title: AV Engineer, Platform & Automation
text: Back to jobsAV Engineer, Platform & AutomationSan Francisco, CA | New York City, NYApplyAbout Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the Role As an AV Engineer focused on Platform & Automation, you'll build and own the software layer of Anthropic's collaboration systems — the tools, integrations, and engineering practices that let a small AV team support a fast-growing global office portfolio. Our rooms, event spaces, and broadcast systems are increasingly managed through APIs and code: device management platforms, DSP and control systems, conferencing administration, ticketing, and paging. Your job is to turn that surface into reliable, team-owned tooling, and to bring software engineering discipline to how we build and maintain it. You can expect a lot of your time writing, shipping, and operating code — fleet health monitoring, automated room testing and ticketing, integrations between our AV platforms and IT systems, and the internal tools that AV Engineering, AV Operations, and Events rely on every day. You'll also help own the administration of the software platforms we already run, and set the standards for how the team version-controls, reviews, tests, releases, and maintains everything from DSP designs to firmware to internal services. Responsibilities Design, build, and ship internal tools and integrations that monitor, test, and manage AV and collaboration systems across every office Develop fleet health monitoring and automated room testing that catch failures before users report them and open actionable tickets automatically Build integrations across device and platform APIs — Q-SYS (including plugins and Lua control scripts), Logitech Sync, Google Meet hardware, digital signage; and IT systems such as Jira, Slack, PagerDuty, and Google Workspace Automate repetitive operational work: provisioning, configuration baselines, drift detection, certificate renewal, and asset data — with code others can read, test, and maintain Own administration and lifecycle of the software platforms behind the AV estate, including firmware and software release management with staged rollouts and rollback plans Operate internal tools as production services, with monitoring, alerting, service metrics, and runbooks, on team-owned repositories and service identities so nothing depends on one person Establish the team's engineering practices: source control, code review, testing, CI/CD, and release — and bring AV configuration under version control, with standards set for integrator deliverables and acceptance verified before changes land Enable AV Engineers, Operations Specialists, and Production staff to contribute safely through templates, guardrails, and review paths built for non-developers Partner with Security, IT Engineering, and Network on least-privilege API access, secrets management, and integration with enterprise standards Gather requirements from AV Operations, Events, and AV Engineering, prioritize the tooling roadmap by operational impact, and decide where to build, buy, or push a vendor to close a gap You May Be a Good Fit If You: Have 10+ years of experience across AV, collaboration, or IT systems engineering, including 4+ years writing, shipping, and maintaining production code that other people depend on Are fluent in at least one general-purpose language: Python, Lua, Go, TypeScript, or similar — and comfortable with shell scripting Practice engineering fundamentals by default: Git-based workflows, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and observability Understand how AV and collaboration systems work: DSP and control, conferencing platforms, room devices, signal flow, AV-over-IP — well enough to build reliable tools on top of them Have built integrations against REST APIs, webhooks, and vendor SDKs, and know how to handle auth, rate limits, pagination, retries, and partial failure Have owned a tool or service in production over time, not just written it, including fixing it when it broke and handing it off cleanly Have defined engineering practices for a team, especially one where most contributors aren't developers Turn operational pain into well-scoped tooling, and can say no to work that shouldn't be built Thrive in a fast-moving environment where standards are being written rather than inherited Strong Candidates May Also Have Experience With: Q-SYS Lua scripting and plugin development Logitech Sync and CollabOS, and Google Meet hardware administration through the Google Admin console and Admin SDK Google Workspace APIs, GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub, Secret Manager), and Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code Jira, Slack, and PagerDuty APIs and automation Crestron, Extron, or other control system programming Dante, AES67, NDI, and network fundamentals for AV-over-IP, including multicast, VLANs, and QoS Building with LLMs — agentic automation, LLM-assisted internal tools, or MCP integrations Monitoring and alerting stacks such as Prometheus and Grafana, and containerized deployment Q-SYS Level 2, CTS, or equivalent demonstrated capability Role Specific Location Policy: This role will be based in our San Francisco or New York City office This role is expected to be in office 50% of the time Up to 4 weeks of domestic and international travel annually for platform rollouts, new-office readiness, and on-site testing Business-hours escalation coverage for the tools and platforms this role owns Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$285,000 - $325,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the role As an Applied AI Engineer at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor helping tech-forward companies build on the Claude Developer Platform as they grow and scale. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with engineering teams to help them develop their products on top of Claude - advising on implementation, agent design, and working alongside them to build at the frontier of AI.Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers through deep technical engagements. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable tech-forward businesses to succeed with Claude. Responsibilities Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-growth, tech-forward companies, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI Work hands-on with customer engineering teams: pair programming, architecture reviews, and code contributions that accelerate their development Develop prototypes and technical documentation—including evaluation suites, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams—that enable customers to build and scale with Claude Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements Identify patterns across engagements and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, and the broader Applied AI team Create technical content for developer audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and developer-focused events Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and relationship building You may be a good fit if you have 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder Experience in a customer-facing or pre-sales technical role - partnering with customers to scope, design, and deliver solutions Production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python and experience building production applications Experience working with high-growth, tech-forward companies Ability to context-switch across industries (healthcare, fintech, etc.) and use cases Builder credibility that earns trust with technical founders and engineering leaders - you've shipped products and can speak from experience Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans Experience facilitating technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events Passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. title: Data Engineer, Product
text: Back to jobsData Engineer, ProductSan Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WAApplyAbout Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.Job Description As a Data Engineer, you will be a member of the Data Science & Analytics team building the foundation to scale analytics across our organization. You will collaborate with key stakeholders in Engineering, Product, and other areas to build scalable solutions to transform data into key metrics reporting and insights. You will be responsible for ensuring teams have access to reliable, accurate metrics for consumer products from idea to implementation. You will also lead your own projects to enable self-serve insights to help teams make data-driven decisions. Responsibilities: Understand and whenever possible proactively identify the data needs of stakeholder teams in terms of key data models and reporting, and translate that into technical requirements Define, build and manage key data pipelines in dbt that transform raw logs into canonical datasets Establish high data integrity standards and SLAs to ensure timely, accurate delivery of data Develop insightful and reliable dashboards to track performance of core metrics that will deliver insights to the whole company Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools to enable self-serve analytics to scale across the company Closely partner with stakeholders to define and materialize metrics and analysis for new and evolving consumer products in a fast paced environment Influence the future roadmap of Product teams from a data systems perspective Become an expert in our organization’s data models and the company's data architecture You might be a good fit if you have: 7+ years of experience as an Data Engineer or similar Data Science & Analytics roles, preferably partnering with Product leads to build and report on key company-wide metrics. A passion for the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI. Expertise in building multi-step ETL jobs through tooling like dbt; proficiency with workflow management platforms like Airflow and version control management tools through GitHub. Expertise in SQL and Python to transform data into accurate, clean data models Experience building data reporting and dashboarding in visualization tools like Hex to serve multiple cross-functional teams. A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of the effective. A “full-stack mindset”, not hesitating to do what it takes to solve a problem end-to-end, even if it requires going outside the original job description. Experience building a Data Engineering (or similar) function at start-ups. A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress. Experience scaling own productivity and that of others by leveraging AI without sacrificing the quality of deliverables. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$320,000 - $405,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. text: Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - SIEM/Security Analytics / CTI (Central/West)Dallas, TXSales – Sales Engineers /Full-time /RemoteApply for this jobCompany Description Anomali, headquartered in Silicon Valley, delivers the first Intelligence-Native Agentic SOC Platform — unifying a security data lake, the world's largest IOC repository, threat intelligence, and agentic AI into a single modern experience. The platform accelerates detection, investigation, and response, delivering earlier insights, faster action, and scalable modernization across any environment. Whether augmenting existing tools or delivering complete SOC capabilities end-to-end, Anomali empowers security teams to operate faster, smarter, and with confidence. Beyond Detecting. Start Deciding. Start Acting. Learn more at www.anomali.com Responsibilities: As a Senior Solutions Engineer specializing in Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and Cyber Threat Intel (CTI),you will play a pivotal role in providing advanced pre-sales technical support for both territory and enterprise accounts, as well as, regional channel partners. Your primary focus will be on driving new business opportunities from prospective and existing customer accounts within your assigned region. Achieving and exceeding sales quotas to meet revenue goals will be a fundamental objective. In this role, you will lead and manage all technical aspects of the pre-sales engagement process for potential clients and enable partners. Additional Responsibilities: o Provide exceptional pre-sales technical expertise through effective delivery of technical and product demonstrations o Serve as a valuable business resource to prospects and customers, leveraging your status as an "industry expert" to employ executive-level selling practices. Maintain consistent communication and provide ongoing technical consultation. o Take the lead in driving opportunities within strategic and enterprise accounts within your assigned territory, focusing on SIEM solutions o Assume the role of a proactive "Technical Account Manager" in target accounts, fostering relationships and engaging in business development activities o Collaborate seamlessly with Sales, Marketing, and Product Managers, serving as the technical liaison between Enterprise Business Representatives and pre-sales customers o Assume ownership of the primary technical relationship with pre-sales customers. Ensure their satisfaction by skillfully managing and delivering technical insights through various channels, including on-site interactions, online communication, and phone conversations. o Support the regional Sales Organization to guarantee the timely and successful closure of sales with potential customers, particularly in the context of SIEM solutions o Facilitate effective communication between customers and Product Management, conveying pertinent feedback and customer requirements o Play a central role in planning and conducting mid/high-level meetings with customers and prospects o Support excellent technical relationships with partners across the region o Quickly acquire, apply, and communicate technical knowledge concerning Anomali’s technology as well as competitor offerings. Qualifications: Required Skills/Experience: o Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an additional 3 years of relevant experience in lieu of degree o Extensive background and expertise in security analytics with a focus on SIEM technologies and CTI o A minimum of two years of experience as a field systems engineer, sales engineer or consultant supporting large enterprise customers o Strong grasp of general networking concepts and proficiency in Linux o Deep understanding of security and information event management (SIEM) principles and methodologies o Hands-on experience and proficiency with SIEM platforms such as ArcSight, SPLUNK, NetWitness, QRadar, McAfee SIEM, or similar tools. o Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Perl o Confident and effective presenter, capable of addressing diverse audiences o A passion for both sales and technology, with a strong desire to advance your sales engineering career o Openness to coaching and a proactive approach to training/feedback o Self-motivated, displaying a robust work ethic o Clear and concise communicator with strong interpersonal skills o Proficient in delivering engaging presentations with an unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction o Demonstrated ability to manage Proof of Value and adeptness in conducting solution demonstrations o Preferred location: US Central, Mountain or Pacific time zones o This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. The successful candidate must not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship to work in the US. If you possess the requisite qualifications and are enthusiastic about driving technical sales, specifically in the realm of SIEM, within a dynamic startup environment, we encourage you to apply for this captivating Sales Engineer - SIEM Specialist role. Your contributions will be instrumental in advancing our sales efforts and contributing to the overall growth of our company. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de clients pour livrer des applications d'IA avancées qui résolvent des problèmes commerciaux réels. Nos FDE interagissent avec les clients pour accélérer l'adoption des produits existants et créer de nouvelles applications basées sur nos modèles.En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes post-vente, produit et ingénierie, vous combinerez expertise en ingénierie, compréhension des applications IA de pointe et compétences en contact avec la clientèle pour comprendre les flux de travail clients et développer des solutions innovantes qui répondent à des défis commerciaux complexes tout en respectant nos normes élevées de sécurité et de fiabilité.Vous serez à la pointe des déploiements d'IA en entreprise et vous serez l'une de nos fondatrices FDE qui contribue à façonner notre mouvement de déploiement vers l'avant. Nous attendons de nos FDE qu'ils travaillent de manière autonome, qu'ils s'épanouissent dans l'ambiguïté et qu'ils représentent Anthropic au plus haut niveau dans l'environnement de nos clients. Il s'agit d'une responsabilité importante : vous jouerez un rôle clé en défendant notre mission au sein de l'entreprise.Responsabilités Travailler au sein des systèmes clients pour développer des applications de production avec les modèles Claude, en veillant à ce que ces produits répondent aux exigences des clients. Fournir aux clients des artefacts techniques tels que des serveurs MCP, des sous-agents et des compétences d'agent qui seront utilisés dans les flux de travail de production. Fournir une assistance au déploiement des produits Anthropic dans les environnements d'entreprise. Identifier et codifier des modèles de déploiement reproductibles et fournir des informations à nos équipes Produit et Ingénierie. Maintenir une connaissance approfondie des derniers développements en matière de capacités des LLM, de modèles de mise en œuvre et de piles technologiques de développement de produits d'IA. Établir des relations à long terme avec les clients et identifier de manière proactive de nouvelles opportunités de déploiement de l'IA tout au long du cycle de vie d'un engagement. Se déplacer fréquemment (25 à 50 %) sur les sites des clients afin de nouer des relations personnelles avec eux. Être un champion de la mission d'Anthropic sur le terrain. Profil recherché : Vous avez plus de 8 ans d'expérience dans un poste technique en contact avec la clientèle, par exemple en tant qu'ingénieur en déploiement avancé, ou en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel avec une expérience de conseil. Les anciens fondateurs techniques sont également encouragés à poser leur candidature. Vous avez de l'expérience en production avec des LLM, incluant l'ingénierie avancée des prompts, le développement d'agents, les cadres d'évaluation et le déploiement à grande échelle. Vous avez de solides compétences en programmation avec une maîtrise de Python (et idéalement d'un ou plusieurs autres langages comme TypeScript, Java, etc.) et une expérience de l'expédition d'applications de production. Haute capacité d'action, capable de surmonter l'ambiguïté qui caractérise les organisations complexes.• Esprit de coopération élevé pour la collaboration inter-organisationnelle, équilibrant les priorités concurrentes avec intégrité.• Passion pour la promotion de systèmes d'IA sûrs et bénéfiques à travers des applications techniques créatives.• Solides compétences en communication pour mener des discussions exploratoires avec les clients et transmettre des concepts techniques à divers intervenants tout en conservant une attitude humble et collaborative.• Une expérience dans le domaine des services financiers, des soins de santé/sciences de la vie ou d'un autre secteur d'activité est un atout.• Une expérience des systèmes informatiques d'entreprise et/ou des modèles de déploiement de l'IA est un atout. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will collaborate closely with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models.Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise.Responsibilities Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements. Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows. Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have 8+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. Native French speaker with fluent English proficiency Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations. High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus. Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. text: Back to jobsIT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, ChromeOSBoston, MA; Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY; Washington, DCApplyAbout Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the role The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint. Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there. through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team's config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and actual state Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program You may be a good fit if you Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow Strong candidates may also Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate Technical Skills Python and shell scripting ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise Google Admin SDK, Chrome Policy API, and GAM for automating policy and reporting Android Enterprise management (working knowledge) Querying live device state at fleet scale GitOps and CI for configuration management Endpoint security fundamentals We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. title: Appen - Forward Deployed Engineer
text: Forward Deployed EngineerSan Francisco, CaliforniaAI Data Opportunities – Applied AI & Research /Permanent - Regular Full-time /HybridApply for this jobRole Purpose The Forward Deployed Engineer works directly with enterprise clients to design, deploy, and optimize GenAI data solutions, with full ownership of final delivered data quality. Embedded across engineering, data operations, and client delivery, this role ensures datasets, pipelines, workflows, and automations meet defined accuracy, reliability, and performance requirements for GenAI model development. Your Impact Act as a trusted consultative partner to clients by defining requirements, clarifying success criteria, shaping high-quality annotation guidelines, and proactively providing insights. Influence the what and the why behind GenAI data solutions by translating ambiguous client needs into clear, scalable workflows. Deliver GenAI datasets that meet all defined acceptance and quality criteria. Define the validation and automation requirements that reduce variance, manual review effort, rework, and time to validation. Partner with engineering to build requirements as scalable, reproducible, and observable pipelines. Contribute reusable quality frameworks and validators adopted across multiple projects. What You Bring 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions architect, data or technical consulting, or data operations. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience working on GenAI, machine learning, or model evaluation data, including LLM training, annotation, or evaluation workflows. A consultative problem-solving approach when leading client conversations, asking sharp questions, and guiding stakeholders toward better decisions. Ability to vibe code but proficiency in Python and SQL is a plus Confidence in working directly with client engineering or machine learning teams. Location and Work Arrangement This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA. You will be required to work from our San Francisco office two days per week.$150,000 - $200,000 a yearThe total target compensation for this full-time role is inclusive of base salary and performance-based incentive. Actual compensation is determined based on role, level, experience and technical expertise. Appen offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan options and paid time off.Why You’ll Love Working Here At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest-quality AI solutions for frontier models. You’ll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You’ll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time. About Appen Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialize in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre-training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion. title: Senior Software Engineer, Trading Infrastructure
text: Back to jobsSenior Software Engineer, Trading InfrastructurePalo Alto, California, New York City, New YorkApplyAptos is a people-first blockchain on a mission to help billions of people achieve universal and fair access to decentralized assets in a safe and scalable way. Founded by some of the original creators and maintainers that researched, designed, and built the Diem blockchain to serve this purpose, we have dedicated several years toward this mission. We believe the open-source Diem technology we have developed is an important foundation of a safe and scalable web3 world where everyone has more equitable opportunities to grow and access financial assets with lower fees and fewer intermediaries. Aptos (Ohlone for "The People") encompasses our mission and ethos for why we build.About The Role We're looking for a talented, driven Senior Software Engineer to build the critical infrastructure that powers trading on Aptos. This role will have significant impact and visibility - the systems you build will directly enable billions of volume on Aptos. You'll work on APIs, indexers, node infrastructure, SDKs, and developer tools that form the foundation for trading and trading products. You'll help shape technical direction and may grow into leading other engineers as the team scales. You should love solving hard distributed systems problems and have a passion for building robust, scalable infrastructure. This is a hands-on role: most of your day is spent writing, reviewing, and debugging real code across the stack, with the autonomy to make sound technical decisions and the judgment to know which ones to raise. You care about more than making it work. You think about edge cases, failure modes, performance — both on the server and as the user perceives it — accessibility, and the engineers who'll read your code next. You collaborate closely with product managers, QA, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous goals into reliable software, and you push back early when requirements don't add up. You bring an AI-first working style — using AI tooling daily to move faster across design, coding, and review — with the judgment to catch where its output falls short. You’re also comfortable working hands-on with LLM/agent APIs — prompt and context design, retrieval, and orchestrating agent workflows — and understand their behavior and failure modes in production. This is not a role for someone who lives on only one side of the stack. We need an engineer who's genuinely comfortable building and owning a feature from the component to the database, takes it from ambiguous intent to shipped, reliable software, and raises the bar for the team around them. Frontend craft Build accessible, responsive UIs with a modern framework (React, Vue, or similar) in TypeScript. Build and maintain integrations with third-party platforms and reason about their failure modes. Code quality and working within the architecture Review PRs thoroughly — catching correctness, clarity, and maintainability issues, not just style. Implement against the boundaries, contracts, and patterns the architecture defines, flag when a contract or requirement doesn't hold up, and escalate the decisions that aren't yours to make. Refactor and pay down technical debt deliberately, where it buys real leverage. Cross-functional collaboration Work directly with Product and Design on scope, feasibility, and trade-offs inside the current iteration. Collaborate with your tech lead and fellow engineers to keep the system coherent as it grows. Apply judgment to AI-assisted output — treat it as acceleration, not a substitute for understanding the code you ship. text: Back to jobsSenior QA Engineer ( Manual & Automation ) LATAMApplyArionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to own quality end-to-end across one of our core product teams and continuously raise the quality bar of the products you support. This is a hybrid role: you are equally comfortable designing manual and exploratory test scenarios as you are writing and maintaining automated suites in CI. You think about quality from the moment a requirement is drafted - not after the code is merged. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, product managers, designers, and DevOps to shape what "done" means: defining acceptance criteria, designing test coverage that reflects real product risk, and acting as the final checkpoint before anything reaches production. You bring an AI-first mindset to the craft - using AI tools to accelerate test design, automation, triage, and reporting, with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when not to. You also own quality for LLM-powered features (assistants, RAG, agents, etc.) where “pass/fail” is a judgment you have to operationalize through evals: curated datasets, graded criteria, baselines, and regression thresholds. This is not a role for someone who waits for tickets to be marked "ready for QA". We need a quality engineer who challenges unclear requirements, asks the uncomfortable questions early, and treats production confidence as a deliverable — measured in fewer surprises in production, faster releases, and a stronger quality culture across the teams you work with Required Qualifications Quality Engineering / QA experience in modern software products, with demonstrable depth in both manual and automation (not one bolted onto the other). Experience designing test cases, test plans, and test strategies for non-trivial systems — covering happy paths, edge cases, negative scenarios, integrations, and non-functional risks. Experience building and maintaining automated test suites in production-grade CI environments, with hands-on framework decisions and ownership of flakiness, reliability, and reporting. Strong experience with at least one modern UI automation tool (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent) and at least one API testing approach (Postman, REST clients, or automated API frameworks such as RestAssured, Supertest, Pytest+requests, or similar). Working knowledge of test case management tools (Qase, TestRail, Xray, Zephyr, or similar) and bug tracking tools (Jira, Linear, Asana, or similar). CI/CD fluency: comfortable wiring automated tests into pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar; understands quality gates, parallelization, and reporting. Scripting/programming proficiency in at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or equivalent—sufficient to write, debug, and refactor automation code without dependency on engineers. Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals: risk-based testing, equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, exploratory testing techniques, and regression strategy. Strong release readiness mindset: ability to define quality gates, run release validation, and make confident go/no-go calls backed by evidence. Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable working in fully remote, distributed teams. Senior judgment: ability to operate autonomously, challenge unclear requirements, prioritize by risk, and own outcomes without micromanagement. AI-first working style: hands-on, daily use of AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, and documentation — with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when not to. Nice to have: Performance and load testing experience (k6, Locust, JMeter, or similar) and the ability to design realistic load scenarios. Security testing awareness: OWASP Top 10, injection patterns, authentication/authorization edge cases. SQL for data validation; comfort reading logs and traces to debug failures past the UI layer. Experience with an eval or LLM-observability framework. Experience building LLM-as-judge graders and validating judge/human agreement. What this person will own and do day-to-day Quality Ownership and Test Strategy Own end-to-end quality for the products and features in your scope.Define test strategies based on product risk, release goals, and business impact — not generic checklists.Influence quality upstream by reviewing requirements and designs to surface ambiguity, edge cases, and testability issues early.Identify non-functional risks (performance, security, accessibility, data integrity) and ensure they're addressed or escalated. Manual QA and Exploratory TestingRun structured exploratory sessions guided by risk and user personas.Cover what automation can't yet: complex flows, visual checks, new feature shakedowns, third-party integrations.Document findings clearly: reproducible steps, environment, expected vs. actual, severity, impact.Act as a user advocate during pre-release validation. Test Case Design and DocumentationDesign test cases covering happy paths, edge cases, negative scenarios, role/state transitions, integrations, and relevant non-functional risks.Maintain traceability to requirements, acceptance criteria, and product risks.Build and maintain smoke tests, regression suites, and release checklists as living assets. LLM and AI Product Quality (Evals)Own the evaluation strategy for LLM-powered features: what is measured, against which dataset, with what pass criteria, and what blocks a release.Build and maintain eval datasets: golden sets, adversarial and edge-case sets, regression sets grown from real production failures.Test for groundedness and hallucination: are answers supported by retrieved context, are citations real and relevant, does the system abstain when it should.Test agents and tool use: correct tool selection, argument validity, recovery from tool failure, loop and cost runaway, task completion end to end.Cover safety and misuse: prompt injection (direct and via retrieved content), jailbreaks, PII and data leakage, permission bleed between users or tenants, unsafe or out-of-policy output.Own non-functional quality for AI features: latency (including streaming/first-token), cost per request, token usage, and rate-limit and timeout behavior.Define the human-in-the-loop process: who reviews ambiguous outputs, how disagreements are resolved, how that feedback flows back into the eval set. Automation QADesign, implement, and maintain automated suites across UI, API, and integration layers.Decide what to automate based on stability, ROI, and risk — and what not to.Keep flakiness under control; contribute to the framework itself (utilities, fixtures, test data, reporting). Defect Management and Quality ReportingTriage, prioritize, and track defects to resolution with clean hygiene (title, severity, repro, environment, links).Produce concise release quality reports: what was tested, what wasn't, known risks, recommendations.Surface trends and turn them into actionable improvements. Release Readiness and Quality GatesOwn release validation: smoke, regression, environment checks, sign-off criteria.Define and enforce quality gates for staging, UAT, and production.Coordinate with DevOps on hotfixes, rollback, and post-release monitoring.Make confident go/no-go calls backed by evidence. text: Back to jobsSenior Machine Learning EngineerLATAMApplyArionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build the AI components of a governed data foundation used by AI agents, applications and business teams.You will work inside AI Labs, where most engagements start as an ambiguous business problem (complex legal documents, scanned and digital; extraction, classification, assistants, agents) and end as a working system with measurable quality. Hence, this is a hybrid of engineer and scientist. You write production-grade Python and ship it through CI/CD, and you treat model quality as an engineering discipline: you do not say "it works" — you show the eval. Curated datasets, graded criteria, baselines, regression thresholds wired into CI. You know that an LLM feature without evals is an untested feature, and you build the measurement before you build the demo. You are vendor-agnostic and cost-aware: you choose models based on business constraints, and design solutions between the whole catalog of in-context learning options and new available tools. You use AI tools daily to accelerate your own work, with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when not to. Because we are a consultancy company, you are also client-facing: you demo live, explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, size effort honestly in pre-sales, and turn what you learn into assets the rest of the company can reuse. You might be needed to record videos, design prototypes, and help all through the creative process of a solution. You'll work in a small team (solution architect, data engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client's engineers, who will run what you build. Required Qualifications - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production ownership — not notebooks handed off to someone else.- 2+ years building LLM systems used by real users or delivered to clients.- Advanced Python: clean, tested, reviewable code; async, typing, packaging, dependency management.- Structured extraction from unstructured documents.- Hands-on RAG experience: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, reranking and the ability to explain how retrieval quality was measured.- Hands-on Agents with tool use and MCP experience.- Awareness of LLM security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling in a client-data context.- Experience designing and running evals: building eval datasets, defining graded criteria, establishing baselines and regression thresholds, and using them as a release gate. Candidates who have only eyeballed outputs will not pass this bar.- CI/CD and engineering hygiene: Git, automated tests, reproducible builds, containerization; ability to ship without a platform team holding your hand.- Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, or equivalent) and the judgment to work without one.- Cloud deployment of AI/ML workloads, preferably AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, S3) or demonstrable equivalent on GCP/Azure.- Practical understanding of cost and latency engineering for LLM systems: token accounting, caching, model routing, streaming.- AI-first working style: daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) with the judgment to know when to trust the output.- Senior judgment: operate autonomously, challenge an ill-posed problem, prioritize by risk and business impact, own outcomes. - Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable in a fully remote, distributed, client-facing team. text: careers Got what it takes? Great software is still built by exceptional engineers. Over the years, we’ve learned something simple but powerful: the difference between an average developer and an outstanding one can be dramatic. Talent, judgment, adaptability, and communication matter — especially in the kind of custom software projects we take on. Programming is demanding, creative work. It requires long stretches of focused thinking, thoughtful design, and clear communication. We believe those conditions are easier to achieve in a flexible, remote environment built on trust and autonomy — not office distractions. That’s why Art+Logic is a distributed custom software development firm. Our turnover is far lower than the industry average. Developers tend to stay because the work is varied, the expectations are high, and the culture respects both craft and independence. Clients benefit from this structure too. Our distributed model keeps teams lean and highly engaged. Communication is written and transparent. Clients are involved throughout the project lifecycle, and expectations are explicit. We don’t disappear after version 1.0 — many of our client relationships span years. If you’re motivated by solving difficult problems across a wide range of industries — and you enjoy adapting to new technologies and constraints — you may be a great fit here. See our open positions work How we work Art+Logic is fully remote and globally distributed. Since 1991, we’ve operated without a central office — not as a trend, but as a deliberate choice. We hire outstanding developers wherever they live.Our developers work from home offices around the world, with required overlap with U.S. business hours to support collaboration and client meetings. Flexibility with Accountability We value flexibility. You control your environment and schedule — within the realities of project needs. Our teams meet during standard U.S. business hours, and we typically require meaningful availability during that time. Remote work at Art+Logic isn’t casual freelancing. It requires: Strong written communication Self-discipline Clear time management Comfort working autonomously A proactive approach to collaboration We operate on trust. In return, we expect reliability, professionalism, and technical excellence. Long-Term Relationships We work with independent contractors (often operating as LLCs or similar entities) on an hourly basis. Typical projects run from six weeks to six months, and many continue far longer. Our goal is not short-term staffing — it’s building long-term relationships with strong developers. Team sizes are typically small: 1–3 developers, plus design, QA, and project management. You’ll collaborate closely and be expected to contribute meaningfully to architecture, implementation, and problem-solving. Breadth Over Narrow Specialization Our clients span startups, Fortune 500 companies, inventors, and everything in between. That means adaptability matters. We value engineers who can move between technologies and domains — not hyper-specialists in a single niche. If you’re energized by variety, comfortable stepping into unfamiliar codebases, and motivated to build clean, maintainable systems under real-world constraints, you’ll likely thrive here. All of the company’s designers, developers, and testers are thoroughly vetted experts in their field. We never outsource projects or send them overseas. title: We’re always hiring.
text: We’re always hiring. If you love the work we do or looking for a great async & remote work opportunity, you may found the right place. Arkency is a consulting agency. That means your work would be to write good quality code (testing is absolutely necessary!), but you need to be also capable to talk directly with clients, as well as set up priorities of your work. You don’t need to be an expert with it - but you need to be aware of its importance. The three pillars of Arkency culture are: Anarchy, Async, Remote. Anarchy means - flexible work hours, choosing your own priorities and coming up with the initiative (we love that!). Remote means you are working from everywhere in the world - home, your coworking office, whatever. And async means all communication is not meant to be done instantly - we avoid meetings and long discussions. We have a set of tools to make this kind of working possible. You won’t miss anything important even if you’re working in weird hours. In fact, some of us do. With this kind of environment, overcommunication is necessary. You need to communicate well with the team, so we are more or less informed what’s happening. It’s something you need to learn, but benefits are huge. To start your journey with Arkency, you need to contact us. You’re very likely to be recruited if you: Know that automatic testing is very important during software development and you have a prior experience to prove it. We’ll stalk your GitHub, that’s for sure. You run an active blog. The big part of our working (if you want to) is building products and make everything necessary to sell them - that means blogposts, mailings, landing pages, social media. While some of us don’t write blogposts, this is a skill we’re looking for and gives you a huge advantage. You understand the necessity of creating maintainable code. Tests help, but they’re not enough. You are a great fit if you know (or want to learn) about decoupling from frameworks using architectural and design patterns of software. We love DDD, CQRS, Clean Code architecture. If you fancy those too, you’d love working with us. You are capable of writing a good frontend code. In this times dynamic user interfaces and rich JavaScript codebases are a normal thing for a consultancy agency. You need to know about it or be open to learning it. You write a lot about yourself during recruitment. We’d like to know your background and ideals about the software. In Arkency we avoid writing Rails Way code, for example. You know about the basic stack we’re working on. Ruby on Rails, React.js, Redux - knowing all of these will give you additional points. You are proactive. We love talking to people who come ahead and propose their own ideas, come up with a recruitment talk schedule, that type of thing. During recruitment the more proactive you are, the better. Show yourself in the best light possible! You have a rich portfolio of projects you can share with us. Code doesn’t lie - so we’d love to see what kind of code you produce. Those are things that add you points during recruitment. You don’t need to have it all, we’ll discuss details with you after you contact us. We’re looking forward to hearing back from you! Good luck, Arkency Team

text: Work with us from wherever you like Explore the remote job opportunities at Automattic. Work from anywhere, and make the web a better place for everyone, everywhere. Check out today’s open jobs. View open jobs We’re 1,382 Automatticians in 82 countries speaking 106 languages. We democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. Michelle Langston on her background as a designer, what drew her to Automattic, and what keeps her here. Our hiring process This is our standard process; however, the hiring steps may differ by role to ensure we choose candidates who will thrive as Automatticians. Application You submit a resume, cover letter, and (depending on the role) a few application questions, giving us a sense of your communication style and your alignment with our culture. We pay close attention to your answers, so share as much relevant information as possible, and dedicate real time to your cover letter, since thoughtful written communication matters a lot here. Once you submit, your application goes straight to a recruiter or hiring manager for review. If your application advances, we’ll invite you to complete a criteria assessment designed to evaluate the specific skills the role calls for. Initial interview Most roles start with a Slack interview, which is essential for evaluating text communication in our distributed company. Log in early, take your time with responses, and bring questions. (Note that you might see “Friendly Raccoon” create the channel but won’t conduct the interview itself.) For more tips, see Jerry’s guide to text-based interviews. Some roles call for more verbal back-and-forth, so we use 30 to 60 minute Video interviews instead. You’ll talk with a recruiter or hiring team member about your experience and career goals, so come prepared with specific examples that show your fit for the role and the company. Practical test or trial For some roles, you’ll complete a project that simulates real work in place of a traditional technical interview. This might be a shorter test, like a code test with an assigned buddy on existing code such as a WordPress plugin, or a longer trial of up to 20 hours using real work to check mutual fit, with feedback from your hiring team throughout. Either way, we’re evaluating problem-solving, design sense, and communication, not specific platform knowledge, so take the time you need. Most candidates finish within a week or so. Read more about what to expect. Final review and offer Once a candidate reaches this point, many teams hold a final interview, typically with an executive leader in the business unit. From there, the hiring team submits a recommendation, including your profile, feedback, and work summary, to the CEO for final approval, which can take anywhere from a few days to a month. If approved, HR will reach out to chat about your interview experience, compensation, and start date. Open jobs “I will strive to create inclusive spaces along my journey and intentionally seek out different perspectives.” At Automattic, we want people to love their work and show respect and empathy to all. We welcome differences and strive to increase participation from traditionally underrepresented groups. Automatticians across the company are encouraged to drive grassroots change, for example, facilitating private online spaces for affiliated Automatticians to gather and monthly People Lab series for further learning. Learn more about our Employee Resource Groups. Our dedication influences far more than just Automatticians: we make our products freely available and translate our products into and offer customer support in numerous languages. We ensure our products are accessible across different bandwidths and devices. “I love the fact that it’s very equal here, and actually everybody is used to just covering for somebody being on leave. I think that changes the perception of women a bit, like not being as worried about taking time out—because actually a lot of people take time out here for different reasons.” Nicola Hodd, Marketing Operations Read Nicola’s article What We Value Excellent Communication: As a distributed company, we rely on clear, thoughtful written communication. Autonomy and Self-Direction: We trust team members to manage their work without micromanagement. Continuous Learning: We value curiosity and willingness to develop new skills. Diverse Perspectives: We build better products when our team represents diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Open Source Ethos: We believe in transparency and giving back to the community. Read our Creed Benefits and Culture True Flexibility: Work from anywhere with internet access, on your own schedule. Competitive Compensation: We offer salaries based on skills, not location. Growth Opportunities: Internal mobility and continuous learning are encouraged. Open Vacation Policy: Take time off when needed, with no fixed limit. Equipment Allowance: We provide what you need to create your ideal workspace. Company Retreats: Teams gather once annually to collaborate in person. More about our Benefits Our remote-first culture This isn’t your typical work-from-home job. Everyone works from the location they choose, during the hours they choose. We’re spread out all over the world. We track about 70 percent of our projects on P2-themed WordPress.com blogs, 25 percent in private chat rooms, and the rest on Slack. Because of the geographic variance, we’re active 24/7. But don’t let that worry you. This is not a work-’til-you-drop place. We encourage work-life balance, and care about the work you produce, not the hours you put in. How We Work Why you’ll love working here Making the web a better place is rewarding in its own right, but we also provide professional growth, an open vacation policy, generous parental leaves, wellness support, sabbaticals, and more. Our main benefits are listed here. Additional benefits vary by location. Our Benefits We also meet(up) live Since the pandemic, we’ve focused on smaller groups, division meetups, and so on, that accomplish bonding and coworking on a manageable scale. Awesome places we’ve met include San Francisco, California; La Paz, Mexico; Oracle, Arizona; Breckenridge, Colorado; Mont-Sainte-Anne, Québec; Budapest, Hungary; San Diego, California; Santa Cruz, California; Park City, Utah; Whistler, Canada; Orlando, Florida; London, England; Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Madrid, Spain; Amsterdam, The Netherlands; Montreal, Québec; and many more.In addition to our larger meetups, individual teams meet for five to seven days to brainstorm team-level strategy and bond in locales ranging from Boulder to Buenos Aires, Las Vegas to Lisbon, Montréal to Mexico City, and Vienna to Vietnam. If you join our merry band, expect to travel three to four weeks per year. Travelling at Automattic Preparing Your Application When applying to Automattic, it’s important to research our products and values to ensure a strong alignment with our mission. Showcase relevant projects and contributions that highlight your skills and how they connect to the role you’re pursuing. In your cover letter, demonstrate excellent communication skills — clear, thoughtful writing is highly valued here. Be prepared to discuss how you work independently, manage your time effectively, and stay motivated without direct supervision. Finally, highlight any experience you have with distributed teams or remote work, as collaboration across time zones is a key part of how we operate. Apply for an open role Automated Tools in Our Hiring Process As part of our hiring process, Automattic may use automated tools to help evaluate, score, match, or verify candidates. This can include tools that assess application materials, detect fraudulent applications, verify identity, or support candidate sourcing. These tools support, but do not replace, review by our recruiting team. text: Sr Full Stack Engineer (Node + React) Avenue Code Latin America Sr Full Stack Engineer (Node + React) Avenue Code Latin America 3 weeks ago Over 200 applicants See who Avenue Code has hired for this role Report this job Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a fast-paced Product Engineering team working on a large-scale, high-traffic web and mobile platform.You will work in a mature production environment with real architectural complexity, contributing across the entire product stack: React and React Native applications, Node.js microservices, GraphQL APIs, databases, background jobs, and event-driven systems.This is a hands-on, coding-focused role, with most of your time dedicated to building and evolving product features using React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL. You will also have the opportunity to work across the broader engineering ecosystem, supporting the analytics platform, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud infrastructure.The team owns its features end-to-end, from the user interface to APIs, data, deployment, and production support.What You'll DoBuild and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using React, React Native/Expo, TypeScript, and established design systems, with a focus on performance, accessibility, and responsive user experiences.Develop and evolve GraphQL (Apollo) and REST APIs using Node.js/TypeScript, including microservices, API contracts, database integrations, background jobs, and asynchronous/event-driven processing.Work with MongoDB, Redis, and domain-event/message-based architectures, ensuring services are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and well tested.Integrate frontend applications with APIs and implement unit, integration, and E2E testing across the stack using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Mocha, and Playwright.Contribute to the data platform, maintaining dbt models and supporting Snowflake-based analytics pipelines, data transformations, testing, documentation, and workflow orchestration.Support CI/CD, deployments, and production operations, working with Docker, AWS, logging, metrics, monitoring, error tracking, and incident troubleshooting.Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to define features, estimate effort, evaluate technical trade-offs, and ensure high-quality delivery through code reviews and engineering best practices.Take end-to-end ownership of features, proactively identify risks and blockers, navigate ambiguous problems, and contribute across unfamiliar areas of the stack when needed.Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to accelerate delivery while validating generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability.What We're Looking ForProfessional software engineering experience, with a strong full-stack or backend-leaning background.Expert-level knowledge of JavaScript/ES6+ and TypeScript.Strong hands-on experience with React, including functional components, hooks, and state management.Production experience with React Native, ideally with Expo, including maintaining a live mobile application.Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript for backend development.Hands-on experience building and consuming GraphQL APIs, preferably with Apollo, as well as REST APIs.Experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas and API contracts.Experience working with MongoDB or another document-oriented database.Strong understanding of automated testing, including unit and integration testing across frontend and backend.Experience with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Mocha, and familiarity with E2E testing frameworks such as Playwright.Solid understanding of Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and modern software development practices.Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs.Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to navigate ambiguous problems and drive work to completion.Nice to HaveExperience with Next.js and modern rendering strategies such as SSR, SSG, or ISR.Experience with dbt and Snowflake or other modern cloud data warehouses.Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar workflow orchestration tools.Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues, such as RabbitMQ/AMQP or Kafka.Experience working in monorepos using tools such as Nx, Lerna, or Yarn Workspaces.Experience with product analytics platforms such as Segment or similar typed-tracking solutions.Experience integrating with headless CMS platforms.Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch.Experience with Algolia, Elasticsearch, Stripe, feature flagging, or experimentation platforms.Experience with GitHub Actions, Buildkite, EAS, or Fastlane.Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot as part of a broader engineering workflow.Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.
