text: Back to jobsSoftware Engineer, Open Source AI Remote - Colombia ; Remote - Costa Rica ; Remote - MexicoApplyAbout Backblaze Backblaze provides reliable, high-availability cloud storage trusted by consumers, SMBs, enterprises, and developers in over 150 countries. Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage supports data-intensive workloads including backup, media, analytics, and modern AI pipelines. Our teams focus on building durable, scalable systems with a strong emphasis on developer experience and operational efficiency. Role Overview We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and maintain open source AI integrations, frameworks, and example applications that make Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage a natural part of how AI workflows are constructed and deployed. This is a front-row seat to the AI ecosystem as it evolves, working directly with the latest AI startups, open source frameworks, and developer tools. This role is expected to actively use the latest AI coding agents and tools as part of everyday development work. The primary objective is to build and contribute production-quality open source integrations, new frameworks, and end-to-end example applications that demonstrate how B2 supports AI workflows. A practical understanding of AI workflows, agent-based systems, and data orchestration is required. This role demands continuous learning and hands-on testing of emerging AI frameworks and APIs as they mature, and is best suited for someone genuinely excited to work at the forefront of AI development. What You’ll Be Doing Use AI coding agents to build coding harnesses to accelerate the development, testing, and maintenance of public and internal applications, SDKs, notebooks, and reference implementations that demonstrate AI and cloud storage best practices. Implement and maintain open source AI integrations, frameworks and example applications using languages commonly used in the open source ecosystem, including Python, TypeScript, Go, and Rust. Use AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate implementation while validating correctness, security, and performance. Contribute to open source projects through code contributions, issue triage, reviews, and ongoing maintenance. Ensure all open source assets meet high standards for testing, documentation, reproducibility, and developer usability. Maintain clean, well-structured GitHub repositories intended for external adoption and community contribution. Collaborate with Product and QA to ensure integrations reflect real customer AI workflows and Backblaze B2 usage patterns. Tools and Technologies Languages: Python, TypeScript, Go, JavaScript and other open source languages Backblaze B2 SDKs and REST APIs Open source AI frameworks and tooling AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, Antigravity and Codex Jupyter and Google Colab notebooks GitHub, pytest, CI pipelines What We’re Looking For Software engineer with experience contributing to open source projects in one or more widely used open source languages. Comfortable owning and maintaining public repositories with external users and contributors. Practical understanding of AI workflows, including data ingestion, preprocessing, inference, and agent-based systems. Experience writing production-quality code with strong testing and documentation practices. Strong written communication skills with a focus on developer experience and adoption. Why Backblaze Build open source software used by developers worldwide. Work at the intersection of AI, data, and cloud storage. Collaborate with experienced engineering, product, and QA teams. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-first culture supporting work-life balance. At this point, we hope you are excited about the opportunity. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Learning, development, and growth are important parts of our culture. We are eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in different ways. We want employees to feel comfortable bringing their full selves to work and doing their best work here. At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are central to those values. We are committed to fostering a workplace where employees experience a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socioeconomic status, ability, veteran status, or education. We believe a diverse workforce helps us better serve customers around the world and reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. Backblaze is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. text: Back to jobsSr. Observability Systems EngineerRemote - USApplyRole Overview This is a senior individual contributor role with significant architectural ownership. You will set the technical direction for how Backblaze detects, correlates, and responds to infrastructure incidents across our data centers, and you will mentor other engineers on the team as that platform matures. If you have a passion for making complex distributed systems visible, you are comfortable making architecture decisions that will outlive your tenure, and you are excited about applying AI and agentic automation to infrastructure operations, this role was built for you.. Mentor engineers on the Observability team and act as a technical resource for SRE, Storage Engineering, and Network Engineering on observability practice. Lead design reviews for observability work and represent the team in cross-functional architecture discussions. Deep hands-on experience with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, or equivalent metrics platforms, including PromQL, Alertmanager, and operating these systems at scale. Experience with Kubernetes, including deploying workloads and understanding pod networking and storage. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and configuration management. Strong understanding of Linux internals, with Debian/Ubuntu preferred. Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team. text: Back to jobsSite Reliability Engineer lII (DBA) - LATAMRemote - Colombia ; Remote - Costa Rica ; Remote - MexicoApplyAbout Backblaze Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals. But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Site Reliability Engineer III (DBA) in LATAM to join our team! About the Role We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer III with a Database Administration focus to help ensure the stability, scalability, and reliability of our production database systems, primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra, alongside the rest of our production services and infrastructure. This database specialization is layered on top of the full SRE III scope on the team. You will carry the same on-call, incident response, and service ownership expectations as other SRE IIIs, with database systems serving as your area of deepest technical ownership. Because our SRE Database Engineering function is new, this role will also help establish its operational foundation by designing database architecture and developing the runbooks, escalation guidance, procedures, and training materials that our Level 1 and Level 2 SRE Database Engineers will use as they onboard. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with production database systems, Linux, automation, distributed systems, Kubernetes, observability, and incident response, with a proactive approach to reliability and operational excellence. What You'll Do: Database Architecture & Administration: Design, deploy, and own highly available database architecture for Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra. Establish and document operational procedures, runbooks, and escalation guidance for Level 1 and Level 2 SRE Database Engineers. Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, schema design, and capacity planning. Own database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery strategies. Perform and validate disaster recovery testing and database recovery procedures. Drive database security, access control, patching, hardening, and compliance practices. Serve as an escalation point for complex database production incidents. Partner with the DBA and Data Infrastructure teams on resharding, capacity planning, replication, and architecture decisions for sharded MySQL environments. Service Reliability & Operations: Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments. Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring, logging, and alerting platforms. Partner with service owners to define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budget policies, and alerting. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. Serve as an escalation point for complex production database and infrastructure incidents. Follow established ITIL/OSS processes including incident, change, problem, and capacity management. Take ownership of operational issues and drive projects from problem discovery through resolution. Automation & Tooling: Develop automation for common operational and database administration tasks to reduce manual intervention and operational toil. Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks including Prometheus, Grafana, Catchpoint, and ELK. Help integrate operational runbooks and incident response workflows with FireHydrant. Work with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code tools including Terraform, Ansible, and Jenkins. Develop scripts using Bash, Python, Go, or similar technologies to improve reliability and operational efficiency. Operate and troubleshoot containerized production environments using Kubernetes and Docker. Work within Kubernetes and Vitess environments using technologies such as kubectl, mysqlsh, and Vitess keyspaces. Work with HashiCorp technologies including Terraform, Vault, and Nomad. Project Management & Collaboration: Lead Production Readiness Reviews (PRRs) for functionality being handed off from engineering partner teams. Support the operational readiness of new database-backed services before they enter production. Build training plans, onboarding materials, and technical documentation for new Level 1 and Level 2 SRE Database Engineers. Partner with Engineering, Product, Operations, and DBA/Data Infrastructure teams on reliability initiatives. Assist with capacity planning, disaster recovery exercises, database migrations, and infrastructure projects. Work with vendors and service providers to troubleshoot service issues and track SLA performance. Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency. Share technical knowledge and help grow a reliability-minded engineering culture. Incident Response: Respond to and resolve production database, infrastructure, and service incidents. Troubleshoot and escalate database, Linux, networking, application, and infrastructure issues as needed. Participate in the on-call rotation and serve as an escalation point for database-related incidents. Lead or contribute to root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Identify recurring issues and develop long-term corrective actions to improve reliability. Design action plans to address recurring operational and database problems. What We Value: A proactive mindset with a can-do attitude. Someone who can work independently, take ownership, and drive complex technical problems through resolution. Someone who steps up, supports teammates, mentors others, and shares knowledge freely. Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies. Curiosity, reliability, and a desire to improve the reliability and scalability of production systems. Required Qualifications: 6–8 years of experience in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, database engineering, or similar roles, with meaningful experience supporting production database systems. Deep hands-on experience with MySQL and distributed or sharded database systems. Experience with Vitess in a production environment strongly preferred. Experience administering and supporting NoSQL databases such as Cassandra. Experience designing high-availability database architecture, replication topology, backup strategies, and disaster recovery processes. Strong SQL skills, including query performance analysis, indexing, schema design, and troubleshooting. Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills. Experience with security-focused operations including patching, system hardening, access controls, and vulnerability remediation. Strong understanding of service reliability concepts including monitoring, alerting, incident response, root cause analysis, SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. Experience working with containers and orchestration platforms including Kubernetes and Docker. Comfortable operating in Kubernetes and Vitess environments using tools such as kubectl, mysqlsh, and Vitess keyspaces. Experience with infrastructure and configuration management technologies including Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, and HashiCorp products such as Vault and Nomad. Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, Bash, or Go. Experience establishing operational procedures, runbooks, documentation, and escalation processes. Experience mentoring, training, or helping onboard engineers into complex technical environments. Experience supporting large-scale, production-grade systems. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Qualifications: Direct production experience with Vitess. Experience with large-scale distributed or sharded MySQL environments. Experience with Cassandra or similar distributed NoSQL databases at scale. Experience in SaaS, cloud services, service provider, or large-scale distributed systems environments. Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar cloud platforms. Familiarity with ITIL/OSS practices and SLA/SLO management. Experience leading Production Readiness Reviews. Experience developing onboarding or technical training materials for engineers. Diseñar y escribir código limpio y robusto tanto para componentes backend (Java) como frontend (React). Implementar arquitecturas y tecnologías de monitoreo y alertas. Liderar procesos de integración continua y prácticas de revisión de código. Proporcionar liderazgo técnico y mentoría a los miembros del equipo. Realizar investigación y desarrollo para evaluar nuevas tecnologías y comunicar su valor para la empresa. Guiar al equipo en entornos tecnológicos complejos.Qué Buscamos 5+ años de experiencia en desarrollo Java y React. Competencia en metodologías Ágiles, asegurando una entrega eficiente de proyectos y colaboración en equipo. Comprensión profunda de patrones de desarrollo y arquitecturas Java. Sólida experiencia en arquitectura cloud y servicios distribuidos. Experiencia en arquitecturas y tecnologías de monitoreo y alertas. Historial probado en desarrollo e integración de aplicaciones a gran escala. Habilidad en realizar revisiones de código y gestionar pipelines de CI/CD. Comprensión clara de los requerimientos del cliente, evaluando beneficios y debilidades potenciales. Conocimiento avanzado de las ventajas y desventajas en la elección de tecnologías o soluciones específicas. Sólida experiencia liderando reuniones con clientes y stakeholders, comunicando efectivamente conceptos técnicos. Habilidades de liderazgo demostradas en gestión de equipos, asignación de tareas, identificación de riesgos, toma de decisiones, estimación de tiempos, resolución de conflictos y planificación de proyectos. Nivel nativo de español. Nivel avanzado de inglés.Qué ofrecemos para que tu trabajo (y tu vida) sea más fácil: Trabajo 100% remoto: trabaja desde tu casa o donde quieras. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. Aqui, o trabalho tem propósito: construir oportunidades reais, transformar a vida das pessoas e o mercado financeiro. Esse é o nosso Jeito Inter de Fazer. Se você quer fazer parte dessa mudança e deixar um legado, seu lugar é aqui.Vem ser Sangue Laranja. Get to Know Inter As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here. Become Sangue Laranja. Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo Atuar no time de Customer Intelligence no desenvolvimento e evolução de microserviços em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance e integração com outros sistemas. No seu dia a dia, você vai Desenvolver e manter APIs e microserviços em Java (Spring Boot, Micronaut ou similar). Modelar APIs RESTful seguindo abordagem API First (Swagger/OpenAPI). Participar de code review e seguir padrões de código e arquitetura do time. Escrever testes automatizados (unitários e de integração). Integrar serviços com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, filas e APIs internas/externas. Implementar soluções seguras, utilizando autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2, Basic Auth). Documentar decisões e comportamentos relevantes das aplicações. Apoiar pessoas menos experientes e propor melhorias de processo e técnica. Participar de decisões de arquitetura, contribuindo com boas práticas de design e escalabilidade. O que buscamos Obrigatórios Ensino superior completo. Java 8+ e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA). Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços, mensageria (Kafka, SQS, SNS), cache e observabilidade. Kubernetes (EKS) e modelagem/otimização de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB). Boas práticas de deploy/CI. 5+ anos em backend, com liderança técnica ou mentoria. Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial em: Belo Horizonte (MG), São Paulo, Curitiba ou Recife Desejáveis Experiência com Micronaut ou outros frameworks além de Spring. Vivência com AWS: EC2, EKS, S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudFront, ELB, Terraform ou CloudFormation. Conhecimento de segurança para aplicações web e microserviços (autenticação/autorização). Prática de Gitflow, CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Uso de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento (Copilot, Cursor, etc.) com consciência de boas práticas. Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de DevOps. Desenvolver e gerenciar soluções utilizando os serviços do ecossistema AWS, como S3, EMR, Glue e IAM. Colaborar de perto com cientistas de dados, analistas e áreas de negócio para entender requisitos e disponibilizar as informações necessárias para o consumo. O que buscamos Obrigatórios: Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados, com domínio prático do framework Apache Spark para processamento de grandes volumes de informações. Fluência em linguagens de programação orientadas a dados, com preferência por Python. Forte vivência em SQL avançado para modelagem, transformações estruturais e consultas analíticas. Conhecimento prático em infraestrutura de nuvem AWS, englobando processamento e armazenamento. Experiência com controle de versionamento de código com Git e conceitos de orquestração de dados. Perfil analítico e proativo na resolução de problemas, com boa comunicação e postura colaborativa para apoiar a equipe. Desejáveis: Experiência com ferramentas específicas de orquestração de pipelines, como Apache Airflow. Conhecimento em processamento de dados em tempo real (streaming). Vivência com práticas de Infraestrutura como Código, como Terraform ou CloudFormation, e esteiras de deploy contínuo (CI/CD). Experiência prévia com outras plataformas de nuvem, como GCP ou Azure, o que pode compensar conhecimentos mais específicos em serviços exclusivos da AWS. Experiência em tratamento e processamento de dados da indústria financeira e de marketing. text: Voltar para vagasDATA SCIENTIST III | DATA ENGINEERING & SCIENCEBelo Horizonte, MG; Curitiba, PR; Recife, PE; São Paulo, SPApplyConheça o Inter Pioneiros, mudamos o mercado ao lançar o primeiro banco digital do Brasil e seguimos criando tendências com tecnologia de ponta. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. Aqui, o trabalho tem propósito: construir oportunidades reais, transformar a vida das pessoas e o mercado financeiro. Esse é o nosso Jeito Inter de Fazer. Se você quer fazer parte dessa mudança e deixar um legado, seu lugar é aqui.Vem ser Sangue Laranja. Get to Know Inter As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here. Become Sangue Laranja.Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo Você fará parte do nosso time de Data Science como referência técnica sênior e atuará diretamente na construção de soluções inteligentes que impactam milhões de clientes do Inter. Sua missão será transformar grandes volumes de dados em modelos preditivos e insights estratégicos, liderando tecnicamente iniciativas de ponta a ponta e sendo protagonista na evolução do nosso ecossistema de produtos financeiros e digitais. No seu dia a dia, você vai: Conduzir análises exploratórias de grandes volumes de dados transacionais e comportamentais para identificar insights acionáveis e oportunidades de negócio. Construir e implementar modelos de machine learning e deep learning aplicados a problemas reais como detecção de fraudes, análise de risco de crédito, sistemas de recomendação, previsão de churn e propensão de compra. Validar hipóteses por meio de experimentos controlados com metodologias de teste A/B e análise estatística. Liderar tecnicamente projetos de ciência de dados de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até a entrega em produção. Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de cientistas de dados juniores e plenos por meio de code reviews e orientação técnica. Colaborar com product owners e engenheiros para traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas e escaláveis. Contribuir para a definição de boas práticas, padrões técnicos e evolução da cultura de dados na organização. O que buscamos Obrigatórios: Sólida experiência com modelos de machine learning em ambientes produtivos e de larga escala, com histórico comprovado de entrega de valor para o negócio. Proficiência em Python com bibliotecas como pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scikit-learn, PyTorch. Experiência avançada em SQL para manipulação e consulta de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência com Apache Spark para processamento distribuído de grandes volumes de dados. Conhecimento em serviços AWS (como S3, SageMaker, Glue, EMR ou similares) para desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções de dados. Domínio de Git para versionamento de código e colaboração em times de tecnologia. Sólida base em estatística descritiva e inferencial, testes de hipóteses e conceitos de probabilidade. Capacidade de explorar datasets complexos, identificar padrões e trabalhar com dados estruturados e semi-estruturados. Habilidade de comunicação técnica para apresentar resultados e insights de forma clara para audiências diversas (data storytelling). Experiência com o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de modelos, incluindo monitoramento, retreinamento e manutenção em produção (MLOps). Desejáveis: Experiência em desenvolvimento de soluções de Machine Learning em ambiente produtivo. Experiência com Apache Airflow para orquestração e agendamento de pipelines de dados. Experiência com metodologias de experimentação A/B em ambiente de produto digital. Vivência em empresas de tecnologia ou fintechs com alto volume de dados. Experiência em liderança técnica ou mentoria de times de dados. Conhecimento em ferramentas de feature store, monitoramento de modelos (como MLflow ou similares) e práticas avançadas de MLOps. Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura de documentação técnica e comunicação com times globais. Engenharia de prompt e LLMs; uso de agentes de teste e MCP. Design patterns: Page Objects, Screenplay, Factory, Singleton, Builder. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. Aqui, o trabalho tem propósito: construir oportunidades reais, transformar a vida das pessoas e o mercado financeiro. Esse é o nosso Jeito Inter de Fazer. Se você quer fazer parte dessa mudança e deixar um legado, seu lugar é aqui.Vem ser Sangue Laranja. Get to Know Inter As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here. Become Sangue Laranja. Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo Atuar no time de Customer Intelligence no desenvolvimento e evolução de microserviços em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance e integração com outros sistemas. No seu dia a dia, você vai Desenvolver e manter APIs e microserviços em Java (Spring Boot, Micronaut ou similar). Modelar APIs RESTful seguindo abordagem API First (Swagger/OpenAPI). Participar de code review e seguir padrões de código e arquitetura do time. Escrever testes automatizados (unitários e de integração). Integrar serviços com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, filas e APIs internas/externas. Implementar soluções seguras, utilizando autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2, Basic Auth). Documentar decisões e comportamentos relevantes das aplicações. Apoiar pessoas menos experientes e propor melhorias de processo e técnica. Participar de decisões de arquitetura, contribuindo com boas práticas de design e escalabilidade. O que buscamos Obrigatórios Ensino superior completo. Java 8+ e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA). Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços, mensageria (Kafka, SQS, SNS), cache e observabilidade. Kubernetes (EKS) e modelagem/otimização de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB). Boas práticas de deploy/CI. 5+ anos em backend, com liderança técnica ou mentoria. Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial em: Belo Horizonte (MG), São Paulo, Curitiba ou Recife Desejáveis Experiência com Micronaut ou outros frameworks além de Spring. Vivência com AWS: EC2, EKS, S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudFront, ELB, Terraform ou CloudFormation. Conhecimento de segurança para aplicações web e microserviços (autenticação/autorização). Prática de Gitflow, CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Uso de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento (Copilot, Cursor, etc.) com consciência de boas práticas. Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de DevOps. title: Join the Bandzoogle Team!
text: Join the Bandzoogle Team! At Bandzoogle, we build tools that help bands succeed online. Our app powers tens of thousands of artist websites, helping them make a living by selling their music and growing their fan base. More than just building a great product, our goal is also to create a great place to work. Work from anywhere Bandzoogle is a fully remote team, but we don't let physical distance keep us apart. We're always in close contact through our busy company Slack channels, video meetings, and yearly face-to-face meetups in fun places (like Chateau Montebello in Quebec). Startup vibe, solid foundation We're not the typical music industry startup. We've achieved double-digit growth every year since we launched in 2003, all without the pressures of VC funding. At Bandzoogle we have the best of both worlds: a light-weight "startup" atmosphere backed up by a solid, profitable company. We were named one of Canada’s Top 100 Small & Medium Employers in 2022. Don't forget the perks! Full-time staff get: Flexible working hours Full health coverage (including vision and dental) A shiny new MacBook (or whatever you prefer) A $1,000 yearly education budget. Learn new skills and we'll reimburse books, courses, conferences, etc. Reimbursement of home office expenses, internet, and use of co-working spaces Yearly meet-ups in fun locations, family included! Integrações complexas com Nelogica, equilíbrio entre entrega e estabilidade, evolução de arquitetura Java/cache, colaboração cross-squad com operação e negócio. Colaborar com Produto, Operações e squads parceiros para atender requisitos de negócio e regulatórios (CVM, B3). Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e compartilhar conhecimento com o time. Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial em BH Mínimo de 4 a 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo pelo menos 2–3 anos com backend e microsserviços em produção. Experiência sólida com Java e arquitetura de microsserviços (APIs REST). Experiência com CI/CD, deploy em cloud e Kubernetes. Capacidade de debug autônomo em ambientes de produção (logs, métricas, tracing). Experiência com code review, testes e boas práticas de engenharia de software. Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas e entregas incrementais. Perfil colaborativo, comunicação clara e foco em valor de negócio. Java, Git/GitLab, Kubernetes, APIs REST e IntelliJ serão ferramentas utilizadas no dia a dia. Desejáveis: Experiência em fintechs, corretoras ou domínio de investimentos (home broker, renda variável). Integração com Nelogica ou plataformas de trading. Valkey/Redis, observabilidade e service mesh. Conhecimento do contexto regulatório CVM/B3. Arquitetura de software e design de APIs. Inglês para leitura de documentação técnica. Automação e IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento. title: Help us become the AI-native digital partner that actually compounds.
text: Careers|Come build with usHelp us become the AI-native digital partner that actually compounds.Work with us Intelligent systems can now read context, chain steps together, and carry the repetitive weight of delivery that used to eat a person's week.At Axelerant, we do not just use that shift, we build on it.We have built our own systems for the work: a shared knowledge brain, a delivery runtime, an acquisition engine, the people layer and more, so the routine runs on rails and our people spend their time on the judgment, the craft, and the relationships. Human-led, AI-shouldered.That is what you would be joining, and it is the part of the work that was always the point: understanding a client's world and owning the outcome.Find your role The systems we build on6 layers01QuireAcquire02FoyerCustomer success03BottThe runtime04FortaThe operating core05MemraContext substrate06FynnThe people layerall five talk via MemraA note on team sizeSmall on purpose,because the systems carry the scale.Small is a choice, and it changes what a day here feels like. You are trusted with real scope early. You work shoulder to shoulder with the client, not behind a layer of account managers. And when something you built moves the number it was meant to move, everyone can see it was yours. There is no crowd to disappear into, which is exactly why the people here chose us.Work with us What we value|Operating rulesOwnership, in the open, done with care.ExcellenceYou are measured on what you ship and what it moves, not on effort or hours. If it did not move the metric you own, it did not count.KindnessRelationships come first, with clients and with each other. You are trusted to look after the whole person, including yourself. Most firms will not put this on the wall because it sounds soft. That is exactly why it is ours.OpennessYou see what the system sees. Trust runs on information, not authority, which means you are expected to work in the open and share what you know.Three values, and each one keeps the others honest. Ownership is not a fourth word on the wall; it is how we work: one name accountable for every outcome, never a committee.An honest disclaimerSome jobs, this is not.A good hire is a two-way fit, and the fastest way to protect your time is to be honest about the parts of this that people sometimes hope are different. If a couple of these sound like the environment you have been looking for a way out of, we are probably the wrong stop.You want a narrow laneSomewhere with a well-defined scope and a manager who hands you tasks. Here, you own the whole loop, ambiguity included.You would rather stay behind the toolsAway from clients, in the safe part of the org chart. Everyone here works directly with the people we serve.You measure a career in titlesWe keep titles flat and let scope, and the outcomes you own, do the talking. If rungs matter more than the work, you will find it thin.You prefer the routine, repeatable workThat work is increasingly carried by intelligent systems. What is left for people is the ambiguous, judgment-heavy part, and that is what we hire for.Open rolesCurrent openings.Our team is remote-first and spans the globe. title: 37signals — Working at 37signals
text: Working at 37signals Take a look at our current job openings, sign up to be notified about future openings, and learn about what it’s like to work here. Sorry, we don’t have any job openings right now. Sign up to be notified If you’d like to be notified about job openings, sign up below, or grab the RSS feed. We will never share your email, or use it for any other purpose. Sign up Who we are An eclectic crew united by intellectual curiosity and a commitment to creating truly great products. We’re a fully-remote company with no physical headquarters. We’re collectively spread out across dozens of cities on multiple continents. Everyone is free to live and work wherever they choose. We run the gamut in geography, lifestyle, and interest, but we’re all here to do exceptional work, build wonderfully novel, straightforward products, experiment, pay attention to the details, treat people right, tell the truth, teach, give back, and keep learning. For 24 years we’ve operated a no-nonsense, profitable business that makes more money than it spends. We’re fully independent, self-funded, and answer to no one but ourselves and our customers. In addition to Basecamp and HEY, we invented the Ruby on Rails programming framework and have written a number of best-selling, influential books. Who you are Rock star? Pass. Friendly and thoughtful? Let’s talk. In broad strokes, Managers of One thrive at 37signals. If you consider yourself an eager learner, a conscientious worker, and a thoughtful, kind, supportive human, you might just have a home here. We don’t place independent value on where you come from, where you live, where you worked before, where you went to school, if you graduated or dropped out, or how well you did or didn’t do. We care about who you are today, how you’ll be tomorrow, and what you’re able to do now. What it’s like to work here A calm, low-distraction environment where you can do your best work. We work hard to make sure every employee is given the freedom, tools, trust, and support to do the best work of their careers. That’s why so many people who work at 37signals stay at 37signals. We respect everyone’s right to participate in political expression and activism, but we avoid having political debates on our internal communication systems. 37signals as a company also does not weigh in on politics publicly, outside of topics directly related to our business. You should be at peace with both of these stances. We value a calm company and deliberate, concerted effort. You’ll have fewer meetings, hardly any email, and far fewer interruptions than you’re used to. 8-hour days and 40-hour weeks are plenty of time to do great work, so that’s all we expect. It’ll take some getting used to if you’ve been immersed in ASAP culture, but after a while you’ll wonder how you worked any other way. We work in small, independent teams, typically on a 6 week cycle. Everyone at 37signals participates in Everyone on Support every few months, and twice a year the entire company gathers in person. Read our employee handbook for more details on what it’s like to work at 37signals. Make sure you check out the benefits and perks. Spoiler; they’re great. We look forward to getting to know you. Thanks for checking us out.

Software Engineer - Data oriented (Mid-Level) Full-time, Rehovot, Israel (Hybrid) At Big Data Boutique, we are at the forefront of modern data infrastructure. You won't just be writing scripts; you will be designing robust backend systems that interact with diverse database technologies; and often interact with data platforms powering Fortune 100 success stories. Key Responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain high-performance Python applications and APIs. Monitor, manage, and optimize data flows. Harness GenAI to your will - use it in a smart way to become more efficient, and build tooling and agentic systems to automate workflows. Collaborate with DevOps and Data Engineers to troubleshoot complex performance bottlenecks. Contribute to the automation of data pipelines and infrastructure management. Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions to ensure high code quality and system reliability. Minimum Requirements: Experience: At least 2+ years of professional software development experience with Python. Database Foundations: Proven understanding and hands-on experience with at least one transactional database system (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server). Core Skills: Strong command of Pythonic principles, asynchronous programming, and RESTful API design. Problem Solving: A methodical approach to debugging and a drive to understand "under the hood" mechanics. GenAI Ready: Open minded mentality, ready to learn new things and leverage GenAI tooling and mindset without hampering quality and accuracy. Major Advantages: OLAP & Search Engines: Experience with ClickHouse or Elasticsearch is highly valued. Database Internals: Deep knowledge of database engine internals and query optimization. Nice-to-Have Skills: Expert Tuning: In-depth experience in performance tuning for MySQL or PostgreSQL (e.g., indexing strategies, configuration optimization, execution plan analysis). Infrastructure: Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native data services. AI-First Marketing Executionist Full-time, Remote, Global (English-speaking) Entry-Level / Student-Friendly We're looking for someone smart, curious, fast-moving, and unusually comfortable figuring things out. This is not a traditional junior marketing role. We already have an established software business, a marketing strategy, positioning, content ideas, campaigns, and a long list of things we want to execute. What we need is someone who can turn plans into output, using AI aggressively to move faster, learn faster and produce more than would traditionally be expected from an entry-level marketer. You don't need years of marketing experience. Students and recent graduates are welcome. What matters much more is that you have an agile mind, strong execution instincts, good taste, and a hunger to learn. What You'll Do You'll work closely with experienced founders, marketers, and technical people to execute our marketing plans across multiple channels. Your work may include: Turning ideas and rough briefs into LinkedIn posts, articles, newsletters, landing pages, and other content Researching topics, markets, competitors, customers, and trends Creating and iterating on marketing campaigns Helping produce visual content, diagrams, presentations, short videos, and other creative assets Updating and improving website content Repurposing existing material into different formats and channels Supporting product launches, events, webinars, and campaigns Experimenting with new distribution channels and marketing formats Maintaining marketing calendars and making sure things actually get shipped Measuring what works and improving future execution based on the results Finding new ways to use AI and automation to make the marketing operation faster and better A big part of the job is simply seeing something that needs to happen and making it happen. AI Is Part of the Job We expect you to use AI constantly. ChatGPT, Claude, image generation, research tools, automation, coding assistants, video tools and whatever comes next should become extensions of how you work. You won't be expected to already know every tool. You will be expected to explore them, learn quickly, and continually improve your workflow. The goal isn't to have AI do mediocre work for you. It's to use AI to increase what a talented, motivated person can accomplish, while applying your own judgment, creativity, taste and critical thinking. Who We're Looking For You might be a great fit if you: Learn extremely quickly Are naturally curious and like figuring things out Are comfortable starting with an incomplete brief Can take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions Write clearly and communicate well Have strong attention to detail Have good visual and editorial taste Enjoy technology and experimenting with new tools Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly Care about getting things published, launched, and finished Are ambitious about becoming exceptionally good at what you do You do not need to be an expert marketer today. We're much more interested in your trajectory than your resume. Especially Interesting Any of these are a plus, but none are mandatory: You already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools extensively You've built side projects, communities, websites, newsletters, social accounts, or small businesses You enjoy writing You have experience with Canva, Figma, video editing, or image-generation tools You understand software, startups, developers, or B2B technology You've experimented with automation or no-code tools You know a little HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Python You have examples of things you've created, even if they weren't created professionally What This Role Is Not This isn't a role where you'll spend six months watching someone else do marketing before you're allowed to contribute. It also isn't a role where success means attending meetings and moving tasks between columns. You'll be given context, guidance, access to experienced people and extensive help from AI, and then you'll be expected to produce real work that goes into the world. Why This Role Could Be Interesting Marketing is changing quickly, and someone entering the profession today shouldn't be trained to work exactly like a marketer did five years ago. This role is an opportunity to learn how to build an AI-native marketing operation from the inside, combining human judgment, creativity, strategy, technology and AI-assisted execution. I

text: Bitovi Services Client Work Open Source Blog Academy Jobs Contact Us Menu Contact Us (312) 620-0386 | contact@bitovi.com We're Hiring Bitovi is simplifying web application development. We build amazing web apps, the right way. After years of solving complex front-end engineering problems, we know what works and what doesn’t. We’ve baked that experience into our tools, consulting, and training. We Want You You’re an experienced developer, UX designer, or DevOps engineer who's looking for more engaging, enjoyable work with a team that's just as passionate as you are. You’d love to level up your skills working in unique environments, a variety of projects, and different frameworks and tools. You're a born problem solver, and you're always interested in a new way to approach a complex challenge. Finally, while you like what you do, you're not interested in burning yourself out to do it. You want the freedom to work where you want, when you want, and with the kinds of projects you enjoy most - and plenty of time to enjoy your family, your hobbies, and your life outside of work. Sound like you? Come join the team. Who We Are We are a full time, remote team of 80+ React, Angular, and JavaScript developers, UX designers, and DevOps Engineers located across North America, South America, and the UK. We offer end-to-end app development, from ideation to training teams in better processes to delivery, and it's our mission to leave every company better than we found it. We're working on a video series for each department on what it's like to work with us - here's the first one, from our DevOps team. TL;DR A good short read for interested candidates is our CEO Justin's blog post Hello Potential Bitovian. Interested? A Little Bit More We want someone who enjoys identifying the hard parts of application consulting and simplifying them, talking about architecture, and teaching others. We also want someone who can lead others and be an integral part of a team. We look for strong communications skills, the ability to set and manage expectations, and how you interact with others to build relationships. In addition to client work, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a small and growing company by applying your talent and passion towards an area of interest. Bitovians: Speak at conferences Conduct training sessions and workshops Run meetups or other local groups Maintain open source projects Publish content What We Look For When it comes to interviewing, we are looking for individuals with expert level technical skills, who are just as comfortable and confident communicating with key client stakeholders, setting and managing expectations, and leading through project challenges. Project success is a combination of multiple factors and we've learned that non-technical skills are just as critical. Our interview process for all roles involves a combination of technical, behavioral, and consulting style interviews. We tend to start with a take home exercise and move on to interviews conducted via video calls from there. title: Careers
text: Careers We help some of the world’s biggest enterprises build change-ready networks. Our products boost network resilience, enable rapid change, and protect critical infrastructure. And thanks to our culture, we have fun doing it. Want to be a part of the action? Join us! See vacancies Happy people make big things happen BlueCat offers a friendly and exciting culture with great benefits and a range of exciting career opportunities in places such as Canada, the US, Iceland, and Europe. When you’re a BlueCat, your voice and ideas always matter—to everybody, including our leadership team. Plus, we have fun. There are a bunch of social gatherings and great parties spread across the year, the biggest of which is the Bluecat Kick-off (or BKO). BKO is our annual event where we fly BlueCats in from all over the world to celebrate our wins, plan our year, and charge into the year ahead together. It’s a hell of a show. Basically, we love working here. And so will you. We build cutting-edge software for some of the biggest organizations in the world – across all industries. We are inspired to challenge ourselves everyday. We want our employees to try new things and grow. We aren’t afraid of failure. We know we won’t have success without each other. Every day is an exciting day in the office, never know what to expect. Where we work We’re based in Toronto but work all over the globe. We have offices in California, New York, Serbia, Germany, the UK, Japan, Iceland, and we sometimes hire fully remote positions. Our culture code This list was crowdsourced from the BlueCats themselves. It’s a guide to bringing our values to life. And we stick to it. We are accountable, transparent and responsive We are driven by initiative, defined by action We listen to and guide our customers and each other We are inspired to innovate, powered by curiosity We win as One BlueCat is officially a great place to work See what it’s like to work in our teams Software Engineering Our Software Engineering team’s priority is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products. Innovation is at their core. They run an Agile shop across all five of our products and make use of product demos and daily standups to keep each other in the loop on all of the amazing things happening here. See software engineering vacancies Customer Success Customer Success is the face of BlueCat for our customers. They listen to what our customers tell them about their experiences and needs so we can serve them better with outstanding customer experiences. They call themselves “BlueCat’s frontline warriors.” We’ve never actually seen them wearing body armor, but we get what they mean. See customer success vacancies Sales Our Sales team likes to have fun and win together. They’re intelligent and market-aware professionals who love bringing creative solutions to the table to help grow and transform BlueCat. See sales vacancies Marketing The Marketing team moves fast, works hard, and (in their own words) “gets sh*t done”. But what sort of sh*t, exactly? Well, things like working closely with our customers and leveraging their expertise to deliver lead- and demand-generating content and campaigns, marketing new product releases, getting customer advocacy, and contributing to the BlueCat office swear jar… See marketing vacancies Finance We guarantee you’ll never meet a more collaborative, high-energy, and high-performing Finance team than the one at BlueCat. They’re a big group that has grown and developed into the heroes of all things numbers for our organization. They keep everything running efficiently and balanced — so we all get paid. (On payday, they’re everybody’s heroes.) See finance vacancies IT Our IT team is a family. They rely on each other through all the craziness to make sure our global team of BlueCats are always supported and performing at their best. See IT vacancies People The People team’s priority is making sure BlueCat employees love coming to work every morning. The team works cross-functionally (and tirelessly) to promote and enable everyone’s success at BlueCat. They put people over processes. And, speaking as people, we’re grateful. See people vacancies Product Management Our Product Management team’s priority is delivering amazing products that our customers trust and depend on. The team is continuously accessing market direction, competition, customer feedback, and user experience to ensure BlueCat product success. See product management vacancies Legal Our small but mighty Legal team works diligently behind the scenes to support all of our employees. They’re a whip-smart group of in-house lawyers taking on projects and cases that challenge them to think big and differently. See legal vacancies Join us as an intern/co-op There’s no better place to get experience, strong mentorship and exposure to an amazing work culture as a co-op student. Take a look at our hiring process for details on how to apply. Learn more Equal opportunity employer BlueCat Networks is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all individuals. Our hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We strive to ensure that our workforce reflects the diverse communities in which we operate and that every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. BlueCat promotes a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply and welcome the unique perspectives they bring to our team. By fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, we believe we can achieve greater innovation, creativity, and success as a company. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. BlueCat is an equal opportunity employer, and we look forward to building a diverse and talented team. Protecting your privacy BlueCat requests certain information from you if you would like to register as a user of this site. Protecting your privacy is important to us so BlueCat will only collect, use, retain, and disclose your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. By submitting your personal information to this site, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy, and consent to such collection, use, retention, and disclosure by BlueCat. Connect with us Have questions about a specific role or simply want to express your interest in BlueCat? Reach out to our team at [email protected]! We encourage you to ask questions and welcome the opportunity to connect with talented individuals like you. Welcome to our world There’s always something going on at BlueCat, and we like to share each thing with the world on our social channels. So check us out. Or better yet—add us. Follow us. Say Hi. It’s a great way to find out how you might fit in here. Follow us Follow us on LinkedIn Follow us on YouTube See all vacancies We’re hiring. See our Dockerhub for a list of what’s free. For access to all the images/applications in the catalog, along with many other benefits, you can purchase Bitnami Secure Images. Bitnami Secure Images allows you to use open source software application components in mission-critical projects and production environments in a secure, sustainable and compliant manner. Where can I deploy the applications I get from Bitnami Secure Images? Applications from Bitnami Secure Images are platform-agnostic and can be deployed on any OCI-compliant Kubernetes environments, on any OCI-compliant container runtime and as VMs on VMware infrastructure. We test the applications in our catalog across all major Kubernetes platforms including Tanzu Kubernetes Grid Integrated, Google Kubernetes Engine, Amazon Elastic Container Service, Azure Kubernetes Service and Red Hat OpenShift, so that you can confidently deploy them on any platform of your choice. View our verification matrix How frequently are the applications in Bitnami Secure Images verified and updated? All container images, Helm charts and virtual machines available in the catalog are continuously verified to ensure they include the latest dependencies and minimal CVEs. New versions are only released after they meet specific conditions. This ensures that only relevant updates are delivered to customer registries. Container images A new container is triggered as long it fulfills any of the following cases: A fix for a critical CVE is detected in the OS package An upstream update in the main component of the container is detected There are changes in the configuration scripts such as feature improvements or bug fixes Every 30 days if a new version of the container was not released within that period Helm charts A new Helm chart is triggered as long as it fulfills any of the following cases: A new Helm chart is released in Bitnami Secure Images A new feature or fix for an existing application is merged to the catalog A new version of the main container is triggered that fixes a critical CVE Indirectly when there is an upstream update in the main container Every 30 days if a new version of the chart was not released within that period Virtual machines A new VM is triggered as long it fulfills any of the following cases: An upstream update in the main component of the VM is detected A critical security fix is available Every 30 days if a new version of the application was not released within that period How does the Bitnami Team ensure that Bitnami Secure Images include the latest security fixes? Bitnami Secure Images implements the following policies: Bitnami Secure Images triggers a release of a new Helm chart when a new version of the main server or application is detected. For example, if the system automatically detects a new version of MariaDB, the Bitnami Secure Images pipeline automatically releases a new container with that version and also releases the corresponding Helm chart if it passes all tests. That way, Bitnami Secure Images ensures that the application version released is always the latest stable one and has the latest security fixes. Bitnami Secure Images triggers a release of a new chart when a package that includes a fix for a CVE from the distribution in any of the containers that it includes is detected. The system scans all our containers and releases new images daily with the latest available system packages. Once the pipeline detects there is a new package that fixes a CVE, our team triggers the release of a new Helm chart to point to the latest container images. The Bitnami Secure Images team monitors different CVE feeds—such as Heartbleed or Shellshock—to fix the most critical issues as soon as possible. Once a critical issue is detected in any of the catalog charts included in Bitnami Secure Images, a new solution is released. Bitnami Secure Images provides updates in less than 48 business hours. How do I purchase full access to the Bitnami Secure Images catalog, including Helm charts? Contact us to purchase Bitnami Secure Images today! Bitnami is trusted by millions of developers. With more than 500 million monthly docker pulls, Bitnami has positioned itself as a mature and reliable partner. Its extensive catalog, robust security practices and continuous innovation set it apart in the software supply chain security industry. title: Join Our Team
text: Join Our Team We are Best Practical Solutions, the people behind Request Tracker (RT), one of the most popular open-source ticketing systems in the world, and its companion application, Request Tracker for Incident Response (RTIR). RT and RTIR are used by organizations large and small, across all industries including: private and public companies, security teams, academic institutions, government agencies, and non-profits. We’ve been around since 2001 and are entirely self-funded. We are both contributors to, and beneficiaries of, the free software ecosystem; you can find all of our code on GitHub. RT, being free software itself, is absolutely free to download, deploy, and even modify. We’ve built a business around providing a full range of services to help our customers get the most out of RT. We offer managed hosting, commercial enterprise support, professional installation and upgrades, and custom development where we bring our expertise to address an organization’s specific set of challenges. All of our engagements, whether sponsored by a customer or done for our community, provide the satisfaction of knowing we’re helping people solve real problems every day. We are a 100% remote company so you should be comfortable working with a remote team via tools like Slack, Zoom, and of course Request Tracker. When working at BPS, you can also count on endless opportunities for career growth. With RT’s large codebase, overall breadth of use cases, and variety of services we offer, you will have many opportunities to expand your skillset. In addition to writing code, we also help our customers with a full range of business process support including configuring RT, setting up workflows, and making RT better for people. Not to mention, because everything we do is open source, all of your contributions will be, too. Benefits Work from anywhere Competitive Salary 40-hour workweeks Open Vacation Policy Whatever hardware/software you need to get your job done Co-working reimbursement / Coffee Allowance Professional Development Opportunities& More Lead Platform Engineer Best Practical provides managed hosting for Request Tracker (RT) and associated services, and we seek an experienced platform engineer to help us continue to build and enhance our hosting environment. This role will lead efforts to automate and scale our environments to support continued growth in hosting. Our cloud offering is built on AWS, so the position involves working with AWS services via the Amazon web console, command-line tools, and automation tools like Ansible. We support standard configurations for typical RT deployments and some more complicated custom architectures for larger RT deployments. We work with core services like EC2 and RDS, and additional services like Amazon OpenSearch (Elastic Search). This role involves all aspects of managing and maintaining Linux servers including building out new servers, patching, applying updates, monitoring, and backup and recovery. RT and its supporting infrastructure include the Linux OS (multiple types), Apache, multiple database types (MariaDB, MySQL, Postgresql, etc.), and email MTAs like Postfix. Qualifications 10+ years of experience administering Linux systems, specifically Debian. Production management and support of AWS EC2 servers and related services like Route 53, Cloudwatch, etc. Strong understanding of how the Internet works including web servers, email servers, certificates, DNS, and SSL. Knowledge of secure web architectures, secure Linux server deployment, firewall management, and monitoring for security events. Experience building and maintaining server automation processes with Ansible. Some experience administering and using relational databases like MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. PostgreSQL specifically is a plus. RT is written in Perl, so we tend to lean Perl-ish for many other tools and utilities. You don’t need to be a Perl expert, but it will help if you are familiar and comfortable with it. Strong knowledge of git, version control concepts, automated testing. How to Apply Tech Positions Send something approximating a cover letter, a resume in plain text, HTML or PDF, and a sample of some code you’ve written to resumes@bestpractical.com. If you’re involved in open source development of one kind or another, please tell us about it. If you have a CPAN ID, tell us what it is; we won’t consider applications without some sort of code example to look at. We’ll be paying particular attention to readability, comments, and tests. Whether you’re involved in open source development, putting together some personal hobby projects, or making your mark on the world through your career, we would love to hear all about what you’re excited to be working on. Equal Opportunity Best Practical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. You may read our full statement here.

title: Join the Buffer Journey
text: Join the Buffer JourneyWorking at Buffer is more than just a job. Want to come along for the ride?See our open rolesWhat is Buffer?We’re a small team on a mission to help innovative companies grow their businesses – and along the way, we’re championing a more human way to work.Buffer was started in 2010 as a simple way to schedule posts on Twitter. Today it’s a growing suite of tools now serving more than 75,000 customers.More about BufferOpen dashboardWhere will I work?Buffer is a fully remote team, spread across the whole planet. We have teammates in 22 countries, 51 cities, and 11 timezones (and counting!). As a member of our team, you will be invited to work wherever you’re happiest and most productive.Countries🗺️22Cities🌆51Timezones🕓11More about how we work remotelyUnited by our valuesWe’re building a company that’s focused not just on the bottom line, but also on the happiness of our customers and team. Here are the values that guide our decisions and actions:📖Default to transparencyOur true North Star. Transparency is the value we’re best known for, and yet, still very aspirational. We aspire to always default to transparency as a company and as individuals in our decisions and actions.How we default to transparencyWe choose transparency as a lifestyle of authenticity and honesty, as well as an effective way to work remotely and establish a culture of trust.We believe our transparency will help others as well.We share early in the decision process to avoid “big revelations.”We strive to make all communication clear and avoid making assumptions.⬆️Improve consistentlyImproving consistently is about striving to be better, not in competition with anyone but our yesterday selves. We are committed to working every day toward personal and professional growth.How we improve consistentlyWe try to make Buffer a little bit better every day in whatever domain we can.We choose to be where we are the happiest and most productive.We desire to be better every day and know that improvement can be found in small changes.We strive to exemplify a growth mindset and believe that any skill or talent can be learned through practice.⛵Be a no-ego doerWe don’t attach our personal selves to ideas. We remove ourselves—our fears, our pride—from our work to lead to a better, more productive experience for us and everyone around us. We’re all rowing this boat together.How we are no-ego doersWe consider the bigger picture and practice humility, knowing our work goes beyond ourselves.We are adaptable and comfortable making decisions and working in uncertainty.We advocate for diverse perspectives to make our team and products stronger.We have a bias towards action. Done well today is better than done perfectly next week.💛Show gratitudeThis value is deeply ingrained in our culture. We regularly show gratitude for each other, for the technology to make this company and life possible, and for the many blessings that Buffer brings to our lives.How we show gratitudeWe regularly demonstrate gratitude for our circumstances.We approach customer conversations with the knowledge that it’s a privilege to serve them.We are grateful for the work teammates do to push the company forward.We view it as our duty to give back to help others the way we’ve been supported by many individuals, platforms, and communities.🥛Choose optimismChoosing optimism is foundational to Buffer’s kind and joyful culture. Optimism helps us look to the future with positivity, while embracing hard conversations and decisions in service of Buffer’s health and future.How we choose optimismWe strive to approach everything with optimism about the potential outcome.We assume the best of others because we may lack full context.We believe that constructive, honest feedback is an investment in growth.We push through any artificial harmony.We find joy and fun in the ups and downs of startup life.🪞Reflect to unblockWe carve out time for reflection in order to unblock ourselves. We believe personal growth stems from vulnerability and introspection as we focus on ongoing self-improvement.How we reflect to unblockWe deliberately find time for reflection; we believe this is where life-changing adjustments come from.We find the time to jump out of the trenches into higher-level thinking that will move the needle.We understand the value of patience and treat it as a muscle, which needs practice to grow.What is the Buffer team like?Buffer is an equal opportunity employer that has the awesome opportunity to add teammates from anywhere in the world! We’re united by Buffer’s values, and we celebrate our unique differences.What kind of people work at Buffer? All kinds! We hire talented teammates from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences, and we’re committed to a work environment of respect and kindness.Perks and benefitsOur focus with perks and benefits is to offer everything teammates need to do their best, healthiest work and keep developing their craft.💰Competitive salaryOur salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.🏝Work remotelyLive and work wherever you are the happiest and most productive!🗓4-Day workweeksOur schedule is four workdays, with a flexible, meeting-free fifth day for overflow tasks or personal time as you see fit.💪Health insuranceWe offer health insurance for all of our team members, international or US.🏠Home office setupGet $1000 to set up your home office!👓Growth mindset fundExtra money each year for learning and development.💻New laptopGet a powerful new laptop or PC from your first day at Buffer and every 3 years after.📚Unlimited free booksGet a free Kindle and all the digital or audio books you like, no questions asked.⚡AI tools stipendLevel up your work with the latest AI tools.⛺️Flexible time offNo set limits. Take the time you need to rest and recharge.💵Savings planWith 3% company match.📈Profit sharingWhen the company does well, all team members share the profits.🍼Family leave16 weeks of family leave for all parents, fully paid.👨‍👩‍👧Family support fundA stipend for each kiddo.☕️Working smarter stipendExtra funds for a coworking space or some coffee shop treats.⛱SabbaticalsTake a 6-week break, fully paid, after every 5 years with Buffer.Open rolesThere are currently no open roles.Please be aware: we’ve received a few concerning reports that scammers are falsely using Buffer’s name and reaching out to people about fake job opportunities. We post all open roles here, and only accept job applications through the forms on this page.Be the first to know about new roles at BufferEnter your emailSubscribeAbout usWe are an open companySince 2013, we’ve shared Buffer’s finances, team salaries, and other key metrics openly. Our commitment to transparency is rooted in our belief that it fosters trust, keeps us accountable, and helps drive positive change within our industry.Open dashboardMAUMonthly active users316,903Total customersTotal customers85,028TeammatesAcross 15 countries73ARRAnnual recurring revenue$27.9MOpen dashboard

title: Join us in building tools for a faster web
text: Careers Join us in building tools for a faster web View Open Positions Who we are Calibre is an intentionally small, bootstrapped company building tools to help create faster, more equitable internet. While we do so, we're striving to create a more humane and sustainable way to work. Helping our customers succeed is our mission. If you like seeing the direct impact of your work while collaborating with people who care deeply about doing things right by others, Calibre might be a place for you. Learn more about us. How Calibre supports you at work Work four days a week We believe working less is the future. We show up four days a week, at 32 hours maximum. No overtime! Work remotely Calibre doesn't have a fixed office. You can be in one of the 60+ countries supported by the hiring platform we use. Receive a fair salary We base salaries on market rates, your skills and experience. All open positions come with a transparent pay range. We don't offer equity. Get regular pay increases We raise our salaries by 5% each year. You shouldn't need to switch jobs or be an expert negotiator to get higher compensation. Rest when you need to You'll get 4 weeks of annual leave and 2 weeks of sick leave a year, plus national, state and territory government public holidays. Create your schedule We trust you to tailor your workday as long as you're accountable for your work. Do a school dropoff, go to therapy or run an errand! Spend time with your family All new parents get 12 weeks of paid leave after twelve months of employment, including adoption and foster care. Receive and share feedback You'll always know where you're at with regular 1:1s. We want your candid opinion about how we can improve, too. Be autonomous We trust you to work independently. We will encourage you to create processes and own your area of expertise. Continue learning Spend A$1,500 per year to attend events, take courses or buy books. Available after six months of employment. Get the hardware you need You will receive a MacBook Pro laptop (or the equivalent of your choice) plus required peripherals. Create your perfect workspace You'll have a budget of A$1,500 to make your work environment enjoyable. We also cover up to A$500 a month for a coworking desk! Some benefits (such as leave policies) might vary by country. We will provide a transparent list of benefits to candidates applying for open roles. The benefits above are listed for Australian-based employees but serve as a baseline for what we want to offer no matter your location. Open positions Currently, there are no open positions. Our hiring process We approach hiring with transparency and respect towards applicants in mind. Everyone receives a response at any stage, no matter the outcome. Here's what you can expect: Application submission. Follow the steps in the application form and respond to the required questions. No cover letters are needed! We encourage candidates to take time in getting to know who we are, what we build and how we think about work. We also ask you to respect the outlined process and not seek alternative application and contact methods. Application screening. We review each application to understand your skills, experience and motivation to work at Calibre. You'll hear from us about the application status within seven business days. Interviews and take-home project. Once your application passes the initial review, we will invite you to the first call about values and logistics. Next up, we'll talk to you about team collaboration. Later on, we might ask you to complete a paid project that showcases your skills. Reference check. After you complete all interviews and we successfully evaluate the test project, we ask to chat with three people you worked with in the past. Preferably at least two are your previous managers. Decision. If we decide you'd be a great addition to our team, you'll receive an offer letter to join Calibre. We know that people from underrepresented backgrounds may not apply for open positions unless they meet all criteria. If you’re interested, we strongly encourage you to apply, so we can learn how your unique experience can help shape a better product and company! Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion At Calibre, we believe everyone should be treated with respect and fairness, no matter their background. All candidates are considered without regard to age, sex, race, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, parent or carer status, marital status or religious beliefs. It's critical to us to create a safe and supportive place to work where everyone is welcome.

title: Build a career that suits your lifestyle, in a company where your voice matters.
text: Careers Build a career that suits your lifestyle, in a company where your voice matters. View Opportunities What we believe Our values We Care We have the utmost faith in our team members and the programs that we build. By investing in our team's happiness, we are investing in the success of our company as a whole. We Fail Forward Experimentation is encouraged at CP, and we do it a lot. Sometimes we don't get things right, and that's okay too. To achieve our highest potential, we must learn how to fail forward. We Prioritise We work in small, multidisciplinary teams that are focused on prioritising our customers by developing the best programs possible. We Learn We are dedicated to providing everyone at CP the opportunity to learn new skills. We back this up with a personal learning budget every year. We Play Between our side-splitting team socials, Vinay's never-ending list of dad jokes, and our overly competitive steps leaderboard, there really is never a dull moment amongst us. We Kick Butt We've bagged a great deal of awards over the span of a decade, but we're not stopping there. We're growing as a team, we're expanding to new cities, we're speaking to new companies every day, and we're taking it all in our stride. Normally we don't brag, but this is the only page on our website where we'll do so unashamedly. We also have a Business Development Baby (enquire for more), a couple adorable team pups and a kitten. Beat that. How we work Our Structure Flat structure Everyone is treated equally, and all voices are heard. Diversity & inclusion An ever-increasing social awareness is at the forefront of our culture. Continuous learning A commitment to learning that never stops. Fun side of life Because our success is driven by enjoying the ride too. What We Offer People over process, quality over quantity. We share a deep passion for the work that we do, and we love being able to do it together. Personal growth has been woven into the fabric of our culture since the inception of our company and will continue to be a driving force behind our success. Friendships and trust, built in a safe, friendly workspace. With just the right amount of autonomy, trust and support, we believe everyone has the ability to be the best they can be. Big enough to make a real impact, small enough to move fast. We are a tight-knit remote team passionate about creating the best career opportunities for students and graduates around the world. At CP, we believe there is always room for self-improvement and we strive to be the best versions of ourselves every day.
