text: [Job-32329] Java Backend Specialist, BrazilBrazilGU6 – Prod_GU6 /RemoteApply for this job Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions. Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias. Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Java Backend Specialist para atuar como referência técnica na evolução de soluções de alta disponibilidade e escala, em um ecossistema cloud-native baseado em Java e AWS. Essa pessoa terá papel estratégico na definição de arquiteturas, padrões de engenharia e evolução dos sistemas distribuídos, contribuindo para a qualidade, resiliência e escalabilidade das soluções. Buscamos alguém com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend, visão arquitetural e capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas, orientar times e promover boas práticas de engenharia de software. Responsabilidades Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de sistemas distribuídos utilizando Java, Spring Boot e tecnologias cloud-native.Estabelecer padrões técnicos e boas práticas de engenharia, considerando escalabilidade, performance, segurança e manutenibilidade.Projetar e evoluir soluções baseadas em microsserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.Contribuir para decisões relacionadas à mensageria, persistência de dados e integração entre sistemas.Apoiar a evolução das práticas de engenharia de plataforma e Developer Experience, promovendo padronização e autonomia dos times.Participar das decisões de arquitetura e infraestrutura em AWS, Kubernetes e processos de CI/CD.Identificar riscos técnicos, gargalos de performance e oportunidades de melhoria em sistemas de alta disponibilidade.Atuar como referência técnica para os times, conduzindo discussões arquiteturais, revisões de código e mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras. Requisitos para este desafio Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java 17+ e ecossistema Spring, especialmente Spring Boot.Experiência com arquitetura e evolução de sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e aplicações de alta disponibilidade.Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria utilizando Kafka e/ou RabbitMQ.Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, incluindo modelagem, otimização de consultas e performance.Experiência com desenvolvimento e operação de aplicações em AWS.Conhecimento de Docker, Kubernetes e práticas de CI/CD.Conhecimento sólido de princípios SOLID, Clean Architecture, DDD e padrões de resiliência em sistemas distribuídos.Experiência em decisões arquiteturais, definição de padrões técnicos e evolução de soluções complexas.Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica, influenciando decisões e apoiando o desenvolvimento técnico dos times. Diferenciais Experiência com Internal Developer Platforms (IDP), Developer Experience (DevEx) e ferramentas como Backstage, Port ou Kratix.Conhecimento de padrões arquiteturais como Event Sourcing, CQRS e Sagas.Experiência com serviços AWS como EKS, ECS, MSK, RDS, SQS/SNS e IAM.Conhecimento avançado de observabilidade utilizando OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana ou ferramentas similares.Experiência com GitLab CI e práticas de automação de infraestrutura.Conhecimento de FinOps e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud.Experiência com segurança de aplicações, incluindo OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS ou Zero Trust.Certificações técnicas em AWS, Kafka ou tecnologias relacionadas. title: CI&T - [Job-32448] Master Data Developer (Databricks), Brazil
text: [Job-32448] Master Data Developer (Databricks), BrazilBrazilCentaurus+ – Prod_Centaurus+ /Homeoffice /RemoteApply for this jobAt CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions. With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy. We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.As CI&T grows, we seek a talented, motivated, and experienced Data Developer to join our team and build robust data-driven solutions for our customers. This role is pivotal in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data infrastructure and pipelines that enable our data initiatives to thrive. The Data Developer will be responsible for implementing and optimizing data architectures, ensuring data quality and reliability, and collaborating closely with analytics and business teams to deliver high-performance data solutions. This position requires strong technical expertise in data engineering, cloud platforms, and modern data stack technologies, combined with the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. Responsibilities: Data Pipeline Development: Build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support analytics and business intelligence needs. Data Architecture Implementation: implement data architectures, including data lakes, warehouses, and integration layers that support the organization's data strategy and modernization. Data Quality & Governance: Implement data quality checks, validation processes, and monitoring systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Integration & API Development: Develop and maintain integrations between various data sources, third-party tools, and analytics platforms. Collaboration: Work closely with Data & Analytics Managers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions that enable data-driven decision making. Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance, query efficiency, and storage costs to ensure scalable and cost-effective solutions. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for data architectures, pipelines, and processes. Data Security: Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations across all data systems. Powered by AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to enhance data engineering workflows and productivity. Requirements: Hands-on Databricks migration with the databricks/migrate tool (notebooks,jobs, clusters, secrets, ACLs), Unity catalog to Glue Catalog Notebook and job migration: notebooks, DAG pipelines, DLT pipelines Storage path refactoring: /mnt/ DBFS references to S3-backed locations Data migration execution: Deltalake format to Iceberg format on S3 (Delta tables, raw files), incremental sync Streaming: Auto Loader / DLT checkpoint re-bootstrap, event_id dedup Validation: row counts, checksums, sample queries, ETL runtime comparison Secrets: recreate secret scopes in AWS Secrets Manager AWS services: S3, Glue, Secrets Manager, IAM basics, Athena, LakeFormation andEMR Languages: Spark SQL, PySpark, Java, Python and Scala Agile pod delivery: daily ticket updates, standups, code review Nice to Have: Databricks Certified Consultant (Associate/Professional); DBR to EMR on AWS migration experience #LI-LO1Our benefits: -Health and dental insurance -Meal and food allowance -Childcare assistance -Extended paternity leave -Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass; -Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR); -Life insurance -Continuous learning platform (CI&T University); -Discount club -Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being -Pregnancy and responsible parenting course -Partnerships with online learning platforms -Language learning platform And many more! More details about our benefits here: https://ciandt.com/br/pt-br/carreiras At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important to present your assessment during the selection process. See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here.This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it. We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Sobre o Desafio Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora para liderar a construção, evolução e orquestração do agente de IA da squad. Nesta posição, o foco vai além do desenvolvimento tradicional de serviços: você projetará, treinará e refinará o agente responsável por executar do discovery à verificação de DoD, garantindo qualidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de engenharia. Integração & Contexto: Conectar o agente de IA às fontes de contexto do projeto (repositórios, APIs, sistemas de mensageria e bancos de dados). Engenharia de Prompt & Guardrails: Definir e validar prompts, diretrizes de segurança (guardrails) e critérios automatizados de DoD. Avaliação & Qualidade (PDCA): Analisar criticamente as entregas geradas pelo agente (código, testes e análises) e aplicar melhoria contínua aos fluxos. Liderança Técnica em IA: Operar, medir e refinar as saídas do agente no dia a dia, apoiando a equipe nas decisões técnicas e na evolução da squad. Conhecimentos e Práticas Necessários Desenvolvimento com IA & LLMs (Obrigatório): Experiência prática na integração com APIs de LLM, construção de agentes e tool/function calling. Engenharia de Prompt & Segurança: Domínio no desenho de prompts, definição de guardrails e regras de comportamento para modelos. Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos: Experiência em integração assíncrona (contratos, tópicos/filas, DLQ e idempotência). Microsserviços & Integrações: Vivência na construção e consumo de APIs, versionamento, observabilidade e integração de serviços. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events. The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users. Responsibilities: Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles. Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode. Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles. Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations. Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent. Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed. text: Back to jobsAI Growth Automation Engineer - Bogotá (Hybrid)Bogota D.C. / DC / ColombiaApplyClara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.What you'll do We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "someone should really automate this" into a working tool by next week. You'll sit at the intersection of Lifecycle, Sales, and AI — building the agents, workflows, and internal products that let Clara prospect, sell, and onboard faster and smarter than a headcount-only approach ever could. This isn't a "use AI to write better emails" role. It's a build role. You'll ship things: SDR co-pilots, outbound agents, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows — and you'll own whether they actually move pipeline and activation, not just whether they're clever. You will: Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code. Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation. Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin. Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does. Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted. Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work. Experience with workflow/automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) and comfort integrating APIs across systems (CRM, marketing automation, sales tooling). Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce. Enough technical fluency to read/write basic scripts (Python, JavaScript) or work closely with engineers to get something shipped — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you can't be blocked waiting for one. Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives. A bias toward building and testing over planning — you'd rather ship a rough version this week than a perfect spec next month. Nice to haves Background in Lifecycle Marketing, RevOps, Sales Engineering, Product, or Software Engineering (any of these paths is fine — we care about what you've built, not your job title history). Direct experience with sales engagement/AI prospecting tools (Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, or similar). Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and basic prompt engineering. Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech, ideally with an SDR/AE motion. Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production. Portuguese proficiency (not required, but useful across our MX/BR/CO/AR footprint). Where we work This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.Why Clara A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership. Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths. English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day. How we work Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters. Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be. Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait. Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver. ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning. Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara. text: Back to jobsAI-Native Engineer, New Grad (Hybrid)Monterrey / NLE / MexicoApplyClara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.Ready to start your career at full speed?What you’ll actually do Ship production code in your first weeks — real features, real customers, real money moving. Own features end to end: design, build, test, deploy, watch the metrics, fix what you broke. Use AI across your workflow — coding, debugging, testing, research, automating the boring parts — and push the frontier of how your team uses it, not just how you do. Work directly with Product, Design, and senior engineers. Ask the dumb question early; it’s cheaper than the wrong build. Learn the domain deeply. B2B fintech in LatAm is genuinely hard — multiple countries, multiple regulators, real consequences. That’s what makes it interesting. Relocation to CDMX is encouraged and supported Two tracks — tell us which one fits youProduct Engineering (fullstack, backend-leaning) Backend services, APIs, and the interfaces on top of them. Our stack leans Java/Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and AWS — but we don’t expect you to have used all of it. We expect you to have gone deep on something and to pick up the rest fast.Data & ML Engineering Pipelines, models, and the systems that make them useful in production — risk scoring, fraud signals, spend intelligence. Python, SQL, and modern data tooling. Applied and in production, not just notebooks.Who you are You’re at the start of your software career. Whether you finished your degree last month or took a different route to get here, this role is scoped for engineers without prior full-time software experience — and we’ll treat you accordingly. A technical foundation. CS, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or similar — or equivalent ability you can demonstrate in code. You’ve built things, and you can point at them. A GitHub, a deployed app, a repo people actually use, a hackathon win, a contribution to open source, a bot that solved a real problem for real users. One thing you built and can defend in depth beats a list of ten you touched. You’re AI-native and you can prove it. Not “I’ve used ChatGPT.” We mean: you’ve built with AI — agents, RAG, evals, fine-tunes, a tool that automates something you were sick of doing — and you use AI tools every day in how you code. Come ready to show us the artifact and walk us through the decisions. Strong fundamentals. Data structures, algorithms, systems thinking. Competitive programming (ICPC, OMI, Codeforces), a strong thesis, or serious research all count and we want to hear about them. English proficiency. English is our corporate language — you’ll read, write, and discuss technical work in it daily. Ownership. You surface problems before they become blockers, you push things over the finish line, and you don’t wait to be told what to do. This is the single trait we screen hardest for. Nice to haves Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it. Where we work This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.Why Clara A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership. Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths. English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day. How we work Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters. Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be. Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait. Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver. ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning. Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara. If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.Create a Job AlertInterested in building your career at Clara ? text: Back to jobsAI Growth Automation Engineer - Mexico City (Hybrid)Mexico City / CDMX / MexicoApplyClara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.What you'll do We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "someone should really automate this" into a working tool by next week. You'll sit at the intersection of Lifecycle, Sales, and AI — building the agents, workflows, and internal products that let Clara prospect, sell, and onboard faster and smarter than a headcount-only approach ever could. This isn't a "use AI to write better emails" role. It's a build role. You'll ship things: SDR co-pilots, outbound agents, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows — and you'll own whether they actually move pipeline and activation, not just whether they're clever. You will: Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code. Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation. Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin. Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does. Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted. Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work. Experience with workflow/automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) and comfort integrating APIs across systems (CRM, marketing automation, sales tooling). Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce. Enough technical fluency to read/write basic scripts (Python, JavaScript) or work closely with engineers to get something shipped — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you can't be blocked waiting for one. Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives. A bias toward building and testing over planning — you'd rather ship a rough version this week than a perfect spec next month. Nice to haves Background in Lifecycle Marketing, RevOps, Sales Engineering, Product, or Software Engineering (any of these paths is fine — we care about what you've built, not your job title history). Direct experience with sales engagement/AI prospecting tools (Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, or similar). Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and basic prompt engineering. Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech, ideally with an SDR/AE motion. Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production. Portuguese proficiency (not required, but useful across our MX/BR/CO/AR footprint). Where we work This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.Why Clara A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership. Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths. English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day. How we work Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters. Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be. Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait. Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver. ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning. Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara. text: Back to jobsEngineering DirectorMexico City / CMX / MexicoApplyClara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.We’re looking for an exceptional Engineering Director to help lead and scale our engineering organization as we build the next generation of financial technology that empowers and increases the competitiveness of Latin American organizations. This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong technical judgment, people leadership, platform and systems-scale thinking, and business acumen. You will lead multiple engineering teams, develop engineering leaders and IC builders, shape our technical strategy, and ensure we continue to increase our execution velocity while maintaining the reliability, security, and quality expected from a regulated fintech platform. You will also play an important role in how we leverage AI across our products and engineering organization, helping us identify opportunities to improve customer experiences, automate complex workflows, and increase engineering productivity. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a high-growth, fast-moving environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and can move naturally between strategy, technology, people, and direct execution. What you'll do Recruit, lead and scale engineering teams. Lead multiple teams building a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, speed, and technical excellence. Develop exceptional builders. Coach and grow senior engineers while strengthening our leadership pipeline and raising the talent bar across the organization. Shape our engineering strategy. Partner with Product and business leaders to translate company priorities into a clear technical strategy and engineering roadmap. Drive execution at scale. Ensure teams consistently deliver high-impact products while balancing speed, quality, reliability, and long-term technical investments. Raise the technical bar. Provide leadership across architecture, scalability, reliability, security, observability, and engineering practices. You won't need to be the primary individual contributor, but you should be technically deep enough to challenge assumptions and earn the trust of senior engineers. Build for fintech-grade reliability. Ensure our systems meet the security, availability, data integrity, and auditability expectations of a financial technology platform. Be at the cutting edge of AI-native. Identify and drive opportunities to leverage AI across our products and engineering workflows. Help establish strong practices around AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, reliability, and responsible deployment. Partner across the business. Work closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to make thoughtful decisions and translate technical trade-offs into clear business implications. Build for the next stage of growth. Anticipate technical and organizational bottlenecks and evolve our architecture, processes, and team structure before they become constraints. What we’re looking for 10+ years of software engineering experience and systems thinking, with significant experience building and operating complex production systems. 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, ideally recruiting and leading multiple teams in parallel. Proven experience building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations in fast-growing technology companies. Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, cloud architectures, APIs, microservices, data systems, and event-driven architectures. Experience designing and operating high-scale, highly available systems. Strong understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and engineering best practices translated to an AI-first approach. Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes. Demonstrated ability to attract, coach, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make thoughtful trade-offs, and adapt quickly as priorities evolve. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Professional fluency in English. Our current technology ecosystem includes Java/Spring Boot, React, relational and NoSQL databases, Kafka, REST APIs, AWS, Git/GitHub, and modern CI/CD tooling. You don't need to be an expert in every technology—we care more about your ability to lead teams building complex systems and make excellent technical decisions. AI experience You don't need to be an ML researcher, but you should understand how modern AI can be translated into reliable products and meaningful engineering leverage. Experience with LLMs, AI-powered products, agentic systems, AI evaluation, guardrails, or AI-assisted engineering workflows is highly valuable. Nice to have Experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, cards, expense management, or financial infrastructure. Experience building technology in regulated environments. Experience scaling engineering organizations through periods of rapid growth. Experience building or operating AI/ML-enabled products or platforms. Experience with fraud, risk, credit, decisioning, or automation systems. Spanish and/or Portuguese proficiency. Why this role matters Engineering is at the core of how we build and scale our business. As Engineering Director, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology, but also how our engineering organization operates, how we develop our people, and how we use AI to build better products and move faster. Your continued professional development is important to us because it’s important to you. Flexibility What does it mean to work at CircleCI? For us, flexibility is key. About CircleCI Engineering CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. About the Query Team Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it. The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing. What You'll Do Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. Shape how we store data at scale. Own and harden our ClickHouse-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production-scale data. Build the pipelines that move our data. Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it. Serve data to the product and to customers. Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant. Set technical direction. When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how. Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response. Keep things moving. You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too. You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through. What You'll Bring AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. Hands-on data experience. You've built or owned data-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event-driven architectures, or analytical and time-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus. Backend depth in Go. You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data. Distributed systems judgment. You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own. Technical leadership. You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. You leave foundations others can build on. You raise the quality bar through reviews, mentoring, and direct feedback, not just through the code you write. A track record of shipping. 5+ years building and operating production backend systems. Your work has served real users, and you've treated latency, reliability, and correctness as design concerns. Sound like you? You care about how data powers the product, not just where it lives. You know how to make a datastore fast at scale, and have tuned schemas and queries against real production load. You think like a platform engineer, measuring your work by how much it unblocks the teams building on it. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's a core part of how you approach and solve problems. If that sounds like you, we want to talk. text: Back to jobsEngineering DirectorSao Paulo / SP / BrazilApplyClara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.We’re looking for an exceptional Engineering Director to help lead and scale our engineering organization as we build the next generation of financial technology that empowers and increases the competitiveness of Latin American organizations. This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong technical judgment, people leadership, platform and systems-scale thinking, and business acumen. You will lead multiple engineering teams, develop engineering leaders and IC builders, shape our technical strategy, and ensure we continue to increase our execution velocity while maintaining the reliability, security, and quality expected from a regulated fintech platform. You will also play an important role in how we leverage AI across our products and engineering organization, helping us identify opportunities to improve customer experiences, automate complex workflows, and increase engineering productivity. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a high-growth, fast-moving environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and can move naturally between strategy, technology, people, and direct execution. What you'll do Recruit, lead and scale engineering teams. Lead multiple teams building a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, speed, and technical excellence. Develop exceptional builders. Coach and grow senior engineers while strengthening our leadership pipeline and raising the talent bar across the organization. Shape our engineering strategy. Partner with Product and business leaders to translate company priorities into a clear technical strategy and engineering roadmap. Drive execution at scale. Ensure teams consistently deliver high-impact products while balancing speed, quality, reliability, and long-term technical investments. Raise the technical bar. Provide leadership across architecture, scalability, reliability, security, observability, and engineering practices. You won't need to be the primary individual contributor, but you should be technically deep enough to challenge assumptions and earn the trust of senior engineers. Build for fintech-grade reliability. Ensure our systems meet the security, availability, data integrity, and auditability expectations of a financial technology platform. Be at the cutting edge of AI-native. Identify and drive opportunities to leverage AI across our products and engineering workflows. Help establish strong practices around AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, reliability, and responsible deployment. Partner across the business. Work closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to make thoughtful decisions and translate technical trade-offs into clear business implications. Build for the next stage of growth. Anticipate technical and organizational bottlenecks and evolve our architecture, processes, and team structure before they become constraints. What we’re looking for 10+ years of software engineering experience and systems thinking, with significant experience building and operating complex production systems. 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, ideally recruiting and leading multiple teams in parallel. Proven experience building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations in fast-growing technology companies. Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, cloud architectures, APIs, microservices, data systems, and event-driven architectures. Experience designing and operating high-scale, highly available systems. Strong understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and engineering best practices translated to an AI-first approach. Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes. Demonstrated ability to attract, coach, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make thoughtful trade-offs, and adapt quickly as priorities evolve. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Professional fluency in English. Our current technology ecosystem includes Java/Spring Boot, React, relational and NoSQL databases, Kafka, REST APIs, AWS, Git/GitHub, and modern CI/CD tooling. You don't need to be an expert in every technology—we care more about your ability to lead teams building complex systems and make excellent technical decisions. AI experience You don't need to be an ML researcher, but you should understand how modern AI can be translated into reliable products and meaningful engineering leverage. Experience with LLMs, AI-powered products, agentic systems, AI evaluation, guardrails, or AI-assisted engineering workflows is highly valuable. Nice to have Experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, cards, expense management, or financial infrastructure. Experience building technology in regulated environments. Experience scaling engineering organizations through periods of rapid growth. Experience building or operating AI/ML-enabled products or platforms. Experience with fraud, risk, credit, decisioning, or automation systems. Spanish and/or Portuguese proficiency. Why this role matters Engineering is at the core of how we build and scale our business. As Engineering Director, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology, but also how our engineering organization operates, how we develop our people, and how we use AI to build better products and move faster. text: Attention Protect yourself from fraudulent recruiters targeting CircleCI job seekers. Learn more Staff Software Engineer Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid Apply now Why CircleCI Great Benefits We prioritize the health and wellbeing of our employees through our comprehensive benefit package, including generous paid time off to rest and recharge, holistic mental health support, and benefits covering employees up to 100%. Growth At CircleCI, employees have ample opportunity to learn new skills, including project-based learning and presentations from our colleagues. Your continued professional development is important to us because it’s important to you. Flexibility What does it mean to work at CircleCI? For us, flexibility is key. About CircleCI Engineering CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. Team-Agnostic Placement We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day. What You'll Do Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. Own technical strategy for your domain. You decide when and how the architecture evolves, balancing technical debt against velocity. When a project spans teams, you're the one who breaks down the ambiguity and takes ownership of whether it lands. Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on. Own the full stack, at scale. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. Your ownership extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it. Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs. Champion observability. Drive monitoring and alerting strategy across your domain, not just your own services. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to reduce noise and improve the org's ability to diagnose problems quickly. Mentor at scale. Mentor multiple engineers at once. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own. What You'll Bring AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. A track record of shipping at scale. You've built and owned systems that other engineers build on. 8+ years of production full-stack experience, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes. Full-stack depth. Strong across the stack — React and TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, owning API design, data modeling, and service integration. System design, across domains. You own architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams. You make the tradeoff calls, document the reasoning, and are the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious. Business acumen. You understand how your domain connects to the broader business, and you use that context to guide technical decisions, not just implement them. Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship. Sound like you? You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk. The salary range listed reflects the wide geographic scope of this posting, as we hire across the United States and Canada. About CircleCI CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, ThresholdVentures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. Where we may use AI Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate. Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change. See where Apica landed → The Challenge The Telemetry Cost & Growth Crisis Observability budgets are at their breaking point and AI is about to make it exponentially worse. AI and ML workloads generate 10–100x more telemetry than traditional applications, driving observability costs to unsustainable levels. Legacy platforms charge for every byte ingested, forcing teams to either pay a platform tax or sacrifice visibility into critical systems. Cloud modernization and microservices architectures further multiply data volumes while budgets stay flat, pushing observability spend to an unsustainable level. This isn’t just a cost problem. It’s an architectural problem. Traditional platforms weren’t designed for AI-scale telemetry. They store everything indiscriminately and charge at every step. That model breaks when a single AI agent generates more telemetry in an hour than an entire app stack produced in a day. 54% of enterprises saw telemetry data triple in the past 12 months — average increase of 3.7× 9.5x expected average telemetry growth from agentic AI workloads within 2 years — 44% expect 6×–100× $3.17M average annual enterprise observability spend — growing 28% year-over-year with no natural ceiling Source: Apica + Omdia/Informa TechTarget Survey Report The Architecture Shift Be Agentic-Ready With Apica From Platform to Pipeline: Build telemetry infrastructure that powers AI, not platform costs. For 15+ years, teams treated telemetry pipelines as “dumb pipes” shoveling data into “smart platforms.” That collapses under AI. Agentic systems demand millisecond-level context. If intelligence lives only after storage and indexing, your costs spike first and your agents learn later. The Problem: Platform-Centric Thinking Data is ingested (charged), stored (charged), and indexed (charged) before you see value AI agents need real-time intelligence in milliseconds, not batch processing after storage Platform vendors optimize for their revenue, not your efficiency Scaling agentic workloads = 10x platform bill before generating value Apica Inverts This Model Process and enrich telemetry in the pipeline before expensive ingestion Route intelligently — send only what needs indexing to expensive platforms Store cost-efficiently in your data lake or ours (powered by InstaStore™) Real-time access for both human operators and AI agents Monitor multi-agent user journeys and automate testing continuously This isn’t about replacing your observability platform. It’s about taking control of what reaches it, when, and at what cost. Explore Apica Forge Apica Vanguard Safety Net Synthetic checks simulating real agent workflows end-to-end. Explore Apica Vanguard Apica Wayfinder Test-Data Engine Provision right-sized, compliant test data on demand for agentic journeys. Most enterprises haven’t budgeted for this reality. 02 — Driver Cloud Modernization Kubernetes and microservices multiply telemetry sources exponentially. Traditional tools weren’t designed for this cardinality. 03 — Driver Compliance Requirements Regulations demanding complete data retention conflict with platform pricing. The cost of compliance is becoming prohibitive. 04 — Driver Market Maturity CIOs and CTOs with large observability spend are reevaluating their entire approach based on cost of operations. “This is the tip of the iceberg. text: Back to jobsStaff Engineer (Ingeniero Staff) - Remote FirstBogota D.C. / DC / Colombia; Mexico City / CDMX / Mexico; Sao Paulo / SP / BrazilApplyClara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.We are looking for a Staff Engineer to provide senior individual-contributor technical leadership at Clara. This is an organization-level IC role: you shape architecture, raise engineering standards across pods, and multiply impact through design, code, and mentorship — not a people-manager position. The Role You are a builder and a technical authority beyond a single pod. You still write production code regularly, but your scope is cross-team: systems that span services, shared platforms, and hard technical bets that unlock multiple product areas. This is a builder's role first. You are expected to ship code, lead by example in reviews and design docs, and leave clearer systems behind you — not only facilitate meetings. What You Own Cross-team architecture — Drive system design for initiatives that cut across pods (APIs, data models, event flows, reliability patterns). Hold a high bar on coherence, operability, and long-term cost. Engineering excellence — Set and model standards for code quality, testing (TDD/BDD), observability, and secure design. Influence through RFCs, architecture reviews, and pairing — not through reporting lines. Technical strategy — Partner with Engineering Directors, Pod Leads, and Product on sequencing, tech debt, and platform investments. Make trade-offs explicit and documented. Mentorship & leveling-up — Grow Senior and Mid engineers via design reviews, deep pairing, and hiring signal. You provide strong input on technical fit; managers own career and performance outcomes. Incident and reliability leadership — Lead or co-lead response and remediation for high-severity incidents on systems you influence; drive durable fixes, not band-aids. Hands-on delivery — Author meaningful PRs. Staff at Clara is not an architecture-only title. What You Don't Own 1:1s, performance ratings, compensation, or PIPs — those belong to Engineering Managers / Directors. Day-to-day sprint facilitation for a single pod (unless temporarily embedded); Pod Engineering Leads own pod execution rhythm. Technical Skills 8+ years of professional software engineering, including substantial time as a Senior / Lead IC on complex systems. Deep expertise in at least one of: Backend: Java (Spring / Spring Boot), microservices, scalable system design, PostgreSQL/MySQL and NoSQL data modeling, event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar), REST APIs, AWS, containers (Docker/Kubernetes). Frontend: Production React + TypeScript at scale, component architecture, performance, testing (Jest, RTL, Cypress/Playwright), build/CI tooling. Ability to work and reason full-stack even if your depth is on one side: read the whole path from data model to API to UI. Proven experience designing for high availability, security, and operability in production. Strong testing culture (unit, integration, contract) and familiarity with CI/CD (GitHub Actions). Track record of written technical design that non-authors can challenge and execute against. Soft Skills Demonstrated influence without formal authority — across teams and stakeholders. Clear communication of trade-offs to Product, Design, and leadership. Product mindset: you engage roadmaps and feasibility, not only tickets. Intellectual honesty: change direction when evidence demands it. Mentorship instincts; you leave teams stronger than you found them. Strong English; Spanish is a plus for LATAM collaboration. Nice-to-Have Experience in financial applications, payments, or regulated LATAM markets. Prior Staff / Principal / Staff-equivalent title, or org-wide Tech Lead scope. Platform or developer-experience investments (shared libraries, internal tools, AI-assisted engineering workflows). Deep AWS (EKS, RDS, MSK, etc.) or security posture work (auth, supply chain). Where we work This is a remote-first role: you'll work from home day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.Why Clara A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership. Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths. English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day. How we work Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters. Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be. Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait. Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver. ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning. Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara. text: [Job-32029] MidLevel Developer Full Stack AEM [Adobe Experience Manager], BrazilBrazilGU1 – Prod_GU1 /Homeoffice /RemoteApply for this job Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions. Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias. Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente. A squad de Web Marketing é responsável pelas propriedades digitais do banco — sites institucionais, landing pages de campanha, hubs de conteúdo e páginas de produto. Construímos e evoluímos essas experiências sobre o Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), com forte integração ao ecossistema de marketing (Analytics, Target, Marketing Cloud) e às APIs internas. Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora full stack pleno com especialização em Front-End, que goste de transformar design em interface performática, acessível e pixel-perfect — mas que também seja autônoma para criar componentes, templates e integrações no backend do AEM sem depender de terceiros. Aqui você é dona da ponta a ponta: do HTL e do componente no dialog até o comportamento em runtime, a integração com a API e a entrega em produção passando pelo quality gate. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir componentes, templates e Content Fragments no AEM (Sites), garantindo autonomia de edição para os times de marketing. Implementar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis a partir de layouts do Figma, com atenção a detalhe visual, cross-browser e mobile-first. Otimizar performance web e Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP): lazy loading, otimização de imagens, critical CSS e redução de JS. Manter e expandir o Design System/biblioteca de componentes da squad, promovendo reuso e consistência visual. Construir integrações backend no AEM: servlets, Sling Models, workflows, schedulers e consumo/exposição de APIs REST. Implementar e validar tagueamento e tracking (Adobe Analytics/GTM/dataLayer) em conjunto com o time de marketing e dados. Apoiar campanhas e ativações: criação ágil de landing pages, testes A/B e personalização. Participar de code review, versionamento (Git) e do pipeline de CI/CD (Cloud Manager) entre ambientes (dev/stage/prod). Atuar no ciclo ágil da squad (refinamento, planning, dailys), junto a PO, UX e marketing. Requisitos para este desafio: AEM: Experiência com AEM as a Cloud Service e Cloud Manager. Desenvolvimento de componentes AEM com HTL/Sightly e dialog de autoria (Granite/Coral UI), incluindo Sling Models para expor dados ao HTL. Domínio da estrutura de projeto do AEM Project Archetype e dos módulos Maven (ui.config, core, ui.frontend), com build via Maven. Front-End: Domínio sólido de HTML5 semântico, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, SASS/LESS), JavaScript moderno (ES6+) e TypeScript. Experiência comprovada com layout responsivo, cross-browser e fidelidade ao design. Conhecimento de acessibilidade (WCAG) e boas práticas de SEO técnico. Experiência prática com otimização de performance e Core Web Vitals. Familiaridade com ao menos um framework/lib moderno (React ou Angular). Versionamento com Git e fluxo de branches/code review. AEM / Back-End: Experiência prática com AEM as a Cloud Service: desenvolvimento de componentes, HTL (Sightly), Sling Models, dialogs, editable templates e Core Components. Conhecimento de Java aplicado ao AEM (OSGi, Sling, JCR). Noções de Maven, AEM Archetype e estrutura de projeto AEM. Entendimento de arquitetura author/publish, dispatcher e cache. Consumo e criação de APIs REST/JSON. Comportamental: Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de marketing em solução técnica. Autonomia, senso de dono e organização para lidar com múltiplas campanhas em paralelo. Colaboração próxima com UX/Design e áreas de negócio. [Opcional] Diferenciais: Certificação Adobe Certified Expert — AEM Sites Developer. Familiaridade com o build front-end integrado ao AEM (módulo ui.frontend com Webpack) e com geração/entrega de client libraries. Vivência com Adobe Experience Cloud: Analytics, Target, Launch, Campaign/Marketing Cloud. Conhecimento de AEM Headless/SPA Editor e arquitetura headless. title: Change your life with ClickUp
text: Change your life with ClickUpAt ClickUp, you'll work with exceptional people solving challenging problems that save customers time, the world's most valuable resource. Ready to do the best work of your career?Browse open positionsTrusted by the BESTOur mission.Maximize human productivity.We started ClickUp because the way the world works is broken. Teams juggle dozens of disconnected tools - tasks in one place, conversations in another, documents somewhere else - and critical context gets lost in between. We always knew there had to be a better way. So we built one platform to replace them all. While others scramble to bundle fragmented tools or bolt on AI as an afterthought, we've been building toward convergence from the start.Today, we're at the most exciting inflection point in the history of software: the convergence of software, AI, and humans. For the first time, technology doesn't just organize your work - it understands it, anticipates it, and acts on it. ClickUp is where this convergence lives. Where humans and AI work side by side, in one place, with full context - and where every team can finally focus on the work that actually matters.Millions of teams around the world already rely on ClickUp to power all of their work. We're laser-focused on removing the busywork from work - the constant toggling, the misalignment, the lost context that drains productivity every single day. We envision a world where work feels effortlessly organized, contagiously creative, and endlessly efficient.Our mission is clear: maximize human productivity. Not by making people work harder, but by fundamentally reinventing how work gets done - through the convergence of everything.See our FAQsOur perfect-fitWho we're looking forClickUp was born from a culture of grit, learning, and breaking the status quo. We hire based on three things:Join the teamGrowthYou strive to outdo yesterday's version of yourself, embracing challenges, moving fast, and learning even faster.PassionYou bring energy and bold ideas, inspiring those around you and fueling our shared mission with genuine enthusiasm.Hard WorkYou roll up your sleeves, take ownership of tough problems, and turn ideas into reality.What Drives UsThe ClickUp platform isn't just our product—it's the backbone of how we work as a company. You don't need to be an engineer or product manager to dive deep into leveraging AI or the product in innovative ways. We empower every team to contribute their expertise, shaping the tools we deliver to customers and use ourselves. Here, you'll have the chance to learn, innovate, and lead at the forefront of AI, surrounded by a team of driven, brilliant individuals determined to transform how the world works.At ClickUp, we assess every candidate based on the potential impact they can have. We hire the best people for the job and support each person's journey to build their boldest career.ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.Featured rolesTwo roles that will define our next chapterRare, executive roles reporting directly to the CEO.Executive · Apply with video100x Operator,Chief Of StaffThe force multiplier that keeps the CEO in every detail while making the leadership team faster.Reports directly to the CEOExplore the roleExecutive · Apply with video100x Marketer,Chief Marketing OfficerOne person. The entire brand marketing engine of a $4B company.Reports directly to the CEOExplore the roleOpen positionsBe part of something greatLove your work. Join your dream team.Perks & benefitsClickUp perks and benefitsLove your work. Join your dream team.Join the teamGenerous PTOPersonal growthRetirementRemote workHealth plansWellnessParental leaveRecognitionOur core valuesNormal f*cking sucks#SCRAPPYChallenge the norms, push the boundaries#GREATNESSEmbrace hard work, do hard things#RESILIENCYDrive urgency#URGENCYGrow 1% every day#GROWTHMINDSETOur core valuesBe fun to work with#FUNBe in the details#DETAILSMATTERStay hungry#HARDWORKDeliver the best customer experience#BESTCXSay what you mean, mean what you say#BEDIRECTAbout ClickUpWhat is ClickUp's mission?To maximize human productivity. We started ClickUp because the way the world works is broken: teams juggle dozens of disconnected tools that slow them down. We built one converged platform to replace them all. Today, we're at the inflection point where software, AI, and humans come together, and our mission is to fundamentally reinvent how work gets done, not by making people work harder, but through the convergence of everything.What's ClickUp's financial health / is the company stable?ClickUp is one of the fastest-growing companies in SaaS. We surpassed $300M+ in annual recurring revenue and serve 20M+ users worldwide, with 800K+ new team signups every month. We're backed by $535M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global, and others.AI is where things get interesting: 400%+ AI sales growth year-to-date, AI usage up 800% YoY, and deals that include AI are 7× larger on average. Over 50% of our customers already use 5+ ClickUp apps, which means people aren't just trying us, they're consolidating their entire stack here.ClickUp is the world's first Converged AI Workspace, bringing together all work apps, data, and workflows. ClickUp eliminates all forms of work sprawl to provide 100% context and a single place for humans and agents to work, together.What is ClickUp's culture like?We're a product-led company that ships fast and iterates constantly. Our culture values ownership, speed, and craftsmanship. Teams are lean and cross-functional, which means individuals have outsized impact. We run on transparency, where company metrics, strategy, and decisions are shared openly.Working at ClickUpIs ClickUp remote-friendly?Yes. ClickUp has team members across multiple countries, and our work model varies by role and location. Some teams are fully remote, while others follow a hybrid schedule with in-office days. Specific expectations are noted in each job posting so you'll know upfront what applies. Regardless of model, we lean heavily on async collaboration through our own product and invest in meaningful in-person experiences.Where are ClickUp's offices?ClickUp is headquartered in San Diego, California, with a European HQ in Dublin, Ireland. We also have offices in San Francisco, California and London, United Kingdom, among other locations. Any hybrid or location requirements are noted in the job posting. We offer a co-working program for remote employees who want access to flexible workspace near them.What is work-life balance like at ClickUp?We're a high-growth company that values hard work and impact, and we're transparent about that. At the same time, we prioritize flexibility and trust our team to manage their time effectively. Our engagement surveys consistently show that employees feel supported by their managers, whether it's for personal appointments or family commitments. We also have initiatives like surprise wellness days to encourage balance and recharge.What benefits does ClickUp offer?ClickUp offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the whole person. Our core benefits include: comprehensive health plans, retirement savings, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, an enhanced employee assistance program (EAP), an employee wellness stipend, a professional development stipend, remote work flexibility, company-wide wellness days, and employee recognition programs. Benefits vary by location, and your recruiter can share the full details for your region during the interview process.Does ClickUp support career growth and development?Yes. One of our core values is 'Grow 1%', and we invest in growth at all levels. ClickUp offers an annual professional development stipend for courses, certifications, and conferences; an LMS with Harvard Business courses and accredited continuing education; and a leadership program for aspiring and current leaders. Every role sits on a clear career pathway with defined level expectations for both IC and management tracks, and internal mobility is actively encouraged. Some of our most successful crew members started as front-line representatives and are now product managers, leaders, and so much more!What tech stack does ClickUp use?TypeScript, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and AWS. Our mobile apps are built with Flutter. Engineers work on real-scale problems: our platform serves 20M+ users globally.How does ClickUp approach diversity, equity, and inclusion?ClickUp is committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We support employee-led community groups (Employee Growth Groups) focused on mentorship, networking, and professional development, each with executive sponsorship and open to all as members or allies. Our recruiting practices are designed to be inclusive from first touchpoint through offer, and we continuously evaluate our processes to reduce bias and broaden access.Applying to ClickUpWhat is the interview process at ClickUp?Our interview process varies by team and role, but typically includes a recruiter screen, a hiring manager conversation, a skills-based assessment, and team conversations (either a panel or a series of 1:1s). Your recruiter will walk you through the specific steps and timeline for your process upfront.Can I apply for multiple roles at the same time?Yes, you're welcome to apply to more than one role. However, we recommend a targeted approach. A few well-matched applications carry far more weight than a high volume of generic ones, so focus on the positions that genuinely align with your skills and experience, and tailor each application accordingly. Once you apply, your profile is in our system, and our talent team may reach out if we spot a great fit for you down the line.Can I reapply after being rejected, and how long should I wait?Yes, you can reapply. We ask that you wait at least six months before reapplying to the same role, which gives you time to build new skills or experience. In the meantime, you're welcome to explore and apply to different roles at any time.Does ClickUp offer internships or early-career programs?We do not currently offer a formal internship program. However, we hire for entry-level and early-career roles across multiple teams. We recommend keeping an eye on our open positions and applying when you see a role that matches your skills and interests.Do I need work authorization for my position?Yes, candidates are required to have work authorization for the country they are applying for.Does ClickUp offer visa sponsorship?ClickUp is able to consider visa sponsorship for engineering and product roles on a case-by-case basis, depending on business needs for the specific position. We are typically unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. If you have questions about a specific role's eligibility, your recruiter can clarify early in the process.How do I request accommodations during the interview process?We're committed to providing an accessible and equitable interview experience for all candidates. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.
