We highly recommend everyone remove Slack and email from their devices so they can unplug, relax, and recharge. Work to live, not live to workWe rarely put in more than 40 hours per week. There may be times during a launch or event that people work extra hours, but we encourage them to take more time off later so it balances out. Free to roamWe’ve been a fully distributed team since 2015. Job Location: HerediaLocation Flexibility: Multiple Locations in CountryReq Id: 13005Posting Start Date: 10/6/26At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).Senior Python and Kafka EngineerEvent-Driven Systems, Observability and Data LineagePosition SummaryWe are seeking a hands-on Senior Python and Kafka Engineer to join an established engineering team supporting a correctness-critical, event-driven digital repository processing platform.The platform performs downstream processing after digital objects have been deposited and archived. Its services create persistent identifiers, update operational metadata and search stores, generate viewable and streamable derivatives, distribute content to image, media and full-text services, and notify depositors. The pipeline is event-driven, with an initial archival event being processed by multiple independent services that publish and consume subsequent events.The successful candidate will work directly within the existing team to improve structured logging, end-to-end event visibility, reconciliation, completion verification, and Kafka delivery reliability. This is an implementation-focused engineering position. The architecture is owned internally, and the selected engineer will build enhancements into a live system rather than redesigning or replacing it.Key Responsibilities Implement a consistent structured JSON logging standard across Python services, including standardized fields, logging levels, contextual information, and actionable failure details.Improve Kafka producer and consumer reliability, with particular attention to:Offset commit behaviorConsumer-group stability and rebalancingRetry processingDead-letter topic handlingMessage-loss investigationDuplicate-processing and idempotency considerationsInstrument distributed services to provide greater visibility into how individual digital objects move through the processing pipeline.Implement or contribute to an event-lineage capability that records:The processing stages an object passed throughThe order in which stages occurredThe outcome of each stageWhere processing stopped or failedDevelop reconciliation and completion-tracking capabilities that compare expected workflow stages with recorded events.Help produce an actionable completion verdict for processed objects, including the ability to identify incomplete processing and support alerting or delivery holds.Implement telemetry using OpenTelemetry and contribute to an OpenLineage-based lineage solution, with Marquez currently identified as the leading implementation option.Develop and maintain Python services that interact with Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, object storage, and external APIs.Work with shared internal Python packages that provide message-envelope models, Kafka producer and consumer wrappers, retry and dead-letter handling, shared-state storage, and operational-metadata access.Write automated tests and support safe delivery through the existing Kubernetes, Kustomize, and ArgoCD environment.Troubleshoot complex distributed-processing issues across services, messages, data stores, and external dependencies.Pair closely with the internal engineer leading this work and contribute directly to implementation, testing, technical documentation, and operational readiness.The principal areas of work are structured logging, event lineage and tracking, reconciliation and completion verification, and Kafka delivery semantics.Required QualificationsCandidates should have strong, production-level experience in all four of the following areas:Apache KafkaSignificant hands-on experience operating or developing Kafka-based production applications.Deep understanding of producer and consumer delivery semantics.Experience with Kafka offsets, commit strategies, consumer groups, partition assignment, and rebalancing.Demonstrated ability to diagnose missing, delayed, duplicated, or repeatedly retried messages.Practical experience implementing retry and dead-letter processing patterns.PythonAdvanced Python software-engineering experience.Strong understanding of concurrency, threading, and runtime behavior.Experience building and supporting production services and shared Python libraries.Ability to write maintainable, testable, and operationally supportable code.Observability and Structured LoggingExperience defining and implementing structured logging standards, not only configuring logging products.Ability to establish consistent log fields, severity levels, correlation information, error context, and diagnostic detail.Understanding of observability practices for distributed and event-driven systems.PostgreSQLStrong working knowledge of PostgreSQL.Experience using PostgreSQL JSON capabilities.Ability to design and query operational, tracking, or event-related data structures.These four capabilities are the primary qualification bar for the role. The source brief specifically notes that candidates are not expected to possess every technology listed in the environment.Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry.Experience with OpenLineage, Marquez, or comparable data-lineage and event-lineage solutions.Working knowledge of Kubernetes sufficient to deploy, troubleshoot, and operate applications in a Kustomize and ArgoCD environment.Experience using Grafana and Grafana Loki, or equivalent metrics, dashboarding, and log-management platforms.Strong understanding of event-driven architecture patterns, including:Idempotent processingExactly-once delivery concernsAt-least-once processing implicationsTransactional boundaries between a datastore and a message busFailure recovery in distributed workflowsThe environment values OpenTelemetry, lineage tooling, Kubernetes, Grafana/Loki, and practical knowledge of event-driven architecture, but does not require deep Kubernetes platform-engineering expertise.Additional Relevant ExperienceExperience with one or more of the following would be beneficial but is not required:MongoDBApache SolrAWS S3 or other S3-compatible object storageIstioAWS Secrets ManagerExternal Secrets OperatorAWS EFS and NFS-based shared storageImage or video processing pipelinesDigital asset, library, archive, or repository platformsApache Airflow and PgBouncerTypeScript or Node.jsMongoDB, Solr, S3-compatible storage, Istio, and image or video processing are identified as useful rather than required capabilitiesRelocation Supported:Visa Sponsorship ApprovedAt Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences. title: Fraudio
text: Fraudio Financiële diensten AI-driven risk and compliance platform for PSPs, acquirers and issuers Volgen Alle 31 medewerkers weergeven Dit bedrijf melden Over ons Fraudio delivers risk intelligence for PSPs, acquirers and issuers, connecting signals across acquiring and issuing to detect payment fraud earlier, reduce false positives and ensure compliance with card scheme and regulatory requirements across the full payments lifecycle. Website http://www.fraudio.com Externe link voor Fraudio Branche Financiële diensten Bedrijfsgrootte 11 - 50 medewerkers Type Particuliere onderneming Opgericht 2019 Geen vorige content meer Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-witwassoftware (AML) Anti-Money Laundering Anti-witwassoftware (AML) Merchant Initiated Fraud Detection, Software voor fraudebescherming Merchant Initiated Fraud Detection Software voor fraudebescherming Payment Fraud Detection, Software voor fraudebescherming Payment Fraud Detection Software voor fraudebescherming Geen volgende content meer Medewerkers van Fraudio João Moura Hugo Damásio Jonas Ahrendt Rodrigo Vilarino Alle medewerkers weergeven Updates Fraudio 9.903 volgers 14 u Deze bijdrage melden We believe that moving to machine learning doesn't mean switching off your rules engine. Rules are still the right tool for hard policy: sanctions blocks, regulatory limits, merchant category restrictions and card scheme requirements. They're fast, explainable and easy to audit. The strongest setups run rules first for policy, then let models score every payment that passes. Over time, model output shows which rules no longer add anything, so the rule set shrinks instead of growing into thousands of conditions no one wants to touch. That's how Fraudio works: → Rules fire first, then supervised and unsupervised models score every payment from 0 to 1 → New rules deploy instantly, with no per-rule charge → Pre-trained models and a rules library protect you from the first transaction → Integration takes 3 to 14 days, and Fraudio can run alongside your existing engine while you compare results Talk to us about moving beyond rules: https://lnkd.in/dbgsgZ55 #FraudPrevention #RulesEngine #MachineLearning #Acquiring #Fintech #FightFraudSmarter 5 Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 1 d Deze bijdrage melden Robin Vastenou will be at ICAIF - ACM International Conference on AI in Finance '26 Workshop on Financial Security, Safety and Privacy. 15 November, Bocconi University, Milan 📍 He will be presenting our paper: "Learning Transaction Context Without Labels". Three things worth asking him about: - how a model learns from transactions that won't have a fraud label for weeks - what changes when you rank models by review cost instead of PR-AUC - how to price the effort a fraudster needs to game a model. If you work on fraud, payments risk or adversarial ML and you're at ICAIF, come and find him. Not going? Drop a comment and we'll pick up the conversation here. #FightFraudSmarter #ICAIF2026 #FraudDetection #Payments #MachineLearning 12 Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 6 d Deze bijdrage melden Making the world a better place, one action at a time. João Moura 1 w Pretty cool project by tree-nation that we joined today. If you're a client or partner, you can expect a little gift from us at some point! Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 6 d Deze bijdrage melden Around 3% of digitally onboarded SMEs are fraudsters. Some of them get through onboarding checks, because their documents, website and MCC look legitimate at the time they apply. Chargebacks arrive weeks after the transactions behind them, so a merchant's dispute or fraud ratio can climb for some time before anyone notices. When that ratio goes over a Visa VAMP or Mastercard programme threshold, the acquirer often hears about it from the card scheme first. By then, fines may already apply and the merchant is under formal review. Catching it earlier means tracking how each merchant behaves over time, rather than reviewing transactions one by one. At Fraudio, we monitor every merchant and sub-merchant in a portfolio, all the time. It gives each one a risk score and sends an alert while the ratio is still rising, well before it reaches the scheme threshold. That early alert gives the risk team time to contact the merchant, change its limits or start offboarding before a scheme programme is involved. See how Fraudio's merchant monitoring works: https://lnkd.in/dA-zGAFb #MerchantMonitoring #Acquiring #Payments #VAMP #FraudPrevention #FightFraudSmarter 6 Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 1 w Deze bijdrage melden Most fraud models are tested as if the label arrives with the transaction. On the portfolio we studied, only half of confirmed frauds were known a month later. That gap is where our paper starts. "Learning Transaction Context Without Labels" has been accepted at the ICAIF - ACM International Conference on AI in Finance '26 Workshop on Financial Security, Safety and Privacy in Milan. We tested self-supervised learning on card transaction sequences under the constraints a payments team actually works with: labels that arrive late, limited review capacity, and fraudsters who adapt. What we found: — Learning from unlabelled transaction history beat an identical supervised network by 44% PR-AUC. The months you can't label yet still make the model better. — Priced at realistic review costs, it returned 2.2× the net value. — The context window that scores best is also the cheapest for a fraudster to evade. We'll be in Milan in November. If you're attending, let's talk 📍 #FightFraudSmarter #FraudDetection #MachineLearning #Payments #ICAIF2026 8 Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 4 w Deze bijdrage melden Most banking fraud programmes still put the hard work at the door. Identity check passes, account opens, and the team moves on. The loss usually lands later. APP scams are the sharp version of this. The customer authorises the transfer themselves, so card rules and account-status checks see a valid payment. Instant rails settle in seconds, and end-of-day reporting only confirms the money is gone. What we keep seeing is that the receiving side carries the real signal. Funds arrive from many sources and leave just as fast. One bank watching only its own history misses the mule network sitting across institutions. The centralized view is what surfaces that pattern. Less about stronger KYC in isolation and more about watching behaviour after the customer is already inside. Practical guide for issuers, acquirers, and digital banks: https://lnkd.in/dWJKAeAy #payments #banking #fraudprevention 6 Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 1 mnd Deze bijdrage melden Marketplaces do not lose to fraud the same way a single store does. On a storefront, a false decline costs you one sale. On a marketplace, blocking a good seller removes supply, and blocking a good buyer removes demand. Fraud controls sit on top of the liquidity that keeps both sides coming back. The loss side is climbing too. Juniper Research puts merchant losses from online payment fraud above $362 billion between 2023 and 2028. LexisNexis puts the true cost at $4.61 for every $1 of fraud once fees, replacement goods, and lost sales are counted. On a marketplace, that bill often lands on an honest seller who already shipped. What we keep seeing is that checkout filters alone were built for one side of the problem. Fraud enters at onboarding, listing, checkout, payout, and post-transaction. A control that only reads the payment sees maybe two of those five. So the job is less about blocking harder and more about scoring both sides with enough precision that good sellers and buyers keep moving. Curious if other marketplace operators feel the same pressure on false positives as on fraud rate? link to our article: https://lnkd.in/d43qjq_d #payments #marketplacefraud #fraudprevention C2PA-gegevens weergeven 6 Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 1 mnd Deze bijdrage melden Instant payment rails settle in seconds. That is the timing constraint fraud teams actually work under in 2026. The authorization window is usually well under a second. Scoring has to land inside it, or the decision arrives after the money has already moved. Real-time prevention is that race: enrich, score, approve, challenge, or block before settlement commits. What we keep seeing is that speed without context just moves the pain. A fast decline on a good customer costs more than the fraud you thought you stopped. Batch still has a job here too. Portfolio sweeps, model tuning, and trend work need a slower pass. They do not replace the live decision; they feed it. The accuracy multiplier is shared network data. A card, device, or mule pattern that already showed up elsewhere should not look “first-seen” on your side. That is what the centralized view is for: sub-second decisions with a wider memory than one company alone can build. We wrote the full walkthrough here: https://lnkd.in/dH5K98tA Curious how others are splitting live scoring vs batch in their stack right now? #payments #fraudprevention #fintech C2PA-gegevens weergeven 4 1 commentaar Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 1 mnd Deze bijdrage melden The outdated assumption in small-business fraud prevention is that serious AI detection only arrives with an enterprise budget and a year-long integration. For early payment companies, that assumption is expensive. The moment you process for merchants, or pick up an EMI-style license, monitoring stops being optional. A rules-only setup buys time, then hits a wall: novel patterns slip through, false positives climb, and your own data is too thin to train a strong model from scratch. The access equation has shifted. Pay-per-use, no setup fees, and an API that lands in days rather than 5 to 14 months means the bottleneck is no longer “can we afford the platform.” It is whether the model can see beyond your walls. A siloed model only learns what one customer sees. A centralized, network-effect model brings patterns already observed across connected institutions, so small books are not flying blind on day one. That is the Plug and Protect idea in practice: connect once, protect the portfolio, scale cost with volume. Curious how others at the early PSP / PayFac stage are sequencing this: internal controls first, then monitoring, or monitoring the day processing starts? #payments #frauddetection #PayFac C2PA-gegevens weergeven 5 1 commentaar Interessant Commentaar Delen Fraudio 9.903 volgers 1 mnd Bewerkt Deze bijdrage melden Our CEO João Moura with Entrepreneur Middle East, from Money20/20 Middle East. His take on fraud at scale, and why transaction-by-transaction defence is no longer enough Fraud is operating as a network. Detection has to connect the same way. Interview below. #payments #paymentfraud #Money2020 Entrepreneur Middle East 90.581 volgers 1 mnd Fraud is no longer happening one transaction at a time. Increasingly, it is operating at scale. At Money20/20 Middle East, Entrepreneur Middle East spoke with João Moura, Founder and CEO of Fraudio, about how fraudsters are using increasingly sophisticated tools to operate across payment methods, borders, identities, and merchant accounts, and why fraud prevention needs to evolve with them. Moura, who holds a PhD in AI and has worked with the technology for more than 20 years, argues that looking at transactions in isolation is no longer enough. The industry needs to connect signals across people, cards, merchants, accounts and devices, using behavioural analytics to understand the wider context in real time. title: Careers at Geckoboard
text: Careers at GeckoboardAt Geckoboard, we’re motivated by a desire to build innovative products and create five-star customer experiences.See opportunitiesLife at GeckoboardWhen we started Geckoboard, not only did we want to build a product customers love, we also wanted to create a company people actually want to work for. For us that means a place where we try our best, together, to build something genuinely useful.Every new hire shapes our future company, and that’s why we care so much about bringing in great people. We’re always looking for people from diverse backgrounds with unique perspectives and skills to join our team.How do we work?At Geckoboard, we’re motivated by a desire to build innovative products and create five-star customer experiences. It’s a working environment built on trust, where passionate, talented, thoughtful people thrive.We’re not a large, box-ticking organization that creates process for the sake of it. And we’re also not a hyper-growth startup working towards chaotic, unrealistic deadlines. Working for Geckoboard is simply about playing to all our different strengths and focusing on the areas that we know will make an impact.Where do we work?We’re a global team of 30+ people. Most people at Geckoboard choose to work remotely, however, we do have a small office in Shoreditch, London, for those who want a change of scenery or for when it’s useful to meet face to face.Read our reviews →Read our reviews →Our benefitsLife firstWe don’t talk much about work-life balance because we believe life, health and family come first. We never ask anyone to work overtime and we encourage everyone to fully disconnect from work when out-of-hours or on annual leave. Our leave policy is designed so you can take all the holiday you need (we see 25 days annual leave + bank holidays as the minimum). Some of us work part-time and everyone is free to work flexible hours to fit around their family and personal commitments. Plus, enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption policies are there to support you when your life changes.CommunityOur everyday working style is underpinned by openness, teamwork, and a strong sense of community. The whole company meets up online once a month to share what each team is working on and understand how the business is performing overall. We also host regular socials online and in-person. This has included everything from guided meditation to cookery club, from cheese-tasting to life-drawing.DevelopmentGrowing as a business is as important to us as growing as individuals. Your development is guided by our progression frameworks, continuous feedback and regular one-to-ones with your team lead. You’re also equipped with your own development budget to spend however you choose.InvestmentYou’re helping us grow, so we want to make sure you’re part of our business and our journey for the long term. We offer share options, review your salary annually, and will set you up with equipment of your choice so you can work at your best.InnovationInnovation and experimentation are an important part of life at Geckoboard. Everyone can take lab days once a fortnight to work on their own projects.Open positionsExplore our open positions below and see if anything takes your fancy. If nothing does, but you still want to say hi and tell us about yourself or you’ve got questions about a role, get in touch.Contact our people team

title: Let's Go Beyond your Potential_
text: Let's Go Beyond your Potential_At GFT Technologies, we provide a supportive environment where you can unleash your strengths and bring your best ideas to life. So, seize the opportunity to create value in your unique way.Find Your Job What Makes Us Unique20+ CountriesWe are a global team with diverse backgrounds working together in numerous locations worldwide. With over 12,000 talented individuals, we are a powerhouse of creativity and innovation, and we take pride in being recognized as a Great Place to Work. Growth OpportunitiesWe work on meaningful projects and make a real impact, allowing you to collaborate with top-notch professionals in our industry. This perfect blend of skill and opportunity has proven to be a winning formula, resulting in significant professional growth. 1 TeamAs a global company, GFT fosters a culture of innovation, collaboration, and diversity. We aim to ensure all employees can thrive and reach their full potential while working with state-of-the-art offerings and technologies. Important Recruitment Scam alertProtect yourself from recruitment scamsThank you for your interest in GFT. Please be aware of potential recruitment scams. Whilst we encourage you to explore job opportunities at our company, we also urge you to be cautious and wary of recruitment scams. All GFT job postings are shared only on our official website and trusted platforms. Please keep in mind: We will never ask for payment at any stage of our recruitment process. Official communications come only from verified GFT email addresses (@gft.com). Avoid sharing personal information with non-official accounts (in doubts, please check the real email address behind the displayed naming). If you have any concerns, please verify with our local recruiting teams via our official channels. Please be cautious to the points above as you progress in your job search. Your Career at GFT – Our Entry LevelsStudentsGain experience during your studies and insights into real software solutions. Work on exciting projects, develop your skills, and benefit from our professional development programs, continuous learning, and global network. GraduatesStep into the IT industry with challenging projects that build your skills and confidence. Join an inspiring team and take advantage of mentoring and training to accelerate your growth. ProfessionalsExpand your expertise, work on international projects, and take your career to the next level. Opportunities range from technical leadership to strategic project delivery — with the option to move into executive roles. Executive LeadersSet the course for success through effective strategies, innovation, and collaboration. Our executive leadership team is committed to achieving exceptional results while fostering a thriving environment. Access exclusive programs, global networking, and leadership development opportunities. Working at GFTAt GFT, diversity, equality, and inclusion are at the core of who we are because we care. Our core values foster a workplace environment where all employees can be themselves and feel proud to share their unique backgrounds. We support growth and development, providing our team members with all the tools and resources they need to succeed, because when you succeed, we all succeed as one team. We're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work, and we're excited to welcome new talent who share our values and are ready to grow and thrive with us.BenefitsFind out what benefits are available to our employees in each country.Personal DevelopmentRead more about how we enable individual growth.Culture and ValuesLearn more about the corporate culture at GFT.Personal DevelopmentRead more about how we enable individual growth.Discover your job familyCorporateOur corporate teams consistent of HR, Marketing, Finance, Operations, IT and Legal contribute to overall business performance through their expertise and business partnership. SalesCommitted professionals with strong work ethic and customer-centric mindset. Our sales teams are skilled in negotiating, influencing, and successfully translating client needs into practical solutions alongside our strong team of engineers. Bussiness ConsultingSpecialists with a high level of knowledge and deep understanding of the technology industry and market trends. Client-facing individuals who contribute to profitable sales and delivery strategies through solid consulting expertise. EngineeringOur experts are responsible for building, maintaining, and testing solutions for our clients. Engineering incorporates our high-performing teams of architects, developers, Cloud and DevOps Engineers, Testers, Mainframe, Data, and Product Specialists. Project ManagementProject Governance and AMS teams are engaged in the successful implementation of application solutions for GFT clients. They are accountable for managing large service projects and project resources at a senior level. Get Prepared for Your JobFind your JobApart from technical skills, our team is Caring, Collaborative, Creative, Courageous and Committed and live up to our core values. The way we treat each other and our clients is just as critical to our success as it is the way we apply our knowledge and exercise our competencies. ApplyWe are excited to see you are interested in beginning a career with us! Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and schedule an initial chat to discuss your aspirations and goals. If we are a match, the idea is not only to offer you a role, but a career! Be prepared to share all relevant information about yourself. InterviewLearn some basics about GFT before your interview and be ready to talk about your motivation to work at GFT. Also, be prepared to share all relevant details about previous work experiences, knowledge, career goals and how it all connects with your desired job. Some interviews can take place remotely. Find a quiet place, check all technical details and simply be yourself – being authentic is always best! Get a Job OfferCongratulations, you've made it. Welcome to #teamGFT! We will discuss the details of your job with you, such as the start date or your salary. Our HR department will also give you a lot of information about your job before you start. Start your JobOnce you join, our next most critical phase is welcoming you to the team and making you feel part of it from day one! The onboarding process is a detailed 90-day journey from receiving your equipment and getting you set up to succeed, to meeting all stakeholders and team members who will work with you to get acclimated and ready. Looking forward to it! Any questions?What is the application process?Our application process is simple and straightforward. To apply for the position, please visit jobs.gft.com, select your country and navigate through the open positions. Click on the specific job opening you are interested in and check the job description carefully before applying. You will be redirected to our application portal, where you can submit your updated resume. After submitting your application, our talent aquisition team will carefully review all candidates, and if you are shortlisted, we will contact you for the next steps in the hiring process. If you don't find a job that fits your professional profile, you can register at jobs.gft.com to receive job alerts or contact us for more information. What qualifications and experience?The qualifications and experience required may vary based on the job family, seniority level and project. You can find specific details in the job description for each opening listed on jobs.gft.com. Furthermore, we highly value candidates who embody our 5 GFT Core Values: Caring, Collaborative, Committed, Courageous and Creative. At our core, we firmly believe that diversity drives innovation, and thus, we embrace inclusion in all its forms. What sets GFT apart as an employer? We take pride in creating an inclusive environment that encourages continuous learning, development, and growth. As a global company, GFT fosters a culture of innovation, collaboration, and diversity. We aim to ensure all employees can thrive and reach their full potential while working with state-of-the-art offerings and technologies. Our employee-driven approach makes us a standout choice for talented professionals aiming to make their mark. This is why we were certified as Great Places to Work® in 16 countries in 2026. Got Questions? We’re Happy to Help.Fernanda dos Santos RodriguesChief Human Resources OfficerfirstName *lastName *jobtitle *email *country *messagenewsletterCommunicationLabelopportunityCommunicationLabeldataProtectionDeclarationsubmitRead MoreMore About Our CultureCulture & ValuesWe Care About YouWhat we offerInsightsGFT Technologies Blog

title: Help create the creator economy.
text: Help create the creator economy. Ecommerce redefined how people buy products, the creator economy is redefining how people buy content. Ghost makes independent technology for creators to publish online and build a sustainable subscription business to fund their work. The world has changed, and media is struggling to change with it. The internet fuelled advertising-driven business models where all that mattered was capturing as many eyeballs as possible. The resulting economy brought us clickbait, outrage, fake news, and a fraught competition for your attention. Today, creators are choosing a new model where they have a direct relationship with an audience who pay a subscription to receive their content. The incentives are aligned, and the audience is the customer, not the product being sold. At Ghost, we're a very small team creating a very large platform that's redefining how people are publishing online. The opportunity ahead for subscription commerce is hard to overstate, and we're looking for people who can help turn our dream for the future of publishing into a reality. We work differently to most other companies. We're a non-profit organisation, we give away all of the intellectual property and software we build as free and open source, we have a distributed international team spread all over the world, we're completely self-funded with no shareholders or VCs in the background influencing decisions, and we're committed to staying small, never growing our team to more than around 50 people. We have only two goals at Ghost: To create a product we're incredibly proud of, and a company that provides a great life to the team building it. To achieve those goals we've thrown away most other traditional measures of success. We optimise for making the best product we can, rather than the one that makes the most money. We're cultivating a team of people we love working with, rather than one which is the biggest or most efficient. The structure of the company was chosen as a forcing factor. What happens when you have a business that can never be bought or sold? It turns out that you make a lot of decisions that optimise for building a company you're happy to be stuck with. The alternative paths and artificial constraints we've chosen to adopt have been the seeds for a remarkable amount of creativity. Limiting our ambition has, in so many ways, been exactly what has attracted people and fuelled our success. We've worked remotely since 2013 and, though everyone does it now, the way in which we've done it has always been to give people freedom and trust to do their best work — and live a fulfilling life beyond work. You wont find endless Zoom calls, full calendars, petty process or exhausting career politics here. Just a calm, creative group of humans enjoying challenging problems at the junction between art, science and engineering. Aside from during volcanic eruptions and global pandemics, the whole team gets together in-person for a week-long retreat twice a year. Our last few trips have taken us to Spain, Thailand, Dubai, Egypt and Austria. Perks included with every role at Ghost. 💵 Competitive salaryBased on role, skill, experience and location. 🌍 Work from anywhereFrom a home office, or travel continuously if that's your thing. Everything we do is online. As long as you have wifi, you're all set. 💻 Hardware includedA new (and regularly refreshed) laptop for work + a $500 office workspace setup budget. 🏢 Co-working coveredIf you prefer to work from a co-working space, we'll help pay for it. 📚 Continue your personal developmentThere's a budget for attending conferences, taking courses, and purchasing books. ✈️ Team retreatsThe last few trips have taken us to Dubai, Thailand, Austria & Egypt. 📅 Four day work week Enjoy 3 day weekends year-round. 🏝 Generous paid vacationWe close the office for 2 weeks each December, and encourage everyone to take regular time off from work to relax. 👶 Paid parental leaveWhen the time comes to welcome a new member of the family, we offer generous and fully paid parental leave. 📈 Regular pay reviewsEveryone receives an annual pay review, with compensation updates based on performance. 🧘‍♀️ Meeting-free focusMost people at Ghost only have 1 or 2 zoom calls a week. We like to keep calendars empty & leave plenty of space for focusing on creative work. We're looking for people with a balanced perspective. Our team is made up of a group of incredibly smart, kind people who get shit done. People who are comfortable taking on big ideas and figuring out the details along the way tend to enjoy the light-touch level of process that we use. People with dreams and ambitions beyond their career tend to appreciate our unapologetic focus on balance and freedom, rather than just all-work, all-the-time. We want driven people who move fast and ship, getting things done even in the absence of a complete plan. We also want people who are patient and calm, accepting that most things will be mostly imperfect most of the time. We especially value people who are capable and responsible, who don't wait to be told what to do next. People who thrive in traditional corporate structures and office environments often do not enjoy the experience here. There's a lot of free-form collaboration and experimentation which means it's both harder to coast along doing the minimum, or play politics to climb the career ladder. Our team is passionate about their craft and talented at what they do, but none of us take ourselves or the world around us too seriously. We laugh at ourselves, and each other, a lot — so there isn't much room for self-importance. You won't find any lengthy manifestos here, nor breathless memos about how we're "fixing media" or "changing the world", because people who do particularly well at Ghost tend to be self-aware, and share a common allergy to nonsense. Behind the scenes Building an Open-Source Publishing Platform That Makes [$500,000]/mo - John O'Nolan of Ghost www.indiehackers.com Pursuing a Mission While Bootstrapping to Millions [The followup]www.indiehackers.com Ghost 5.0 — A new business model for publishingwww.producthunt.com The top 10 fully remote companies to work for in 2022www.cnbc.com The challenging path ahead of us. As the creator economy comes to life, there's an incredible amount of interest and excitement about an entirely new sector of the market — not just from creators themselves, but from companies and platforms who want to capitalise on something new. We are not the only team working in this space. Ghost is unique in that we build decentralised, open technology that allows people to own and control their own destiny. Building software that's decentralised, open, and can be installed anywhere is fundamentally more difficult than building centralised platform. It requires more advanced engineering, more compute power, more marketing, documentation, education, and significantly more sophisticated customer support to handle the demands of our most successful customers. Our biggest challenge, by far, is in making advanced software be as friendly, accessible and straightforward to manage as possible. Lowering the barrier for people to feel comfortable running their own technology, and enjoying the freedom to build publications and businesses they control. Forever. Eventually decentralised, open technology always wins. The path to get there requires building a world class product, rock solid infrastructure, carefully crafted architecture, and a renowned service team. And that's where we're hoping you'll be able to help us, because we can't do it alone. We need you. Don't see the right position for you? Join our careers mailing list to be notified whenever we start hiring for new roles. We'll only ever email you about new positions, no marketing or promotions.

production-grade services, APIs, SDKs, internal tools, and reusable platform capabilities.Develop systems that combine AI agents, tools, deterministic workflows, APIs, events, and human approval steps.Implement execution capabilities such as agent runtimes, model invocation, reusable skills, backend services, and automated actions.Build orchestration patterns involving routing, sequencing, systems, and internal or external APIs.Connect the Harness with platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Slack, cloud services, SaaS products, and internal applications.Implement identity, comparisons.Improve developer experience through APIs, SDKs, CLIs, templates, configuration systems, documentation, and reusable reference implementations.Build lightweight user interfaces, developer platforms, workflow systems, or enterprise automation solutions.Experience with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent systems, or tool integration patterns.Experience with security, or product teams. This hands-on role combines technical roadmapping,solution design, independent research, application development, and close collaboration with engineering teamsand stakeholders.The ideal candidate combines strong .NET and Azure expertise with practical architecture thinking, modern DevOpsand infrastructure-as-code experience, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly. Thisperson can move between strategic architecture and hands-on delivery, turn ambiguous challenges into wellsupportedrecommendations, and help define executable work for others.Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Leadership and DeliveryDefine technical roadmaps and architecture strategies for cloud migration, application modernization, and scalable digital solutions.Design secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available systems that align technical decisions with business objectives.Balance long-term architecture direction with hands-on development, prototyping, technical validation, and delivery support.Research architecture options, evaluate tradeoffs and risks, and present clear recommendations to engineering teams and stakeholders.Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, technical plans, and system representations that make complex designs easy to understand.Translate architecture into executable work by helping define epics, features, stories, dependencies, and technical sequencing.Design security-first solutions that protect customer and enterprise data, support compliance, and reduce operational risk.Collaborate with architects, engineering leaders, product partners, and business stakeholders to align solutions with enterprise standards and delivery priorities.Database and Performance OptimizationDesign data and integration architectures that support scalability, reliability, maintainability, and future growth.Write and review advanced SQL, data models, indexing strategies, and query plans to improve application and database performance.Identify and address performance bottlenecks across applications, services, integrations, and databases.Design APIs, third-party and vendor integrations, and synchronous or asynchronous communication patterns.Define service boundaries, integration contracts, versioning approaches, error-handling strategies, and data integrity controls.Support distributed and event-driven solutions using technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.Cloud and DevOpsDesign and support solutions in Microsoft Azure using secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud patterns.Help migrate applications and services from on-premises environments to Azure.Define and improve application onboarding patterns that enable engineering teams to move workloads into the cloud consistently.Use infrastructure-as-code and deployment tooling, including Bicep, Helm, GitHub Enterprise, and GitHub Actions workflows.Apply Agile and DevOps practices to improve delivery quality, deployment reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.Promote observability, resilience, fault isolation, secure configuration, and operational readiness across cloud solutions.Partner with engineers to troubleshoot architecture, environment, integration, deployment, and operational issues.Full-Stack DevelopmentDesign and build backend services using C#, .NET, .NET Core, Web APIs, web applications, and servicebased architectures.Remain close enough to the code to validate designs, support implementation, and contribute hands-on when needed.Build and support modern front-end applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular.Design and evaluate secure authentication and authorization solutions for external users and customerfacing applications through an Identity Provider (IdP), using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Duende IdentityServer v8, or OpenIddict.Support customer identity and access management modernization by evaluating and adopting MicrosoftEntra External ID, including secure migration paths from Azure AD B2C or other legacy identity platforms.Promote clean, maintainable, testable code and sound engineering practices across the software development lifecycle.Support modernization of legacy applications and the evolution of monolithic systems toward appropriate modular, service-based, distributed, or event-driven designs.Mentorship and Team DevelopmentMentor engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical discussions.Bring ideas forward, encourage constructive brainstorming, and help teams evaluate multiple solution options.Communicate proactively and clearly in a distributed, cross-functional environment.Influence stakeholders and align technical decisions with business objectives, customer needs, delivery constraints, and risk considerations.Research unfamiliar technical areas independently and share findings in a clear, actionable way.Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.Required QualificationsHigh school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred.8 to 10 years of software development experience, including technical leadership or architecture responsibilities.2 or more years of experience creating technical roadmaps and presenting architectural solutions.Strong hands-on experience designing and developing solutions with C#, .NET, .NET Core, Web APIs, and the broader Microsoft technology stack.Strong Microsoft Azure experience, including cloud migration, cloud-native solution design, and application modernization.Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and delivery automation, including Bicep, Helm, GitHubEnterprise, and GitHub Actions or comparable tooling.Hands-on experience designing and implementing external-user authentication and authorization through anIdentity Provider, using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.Practical experience with at least one relevant identity platform, such as Microsoft Entra ID, DuendeIdentityServer v8, OpenIddict, Azure AD B2C, or Microsoft Entra External ID.Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous communication, and event-driven architecture.Strong understanding of API design, third-party integrations, SQL development, data modeling, indexing, and performance optimization.Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one modern front-end framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular.Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments with a focus on quality, automation, collaboration, and continuous delivery.Demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar technical areas independently, evaluate alternatives, and present clear recommendations.Strong verbal and written English communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.Proven leadership and collaboration skills, including mentoring engineers, influencing stakeholders, and guiding work without relying solely on formal authority.Preferred SkillsExperience implementing Microsoft Entra External ID for customer-facing applications or migrating customer identity workloads from Azure AD B2C.Experience modernizing identity providers or migrating authentication platforms to cloud environments.Experience with Kubernetes-based environments and Helm-managed deployments.Experience with Azure Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms.Experience supporting customer-facing applications or solutions operating in security-sensitive or regulated environments.Experience decomposing legacy or monolithic applications into modular, service-based, or event-driven architectures.Azure architecture or development certifications.Exposure to additional cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.Behavioral and Leadership ExpectationsStrong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.Ability to structure and articulate reasoning in a logical, easy-to-follow manner.Collaborative and approachable team player who contributes positively to team culture.Proactive problem solver with curiosity and determination in tackling complex or ambiguous challenges.Customer-focused and security-conscious mindset with strong attention to quality, maintainability, testability, and operational risk.Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment in complex technical environments.Hands-on leadership style that stays connected to implementation and engineering reality. title: Working at Gridium
text: Better Buildings for a Better World At Gridium, we develop beautiful tools to help real estate teams reduce their energy use and improve their operations. We believe that everyone deserves to use great software, and that teams work best when talented people are empowered to take risks in a warm, collaborative environment. Big challenges We take in enormous amounts of data and use it to uncover meaningful patterns so that our customers, whether a corporate office campus or a downtown skyscraper, gain unprecedented insight into their energy use. You’ll have your choice of interesting problems to work on, whether you’re most excited about delivering great user experiences, cracking hard analytic problems, or scaling up web services to millions of users. Collaborative, flexible At Gridium, do your best work alongside other smart, creative people. We’re a small, focused team where everyone takes ownership of the end result, and informal collaboration takes precedence over long meetings. We share information freely at Gridium: company goals, financial metrics, planning sessions, you name it. We believe an open environment lets us make better decisions, faster. Work remotely We’re a distributed team, which means you can work wherever you work best, whether a home office, a co-working space, your mountain hideaway, a favorite coffee shop, or anywhere else. Not everyone is comfortable working remotely – we understand! – but we’ve invested heavily in the tools and processes necessary to make distributed collaboration work. Maybe you want to be home every day when your kids get back from school. Or maybe you just prefer to stay close to your favorite mountain bike trail. Whatever the situation, if you’re a self-starter who craves flexibility, remote work might be for you. Face time counts Because sometimes face-to-face really is best, all Gridium employees get together once a quarter for three days of intensive planning, doing, eating, and socializing. These get-togethers, affectionately called “Gridium Camp,” are highly productive and also a lot of fun. Past camps have brought us to Chicago, San Diego, Nashville, Denver, Charlotte and other great destinations. Partners and pets make frequent guest visits! Chris Hollman Data Quality Engineer Nisha Labroo Energy Analyst I Ben Klaas Internal Tools Engineer Chris Hollman Data Quality Engineer Chris joined Gridium as a data analyst after transitioning from a career in healthcare. He is passionate about using data to solve problems and make a positive impact on the planet. Chris lives in North Carolina with his wife Elizabeth and enjoys fly fishing, distance running, and any opportunity to learn new things. Nisha Labroo Energy Analyst I Nisha acquired her BS in Energy Engineering from Penn State and has since gained project management experience on the EPC side of commercial-scale solar farms. She is now an Energy Analyst I with Gridium. Based in Providence with her orange tabby, you can find Nisha experimenting in the kitchen, walking dogs, making jewelry, and playing games with friends. Ben Klaas Internal Tools Engineer Ben started professional life as a biologist (B.S. University of Wisconsin-Madison, M.S. Iowa State University), but long ago made the jump to the tech world, where his passion for data and puzzle solving are still well met. He’s worked with satellite data, internet access equipment, digital audio streaming devices, phone and voicemail management software, census and survey data, and several other things. He is an avid bird-watcher, cyclist, and golfer, so if there’s ever a triathlon with those three events he’s going to dominate, because that’s a narrowly overlapping Venn diagram. Ben lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota with his wife and two daughters, where they barely endure the winter but absolutely love the summer. Available Positions Come Build Great Things at Gridium Don’t see a position but interested anyway? Contact us to talk. Team Players Wanted Buildings use 40% of the world’s electricity. Running them smarter keeps our air cleaner and our grid stronger. Gridium delivers intuitive software and expert services to help building leaders turn mountains of data into actionable insights. Come help us build great products for better buildings. We’re a 100% distributed team focused on a delighting our customers, solving meaningful problems, and working together to design an open, collaborative work environment where everyone can do their best work. title: Shape the future of recruitment – from anywhere
text: Shape the future of recruitment – from anywhere What we doGOhiring is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company that empowers thousands of customers to make data-based recruitment decisions. We are a team of +45 hand-picked talented people. We believe in great software (check our github), kindness, automation, and data-driven recruitment. Digital-first is in our company DNA.We’re learning and growing with one another through collaboration. As a team, we always come through. To keep that strength, we want to grow wisely – at the right speed and with the best people.Do you want to have a big impact in a small team? Come join us! Open Positions Meet the teams Development Talent Acquisition Marketing Partner Management Customer Success Data Customer Service Finance Product Management People How we work (#remotefirst)Since 2012 we are on a mission to take remote work to the next level. And we would never want to change that. We’ve used the years to develop thought-through processes, get connected via the best tools available, and build a company that is based on relationships, trust, and meaningful collaboration. Feel free to join our #remote-culture team from the place you’re most productive at (which can also include our Berlin office space). Team ValuesWe believe in having a life and empower our team to thrive personally and professionally. Take ownership, contribute unique ideas, and enjoy flexible work arrangements. We foster a culture of trust and accountability, providing the structure for efficient collaboration.Join us in a culture that values quality of work. We believe in leveraging automation to enhance productivity, ensuring top-notch results. With a humble mindset, we embrace continuous learning, always seeking to improve and grow.Our DNA is built on clear direction. We believe in continuous improvement, fostering steady growth in all aspects of our work. Through proactive thinking, we stay one step ahead, embracing opportunities and overcoming challenges. Team values Be humbleDon’t be about yourself – be about the team Keep QuestioningChallenge the status quo – there is always a better solution Follow Your True NorthKnow what you want, be authentic and passionate about what you do Shape the digital futureBe passionate about technology and create a positive impact by digital innovation Why I love working for GOhiring“It’s not often you find this combination of a kind and talented team on the one side and a product with a great market fit that customers love on the other side. I really like to work on complex challenges, because as a team we always come through.” Michael NadineStuttgart ChristinaKassel JaschaBerlin KatjaLeipzig Michael Stralsund FriederikeTraveling FlorianBerlin UtaBerlin EduardoBerlin DougParis Lucas Brisbane DimaIrpin MarkusBerlin JuliaRegensburg MarieHamburg PabloVilancosta MariaCrete BastianTrier NicoleUtrecht FrankAschaffenburg RidwanKaiserslautern NikolaBerlin TiagoTrier TheresaHamburg LuisaFrankfurt RémyBerlin KatjaLeipzig ValerieHamburg FranziKarlsruhe DawidWrocław JensBerlin CarlosCologne MiguelLisbon DanielKarlsruhe LarsCologne YaakovMadrid PiotrŁódź JessicaWeilmünster EvgeniSofia GianiMunich GiedriusVilnius GinoMainz ChristinaBerlin NicolaPrague Sophia Nuremberg Kim Nuremberg PatrickSt. Julian's LeonDublin Join the missionReach out and apply — we’ll get back to you with feedback within a few days. We know you’re more than just a resume, so during the interview process we take the time to get to know each other properly, while keeping the process focused, lean and respectful of your time. On average, the whole journey takes about 4 weeks to complete. 1) Application ReviewWe will take few days to go through your application and get back to you as soon as possible. 2) First InterviewA chance for us to get to know each other and explore how we align as people and as a team.Depending on the role, you will meet May, our AI-Recruiter for a first touch-point that will then be reviewed by our Recruing team 3) Take-Home Task (for some roles)Depending on the role, we will send you a role-related task/case-study, so you can show us how you approach real work, in your own time and style. 4) Hiring Team InterviewA deeper conversation with the team you’d join. You’ll hear more about the role and share more about your skills and experiences. 5) Team-TimeIn this final step, you’ll meet with GOhiring team-members from all different teams. It’s a great way to get a feel of what it’s really like to be part of the team! Jobs Questions & Answers What Learning and Development options GOhiring offers? At GOhiring, your development is supported from day one. You will receive structured on-the-job training, guidance through internal mentoring, and access to external learning platforms such as Coursera. As you gain experience, you may also support the onboarding of new team members, helping you strengthen your leadership and coaching skills. Your growth path is tailored to your goals, enabling you to develop in the direction that matters most to you. What does onboarding look like at GOhiring? Your first weeks are all about getting settled, meeting the team, and understanding how we work. You’ll have structured onboarding sessions, access to documentation, and regular check-ins with your manager and onboarding buddy. We make sure you feel welcomed and supported from day one. Can I use AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT) during interviews at GOhiring? At GOhiring, we know that AI tools can be incredibly helpful at work and when preparing for interviews, whether it’s; researching a topic, practicing questions, or boosting your confidence. We fully support using AI and any other technology to learn and grow. However, during the actual interview, we want to hear from you… your thoughts, experiences, and unique perspective. Using AI to generate responses in real time takes away from an authentic conversation and makes it harder for us to truly get to know you. Our goal is to create a fair and genuine process where every candidate has the chance to show their real strengths and potential. What is GOhiring's diversity, equity, and inclusion stance? We’re committed to creating a fair and inclusive workplace. We hire internationally, value diverse perspectives, and ensure everyone has equal opportunities to contribute, grow, and be heard. What does work-life balance look like at GOhiring? Flexibility is a core part of how we work. We respect personal time, encourage healthy boundaries, and trust people to manage their schedules responsibly. Our remote-first culture is built to support both high-quality work and personal wellbeing. How does GOhiring encourage social interactions in a remote-first company? As a remote-native company, staying connected on a human level is important to us. We build in regular moments, both in person and online, that help everyone feel part of the team. These touch-points make it easy to form genuine relationships, no matter where you’re working from.In-person meetups:We meet face-to-face several times a year, both in smaller team retreats and in company-wide offsites. These gatherings give everyone a chance to collaborate, align, and spend meaningful time together.Digital connection:We have weekly digital “coffee-breaks” through Slack, including one-on-one chats and small-group sessions of 4-5 people. These informal conversations make it easy to connect with colleagues you might not interact with day-to-day.

title: We've been thinking about customer support for 14 years.
text: About HelplyWe've been thinking about customer support for 14 years.We spent 14 years building support software. Then AI showed us the help desk itself needed to change.First, we built Groove.In 2011, we set out to build a simpler alternative to Zendesk. No bloated software. No endless configuration. Just an easier way for teams to support their customers.Over the next 14 years, thousands of companies used Groove. That gave us a front-row seat to how customer support works.The hardest part wasn't writing the reply. It was figuring out what the reply should say.Then our customers started asking for AI.As AI improved, our customers wanted it inside Groove. So we added AI-generated replies, summaries, and tools that helped support teams work faster. They worked. But the underlying workflow did not change.Groove had been designed for humans to do the work. Its inbox, workflows, permissions, data model, and economics reflected that assumption. People still opened tickets, gathered context, and handled each issue manually.We could keep adding AI features. Or we could rethink the help desk itself.At the same time, we were experimenting ourselves.We started using Claude inside our support operation. At first, it answered questions and drafted replies. Then we connected it to our knowledge, customer data, product information, and internal systems.Suddenly, AI could do much more than write. It could gather context, search across systems, investigate problems, follow processes, and increasingly take action.The AI was getting far more capable. But our team was still orchestrating every step.So we asked the question:What if our team could direct the work instead?What if AI agents could gather context, investigate issues, follow processes, and take pre-approved actions before a human got involved? Humans would still own the customer experience. But they would spend less time executing every step and more time directing what happened next.That became Helply.An agentic customer support platform built for humans and AI agents to work together.Gather the right customer context.Investigate what happened.Search knowledge and connected systems.Follow your team's processes.Resolve issues and take approved actions.Surface risks and opportunities.Bring in a human when judgment is needed.Your team stays in control, setting direction, handling exceptions, making strategic decisions, and improving how the system works.Our team moved from doing the work to directing it.And we're using it ourselves.We didn't build Helply around demos or hypothetical workflows. Our support operation became its first proving ground.At our peak, 6 full-time people supported 1,400 customers. Today, 2 people support that same customer base. Most importantly: we do not plan to add another support person as we add our next 1,000 customers.This isn't about replacing support teams. It's about giving every person more capacity.That's why Helply never charges per seat.Bring in Support, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership with no per-user fees, and pay only for the AI work you use.Book a demoWhat we believeHumans should direct more of the work.AI agents can gather context, investigate, follow processes and take action. People should spend more of their time setting direction, exercising judgment and handling the moments that need them.AI should be more than a writing assistant.Drafting replies is useful. But the bigger opportunity is everything that happens before and after the reply.Humans aren't disappearing.The goal isn't support without people. It's giving great support people more leverage.AI should be foundational, not bolted on.The next generation of support software can't be the old help desk with AI features added to it. Humans and agents need to be part of the architecture from the beginning.Pricing should reflect how work gets done now.That's why every plan has unlimited users, and you pay only for the work your AI agents do.14 years later, we're still obsessed with support.We've helped thousands of teams support millions of customers. Helply is the culmination of everything we've learned about what great support teams need, rebuilt for what comes next.We're just getting started.Meet the teamIn one sentenceHelply is an AI-native customer support platform that resolves, investigates, and acts on customer conversations for B2B software and B2C, ecommerce, and marketplace teams.What Helply doesSupport AgentTalks to customers directly on every channel, investigates using the knowledge base, customer history, and connected tools, and resolves issues end to end. When it can’t, it hands off to a person with the work already done.Assist AgentWorks alongside a human inside the conversation, investigating, drafting replies, and taking the actions the human approves. The result is a support teammate who moves faster with more context.Background AgentsWatch every conversation and act without being asked, covering churn risk, knowledge gaps, expansion revenue, feature requests, and emerging trends. Teams can also build their own for any recurring job.The full help deskShared inbox and ticketing, messaging and live chat, a knowledge base and help center, analytics, customer records, and workflows: everything you expect from Zendesk, rebuilt around AI agents.What makes Helply differentUnlimited users on every plan.Helply never charges per seat, so Support, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership can all work in one place. Zendesk Suite Professional is $115 per agent per month, plus $50 per agent for Copilot.AI is foundational, not bolted on.The inbox, workflows, permissions, and data model were built for humans and agents to work together from the start, not a legacy help desk like Freshdesk or Help Scout with AI features added on top.You pay for AI work, not per resolution.AI work is billed in credits weighted by complexity, and unused credits roll over. Zendesk bills its AI agents per automated resolution, which penalizes you for high volume.Helply replaces the whole stack.Instead of stitching tools together, Helply replaces Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Front, Help Scout, Pylon, and Plain, with guided migration from each.Built and run by a 14-year support team.Helply is made by the team behind Groove, which supported thousands of companies since 2011. We run our own support on Helply: 2 people now cover the 1,400 customers that once took a team of 6.Who uses HelplyB2B SaaS companies whose support handles technical, account, and billing issues across their stack.B2C, ecommerce, and marketplace businesses handling high volumes of customer conversations.Support, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams that collaborate on the same tickets.Teams migrating off Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Front, or Help Scout who want AI built in, not added on.See support in action for B2B teams and B2C teams.The team behind HelplyHelply is made by the team behind Groove. We started Groove in 2011 as a simpler alternative to Zendesk and spent 14 years helping thousands of companies support millions of customers. When AI showed us the help desk itself needed to change, we rebuilt it around AI agents and became Helply. The company is a remote-first team spanning product, engineering, support, and go-to-market.Alex TurnbullCo-founder, CEOAlex started Groove in 2011 to build a simpler alternative to Zendesk and led it for 14 years. text: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA FULLSTACK REACT/KOTLIN/JAVA ESPECIALISTA I (RGM E DEMANDA) · Grupo Boticário Brasil PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA FULLSTACK REACT/KOTLIN/JAVA ESPECIALISTA I (RGM E DEMANDA) · Grupo Boticário Brasil Há 1 mês 98 candidaturas Veja quem a Grupo Boticário contratou para este cargo Denunciar esta vaga Descrição da vagaUm dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô, TRUSS e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores forma o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.Vem fazer beleza com a gente!Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesAtuação Fullstack com Impacto Arquitetural: Contribuir ativamente com o desenho técnico e a evolução da aplicação de Plataforma de Planejamento de RGM e Demanda atuando desde a interface de alta densidade (One Page Cockpit) até a manutenção de endpoints e persistência no calculation-engine.Engenharia e Performance no Frontend: Desenvolver uma interface reativa e fluida utilizando React 18, Vite e TypeScript. Você aplicará técnicas de virtualização (TanStack Virtual v3) para renderizar grandes volumes de dados em tela sem onerar o navegador.Gestão de Estado e Draft Mode: Implementar lógicas de negócios complexas no cliente, gerenciando estados de alta frequência via Zustand e TanStack Query, além de sincronizar de forma eficiente as edições de rascunhos (drafts) com o backend.Desenvolvimento Backend: Construir e dar manutenção em serviços utilizando Kotlin K2 e Spring Boot. Você garantirá que fluxos de consolidação e aprovação não bloqueiem a thread HTTP, integrando-se adequadamente a mecanismos de orquestração assíncrona.Persistência e Governança: Atuar com banco de dados PostgreSQL (RDS), elaborando migrações com Flyway e respeitando as restrições arquiteturais da plataforma (como a segregação rigorosa de leitura e escrita entre schemas).Visualização de Dados e Segurança: Implementar a camada gráfica exclusivamente com Recharts e integrar o fluxo de autenticação e carteirização de serviços via Microsoft Entra ID (Azure ID) e SSO (JWT).Requisitos e qualificaçõesExperiência consolidada como Fullstack Sênior: Perfil preferencialmente T-shaped, com domínio técnico em Frontend para liderar os desafios da interface, aliado a uma forte autonomia para atuar em Backend.Sólida vivência no Ecossistema React: Prática comprovada com React moderno, TypeScript, gerenciamento de estado (Zustand) e estratégias de data-fetching (TanStack Query), com foco em otimização de performance e manipulação de arrays complexos.Capacidade em Backend (Kotlin/Java): Habilidade para desenvolver, refatorar e dar manutenção em APIs RESTful robustas usando Kotlin e Spring Boot, aplicando boas práticas de Clean Code.Banco de Dados Relacional: Bom domínio prático em PostgreSQL, modelagem relacional básica e versionamento de schemas utilizando Flyway.Integração de Fluxos Assíncronos: Compreensão arquitetural para integrar aplicações clientes com processos não-bloqueantes e serviços em nuvem.Diferencial:Conhecimento do ecossistema de nuvem AWS (ex: hospedagem estática em Amazon S3/CloudFront, API Gateway, runtime em Amazon EKS e orquestração via AWS Step Functions).Experiência em migrar fluxos de planejamento baseados em planilhas pesadas (Excel) para aplicações web de alta performance.Vivência na migração estrutural de versões de bibliotecas core (ex: atualizações maiores do React ou implementações/trocas de Design Systems).Informações adicionaisBenefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam: No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.Saúde:Plano médico e odontológico flexíveisAuxílio medicamentos e vale saúde para familiaresSessões de psicoterapia gratuitas e telemedicina 24hProgramas contínuos de prevenção, cuidado mental e vacinaçãoAlimentação & bem-estarVale Refeição (ou restaurante local) e Vale Alimentação (com vale extra no Natal)Desconto de até 40% nas marcas do nosso ecossistemaGympass/TotalPass para academias e estúdios esportivosAuxílio Home Office para modalidades híbrida e remotaDay off de aniversário para celebrar do seu jeitoPlano de saúde pet, vantagens em convênios e programas de viagem/hospedagemPara sua famíliaLicença parental estendida (180 dias para mães e 120 dias para pais)Suporte para Pais Atípicos e auxílio babá / educação infantilAuxílio material escolar e crédito nutrição infantilOrientação jurídica, psicológica e social dedicadaSeguridade para proteção e tranquilidade financeiraPrevidência Privada e Seguro de VidaApoio ao falecimento de pais e empréstimo consignadoVale Transporte e Estacionamento (conforme o modelo de trabalho)Nota: Os pacotes de benefícios são adaptados de acordo com a elegibilidade de cada cargo e modelo de trabalho.Grupo BoticárioDe uma pequena farmácia de manipulação à maior franquia de cosméticos do planeta.Somos um Grupo com 15 marcas que está presente em mais de 40 países, com mais de 4 mil lojas físicas, líder de e-commerce de beleza no Brasil e mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos. Temos um ecossistema próprio de beleza, que vai da indústria ao ponto de venda, da logística ao varejo, do laboratório ao coração das consumidoras e das nossas inovações na palma da sua mão. Acreditamos que o futuro mais bonito é aquele que construímos juntos, por isso, até 2030 temos compromissos ambiciosos voltados para o impacto positivo em dimensões humanas, ambientais e em nossos processos produtivos.Ganhamos o ranking "Employer Branding Awards 2025" do Glassdoor, que nos elegeu a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no setor de varejo no Brasil! Reconhecimento baseado em avaliações voluntárias e anônimas de nossos colaboradores e ex-colaboradores sobre como é trabalhar aqui.Reinventamos a beleza por meio da tecnologia, inovação, diversidade e sustentabilidade com: O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuarmos com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil e Linha de cuidados Pampers.Vem fazer beleza com a gente!
