title: Sr. Systems Engineer, Sales & Marketing
text: Save Saved Sr. Systems Engineer, Sales & Marketing San Francisco / Remote IT Regular Share Apply Now Description About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.Are you passionate about building impactful products for sales and finance teams? Come join the IT Enterprise Systems team at Pinterest where you will be responsible for advancing our sales and marketing systems. What you’ll do: Design, build, and operate full‑stack applications and services on Pinterest’s enterprise infrastructure to support our Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams, from backend services and APIs through integrations and user‑facing workflows. Lead the technical design and implementation of GenAI/ML‑powered services and pipelines that automate and augment enterprise workflows (for example, summarizing sales interactions, enriching account data, or surfacing intelligent recommendations), including clear evaluation frameworks, observability, and validation guardrails. Own the end‑to‑end software development lifecycle for these systems: requirements gathering, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner closely with product managers, business systems analysts, and other engineers to translate ambiguous business needs into well‑defined technical plans, success metrics, and deliverables—and to make thoughtful tradeoffs between scope, risk, and speed. Use AI coding tools and agents to accelerate development responsibly (e.g., drafting code and tests, iterating on designs, summarizing findings), while applying rigorous testing, code review, and observability to ensure quality and reliability. Mentor and coach other engineers on system design, GenAI/ML patterns, and AI‑augmented workflows, contributing to technical decision‑making and raising the bar on engineering practices within the team. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience building systems or analytics used by Sales and/or Marketing teams (for example CRM or sales productivity tools, campaign management and measurement, or revenue operations workflows), with a clear understanding of how these partners use data and tooling to hit their goals. 10+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including full‑stack applications and/or backend services on a modern cloud platform (such as AWS or similar). Experience in enterprise or business systems environments is a plus. Strong proficiency in Python and experience with at least one of: Java, Node.js, and/or Javascript, with a track record of delivering reliable, maintainable code in collaborative engineering teams. Hands‑on experience designing and operating distributed systems and robust, fault‑tolerant integrations (e.g., REST/gRPC services, event‑driven architectures, or data pipelines) that support critical business workflows. Practical experience building or integrating GenAI/ML‑powered features or services in production—such as LLM‑based workflows, ML‑driven recommendations, or intelligent automation—including an understanding of evaluation, observability, and common failure modes. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and agents to write, review, and validate detailed technical design documents (TDDs), specifications, and test plans as part of a spec‑driven, agentic development workflow, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, quality, and correctness. Experience using GenAI coding tools (for example, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and/or agents in your development workflow, with a demonstrated ability to validate AI‑assisted output and maintain high standards for quality, security, and maintainability. Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional, diverse teams and to explain complex technical concepts—including GenAI/ML tradeoffs—to non‑technical partners. Outcome‑oriented mindset: you focus on delivering business outcomes rather than just technical outputs, using technology and AI thoughtfully to positively impact key performance metrics for Sales, Marketing, and Finance. Salesforce engineering experience (for example, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Salesforce integrations) is a plus, especially where it supports Sales and Marketing workflows. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6 months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. #LI-REMOTE #LI-JD3At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.US based applicants only$132,415—$272,619 USDOur Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire. text: Save Saved Staff Software, Engineering – Analytics Engineering, Core Data Science San Francisco / Remote Engineering Regular Share Apply Now Description About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help improve the quality and velocity of data science at Pinterest. You will shape the future of the people-facing and business-facing products we build by creating rock-solid data foundations and tooling, and by leading a high-performance team that partners closely with our Core Data Science organization. What you'll do: Lead by example, and mentor a diverse team of analytics engineers with an inclusive culture. Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams. Build and prototype AI tools and analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed. Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and iteration—drafting pipelines, exploring approaches, and automating repeatable documentation and QA—while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness and quality. Work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers to build tools and processes that enable self-service of key datasets, insights, and metric investigations. Contribute to comprehensive documentation of tools and datasets, and drive the strategy for better data quality and data democratization within Pinterest. Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, collaborating with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest. What we're looking for: 6+ years of experience working with data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL (or other database languages) and a scripting language (Python or R), including nested data structure manipulation, windowing functions, query optimization, and data partitioning techniques. Experience conducting workflow orchestration and ETL/ELT with huge, complicated datasets and handling DAG data dependencies. Consistent track record of supplying analytics solutions to existing teams, with the ability to take open-ended goals and scope them into defined, impactful objectives. A team player able to partner with cross-functional leadership to quickly turn insights into actions, and an accountable operator who proactively identifies project opportunities amid competing priorities. Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in your day-to-day workflow, with a strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work (testing, source-checking, data validation, peer review). High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI, and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables. Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Desired but not required: Experience in automation, anomaly detection, or infrastructure/workflow optimization. Experience building internal tooling to maximize engineering velocity. title: Careers & Culture
text: Company Careers & Culture We don’t just build technology—we’re powering stronger schools. As the team behind the K-12 Connected Operating System, we connect data, systems, and people to bring clarity, confidence, and action to education. Every day, we help educators and leaders focus on what matters most: improving outcomes for students and communities everywhere. Get to Know PowerSchool We create connected K-12 EdTech that unlocks productivity and insights to empower schools to advance student achievement. PowerSchool solutions unlock operational excellence in over 80% of school districts in North America, unifying the education ecosystem from the central office to classroom to home. Over 15,000 school organizations support more than 60 million students worldwide by using PowerSchool software to run core functions such as student information management, instruction, attendance, analytics, talent management and HR, and school-family communication. Our Core Values PowerSchool’s core values define who we are and how we work, guiding us to act with integrity, operate with excellence and urgency, and stay relentlessly focused on delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers. Act with Integrity We do the right thing—honestly, ethically, and respectfully—especially when it’s difficult. Operate with Excellence We deliver high-quality outcomes with speed, simplicity, and efficient use of resources. Collaborate with Purpose We work across teams with trust and intention to drive decisions and stronger outcomes. Innovate in Every Way We create value for our customers and improve how we work while taking measured risks. Focus on the Customer We prioritize customer needs and outcomes in every decision to deliver meaningful value. Compete to Win We bring urgency, discipline, and market focus to everything we do—winning together by delivering results for our customers. Benefits & Perks At PowerSchool, we champion innovation, empower education, and recognize the incredible people who make it all happen. A career here means meaningful work, room to grow, and a supportive environment where your impact truly matters. Medical, vision, and dental insurance with HSA match Tuition reimbursement program 401k with contribution match Unlimited Discretionary Time Off Employee Referral Program Diversity, Equity and Inclusion The power to create energy and connectivity. Find a role where your work makes an impact every day. Browse Open Roles An important note on fraudulent job offers: What is recruitment fraud? Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam offering fake job opportunities to job seekers. This type of fraud is normally carried out through online services such as false websites, or through fake e-mails claiming to be from PowerSchool. We have seen an increase in scams against PowerSchool candidates. It seems individuals are being tricked to believe PowerSchool is requiring payment to progress in our recruitment process. We confirm this is something we will never do. PowerSchool does not offer positions through Facebook Groups, nor from free email services such as Yahoo mail, Gmail, etc. PowerSchool does not ask for any personal financial or banking information, or request payment from any prospective job seeker, student, or candidate for employment. PowerSchool does not request money for equipment nor ask for fees as part of its onboarding process. PowerSchool has a recruitment process managed through its own Talent Acquisition department and applications are evaluated by its Talent Acquisition team. All PowerSchool roles are listed on our website and all applicants must apply ONLY through https://careers-powerschool.icims.com/jobs/search. If you receive any unauthorized request for payment, suspicious or fraudulent offers, please contact us with ‘fraudulent job offer’ in the subject line at TA@powerschool.com

title: Big goals. Little egos.
text: Big goals. Little egos.We're an ambitious, progressive and inclusive bunch. Does this sound like you, too? Then we're in good company.See open rolesFrom tedious to delightfulWork should be inspiring. We go the extra mile (and then some) by making tedious spend management a delight, all while giving teams the freedom, autonomy, and control they need to achieve their mission. With full visibility and overview, everyone can work with confidence.Looking back at Pleo’s journey, there’s one thing that has stayed the same, and that’s ‘going beyond’. That’s why today our customers don’t just expense, reimburse, report, submit, or close the books. They Pleo it. All of it.Build brilliantly, care deeply, move swiftlyWe’re a team of over 850 people from over 100 nations, bound together by a desire to deliver ‘more than expected’ (it’s in our name). Plus, our Nordic nature means we’re inspired by sensible things like trust, autonomy, and the power of simplicity.As a collective of builders, we move with momentum and a keen eye on what’s ahead. We lead with care and trust you to own your impact, focusing on the mission rather than the hierarchy. We aren’t saying we’ve figured out this whole thing, and that’s okay. So we need people who aren't afraid to come in, build our future, learn from mistakes, and are brave enough to try new things. After all, we're all in this together.What we stand forWe champion the customerWe are driven by customer obsession. We not only listen to what our customers say, but we go further to uncover what they truly need.We make it happenTalking is nice. Doing is better. We take ownership, move fast, unblock barriers and focus on progress aligned with priorities.We succeed as a teamBeing a team isn’t about job titles or departments. It’s a mindset. We work together, ask for input, and challenge each other (respectfully).We build to accelerateWe aim high and move fast to grow and meet our goals. With great ambitions driving us forward, we test, iterate, learn and deliver forward-looking solutions.The perks of the jobCareer & growthWe simply believe in rewarding people for the value they bring and the work they do. This is supported through learning budgets to sharpen your skills, a culture of consistent 1:1s for coaching and impact, and a performance cycle that rewards great work as it happens.Health & wellbeingWe provide around-the-clock support and health insurance, including same-day mental health sessions through MYNDUP. We hope you never need them, but they’re there if you do. It’s the practical approach to making sure you’re taken care of.Time offWe believe in taking time off guilt-free because well-rested people do their best work. With flexible hours and a collective respect for personal time, we make sure that when you step away, you can fully disconnect and recharge.Extra perksAnd it doesn’t stop there. We’re all about community comforts. Weekly breakfasts, office lunch, Pleo Dinners, home office supplies for remotes… Just to name a few.Our open rolesWe are not looking for employees. title: Become a Postmanaut!
text: ← About PostmanBecome a Postmanaut!Join a global community on a mission to help build an API-first world.View Open PositionsJoin usWe are a hybrid workplace and diversity-focused company. We hire and retain the best talent from around the globe by reaching a wide breadth of communities and tapping nontraditional paths to find our ideal teammates.At Postman, we offer a carefully curated blend of world-class benefits so that you can maintain a healthy work-life balance and peace of mind. Your loved ones will thank you for joining us!View open positions →Our valuesAt Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication. We love to hear about our successes, but we value and appreciate the opportunity to learn and grow from each other's mistakes.Create with curiosityWe repeatedly ask, “Why?” and challenge best practices. At Postman, no star is too far to shoot for.Earn trustWe seek input first and listen before taking action. We're always open to perspectives because a diversity of thought and discussion improves our chances of discovering the best solutions.Embrace constraintsWe see constraints as an opportunity to be creative and resourceful with the people and tools we have available to us.Win togetherWe count on each other, always offer help, and focus on solutions. We are a hybrid workplace spanning the globe, but Postmanauts are part of a tight, trusting community that appreciates each person's contributions toward Postman's mission.Own & deliverWe learn from our mistakes and adapt with ease. We push ourselves to take bold but smart risks, and we celebrate failures for the learnings we gain as a result.Equal opportunityAt Postman, diversity means we implement informed policies and practices to grow a company that reflects global experiences and identities while treating each person with fairness and dignity.Inclusion is the choice we make each day and with every interaction, to foster a workplace and world where people of all backgrounds not only belong but excel. We understand that together, we succeed better.Postman is unapologetically committed to Equal Opportunity Employment. We proudly offer equal employment opportunities to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodations through the hiring process, please let us know early by emailing us here. Whether it's a boxing club membership, hula classes, or a longboard, we're here to cheer you on to get out and get moving. We'll reimburse you for activities and items that bring you joy through our wellness and fitness program.Career developmentWe support your career development by providing access to unlimited courses on Udemy and a book allowance. Enhance and uplevel your skills, and even learn something completely new!Postman off-sitesPostman off-sites bring our global team together to share unforgettable memories in inspiring locations. From our first company trip to Barcelona, these bonding events combine professional growth with cultural experiences unique to each city—strengthening team connection, curiosity, and innovation.Postmanaut Giving ProgramCommunity giving is at the core of our DNA. With the Postmanaut Giving Program, Postman supports your philanthropic efforts by matching your monetary contributions and volunteer hours to eligible organizations of your choice. Our process typically includes an initial conversation with our Talent team, followed by a deeper discussion with the hiring manager, a practical exercise relevant to the role, and a final interview focused on our values and how we work. We aim to keep things transparent, respectful of your time and reflective of the way we operate day to day.How long does the hiring process take? It varies by role, but on average our process takes around 27 days. We move quickly, while making sure there’s enough time on both sides to get to know each other properly.Will I receive feedback if I’m not successful? We do our best to provide thoughtful feedback wherever possible, especially for candidates who have progressed further in the process.Are you fully remote? Yes, Primer has been remote since day one. Our team works from 30+ countries, and we organise a company-wide retreat and team workations throughout the year to bring people together in person.Do you have set working hours? We value flexibility and autonomy, but we also prioritise collaboration. Teams align on working hours that allow for effective overlap.What kind of people thrive at Primer? People who are highly accountable, curious, serious about their craft and generous with their knowledge. We value low ego, high standards and a strong sense of ownership.What does “high accountability” mean in practice? It means taking ownership of your work end-to-end, following through on commitments and actively contributing to outcomes, not just tasks.How would you describe the pace of work? We move quickly and set a high bar. It can be challenging, but also deeply rewarding for people who enjoy ownership and impact.What opportunities are there for growth? Growth at Primer is driven by impact. You’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, expand your scope and shape your own path.How does compensation work at Primer? title: Help Us Modernize Spend Management
text: Help Us Modernize Spend Management Explore remote-friendly opportunities with Procurify.* You’ll work with people who are passionate, driven, and care about supporting others to reach their goals. *Security Notice: Procurify conducts interviews only through formal meetings arranged via @procurify.com email addresses. We do not interview via text or WhatsApp, and we will never request payment or banking information. Discover our open roles Alone you can go fast, together you can go far Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re looking for talented and team-driven individuals to join us on our journey to build a place where the best people want to work – a place where every team member is championed to do their best work, chase their dreams, and put their wildest ideas to the test. Learn more about the interview process We want to meet you with your best foot forward. To help you prepare, we’ve outlined what to expect in the interview process, along with some frequently asked questions. Interview process and FAQs Our core values Procurify’s values are our North Star. They help us decide what is right and what is wrong in situations that may seem unclear. Putting our core values first helps us make important decisions that move us towards our purpose, together. Commitment Commitment means earning our customers’ trust by being reliable, transparent, and delivering on what we promise. When we say we’re going to solve a problem, we make sure we do. Internally, commitment means we do what we say we’re going to do. We hold ourselves accountable, support our teammates, and take ownership of our work, knowing that we succeed as a team when we all bring our best to the table. Ambition Ambition means not settling for ‘good enough,’ taking initiative, and looking for ways to improve, whether that’s in the way we collaborate, how we serve our customers, or how we grow in our own careers. Resilience Resilience means adapting to change, embracing setbacks as learning opportunities, and staying solutions-focused. Our customers rely on us to help them navigate complexity, and internally, resilience means we support each other, grow through challenges, and keep moving forward. Change is constant, and we embrace it, support each other through it and grow from it. Excellence Excellence is about setting a high bar—not because we have to, but because we want to. We take pride in our work, we hold ourselves accountable, and we focus on delivering the best possible experience and product for our customers. Our customers expect (and deserve) best-in-class solutions, and we deliver. Excellence isn’t about perfection—it’s about continuously improving, being open to feedback, and always striving to do better, together. Simplicity Simplicity is a competitive advantage. Our customers don’t want more complexity—they want clarity, efficiency, and ease. Internally, simplicity means cutting through the noise, communicating clearly, and making sure that everything we do—whether it’s a process, a tool, or a decision—adds value instead of adding friction. It’s about working smarter, not harder, and making sure expectations are clear so we can all focus on what truly matters. How we show up for our team Remote-first As a remote-first organization, our team can work anywhere within Canada. Flexible work hours We don’t have set hours. You have the flexibility to work on the schedule that works for you and your team. Responsible time off We know there’s more to life than just work, which is why we offer generous Responsible Time Off for all of our team members. We encourage our team to take breaks, unplug and come back to work energized! Health benefits We prioritize our team’s health and wellbeing. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account. Stock options Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program. Financial wellbeing We provide Wealthsimple programs and access to financial advisors to support our team’s diverse life goals. Training and development Personal and technical growth are things that we value, so we provide access to Pluralsight, Masterclass, and progressive career matrices. Tech setup We make sure our team is equipped with the right tools and tech to set them up for success from Day One. Community initiatives We have a strong commitment to giving back to our communities, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns. DEI initiatives We run a diversity, equity, and inclusion roundtable monthly where we host guest speakers and tackle the topics that matter. Referral program It’s all about who you know. Our grand prize for our Referral Bonus Program is a bucket list vacation for two! Remote Team Do your best work from wherever you are As a remote-first company, we want to empower our team members with the flexibility to work wherever they choose. Although we put down our roots in Vancouver, Canada back in 2013, we have significantly expanded our team’s footprint since becoming 100% remote. Today, our team is made up of talented individuals spread across Canada, from Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Ottawa, all the way to Montreal, just to name a few. Community We care about our community From getting out and planting trees, serving hot meals, cleaning up our beaches, and hosting charity auctions, Procurify is all about supporting our wider community. Across the years, Procurify has worked with many different charities and advocated for a variety of causes close to our heart. Some of the things we have done in the past include Presents of Peace, charity auction events, charity trivia nights, and our Donate Your Day program. Being Yourself Diversity, equity, and inclusion at Procurify Everyone should feel safe at work, period. We are committed to building a safe and inclusive workplace, where every single team member feels welcome and empowered to bring their best, true self to work. We understand that education has a big part to play in DEI, which is why we host regular DEI roundtables with guest speakers to help our team grow and support this mission. What to expect from our interview process Our interview process varies depending on the role you are applying for and the level of the role. Consider this a general outline for a typical interview process. 1. Application review 2. Phone interview with the talent team 3. Interview with the hiring manager 4. Panel interview and/or technical interview 5. Offer FAQs Will I get notified if the role has been filled, or I didn’t make it through? Yes! We make sure to communicate with our candidates throughout every step in the process (whether you interview or not) so you are aware of where we are at in our hiring cycle. Will I have to go into the office? We are a remote-first organization - we do not require our team members to go to the office. However, if you are located in Vancouver, we have our office headquarters downtown which allows our team to go into the office if they choose. Since you are remote, how often does the team meet? We have team members all over Canada now! Twice a year, we bring all of Procurify together in Vancouver. This happens during our Procurify Summer Week and for our Holiday Party in December. We encourage our teams to meet with each other as they wish if they happen to live close to each other as well. Let’s do something great together Apply for one of our open positions today. See our open roles

Vas a trabajar en proyectos donde el backend tiene un rol central, participando en el desarrollo y evolución de soluciones robustas, escalables y seguras. Algunos de los desafíos incluyen llevar APIs a esquemas de disponibilidad 24x7, trabajando sobre resiliencia, escalabilidad, observabilidad y operación en producción; y desarrollar APIs y procesos batch que requieren altos estándares de seguridad y procesamiento de archivos, dentro de un contexto de medios de pago. Tecnologías Java 21 · Spring Boot 3 · Kafka · Kubernetes · Docker · AWS · GitLab · PostgreSQL · SQL Server · MySQL · APIs REST · Swagger · Spring Batch · mTLS · OAuth2 · ArgoCD También valoramos experiencia en arquitectura hexagonal, testing, observabilidad y experiencia previa en medios de pago o tarjetas. Requisitos Para posiciones Senior: +8 años de experiencia en desarrollo. Para posiciones Semi Senior: +5 años de experiencia en desarrollo. Experiencia con Java 21 y Spring Boot 3. Experiencia desarrollando APIs REST. Experiencia con Kafka, Kubernetes y Docker. Conocimientos de AWS y GitLab. Experiencia con bases de datos SQL. Experiencia con unit tests y tests de integración. Disponibilidad para trabajar 1 día por semana de manera presencial en Parque Patricios. ¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte! title: About
text: About Whether it’s crunching public adoption numbers to make a recommendation to product teams on new programming languages to support, helping marketing craft developer-friendly messaging or helping senior leadership understand emerging developer-led trends and their implications, RedMonk exists to help companies understand and work with developers. We see a different world than most. We see: A world increasingly dominated by the practitioner: the developer, designer, DBA, sysadmin or operator. A world increasingly driven by bottom up adoption of open source software and cloud based hardware. A world in which much of the software we deploy was built by Web companies. A world in which decision making is distributed and social. A world in which the kingmakers aren’t enterprise salespeople wearing expensive shoes and crisp blue cotton shirts, but hackers in t-shirts writing code. When we founded RedMonk in 2002, things were different. Other industry analyst firms were all about purchasing driven technology adoption, understanding dominant big vendors that sold software to a few senior executives in 18 month sales cycles, who then foisted their choices on to developers in the trenches. But we saw the change coming and helped the industry understand and prepare for it. With each year that passes, our thesis that developers are the New Kingmakers becomes less controversial. But even as the technology world has come around to the idea that developers are important, the question becomes: how best to engage with these new kingmakers? That’s what we do at RedMonk every day. If you’re looking for an analyst or research firm that understands developers, and is easy and fun to work with, we should talk. Don’t Take Our Word For It “RedMonk gets developers. And companies that build for them.” – Anurag Goel founder and CEO @Render “Best in the biz, bar none.” – Emil Eifrem founder and CEO Neo4J “Redmonk is more than just an analyst firm – they focus on building real relationships with clients, thoroughly digging into their long term vision and strategy and helping them to think through whether or not their short term strategy will help them achieve that. They also understand their focus areas better than pretty much anyone out their in the market. Their uniquely deep relationships across the industry enable them to give more thoughtful and tailored advice than any other firm I’ve seen thus far.” – Erica Brescia MD @Redpoint. Previously, COO @GitHub, co-founder and COO @Bitnami “I’ve worked with RedMonk at 3 different companies so far. Yes, they get developers. And yes, I would hire them again.” – Claire Giordano VP marketing Citus Data (acquired by Microsoft) Discussing if you should become a RedMonk client “That’s an easy yes.” – Mike Olson Cloudera co-founder “RedMonk gets developers.” – Adam Seligman VP Generative Builders, AWS “[RedMonk]…smart people who are living and breathing transparent production principles, and as a result are quite influential and should be getting more so.” – Luis Villa Co-founder Tidelift “Redmonk’s expertise in the developer market is unparalleled and they’ve been a fantastic partner as we looked to expand our awareness to the practitioner community. We’ve hosted two Redmonk webinars, and they’ve by far been the best-performing online events we’ve had in terms of pipeline, build and engagement. Rachel Stephens and the RedMonk team have been a dream to work with and we look forward to deepening our partnership.” – Melissa Beck, Head of Global Communications, Sumologic “RedMonk has been a fantastic partner to vFunction. We truly value their developer expertise, guidance on the best global conferences, and the insightful perspectives we’ve gained from their analysts on both the market and our strategy. We’ve collaborated on several activities, including webinars and video Q&As. A standout moment was a webinar featuring our CEO and James Governor—it was informative, entertaining, and became our best-performing asset last summer!” – Megan Bouhamama, VP of Marketing, vFunction “RedMonk, bridging both academia and industry, brought valuable depth and credibility to our Efficacy of Learning with AI panel at SIGCSE 2025. The session was a hit! RedMonk’s objective third-party insights enriched the discussion, helping to draw a packed audience of 105 attendees with standing room only. The thoughtful questions from the audience underscored the impact of the conversation, making it clear that this topic resonated deeply. RedMonk’s contributions fostered an engaging and enlightening dialogue, reinforcing the importance of AI in education and in supporting educators in this technological revolution.” – GitHub

text: Like solving complex problems? Exchanging healthcare data is much harder than it should be. Help us solve this problem while accelerating digital innovation in healthcare. View current openings Discover Support the human connection in health care As technologists, we have the power to facilitate something magical in the delivery of health care — that intimate moment when providers can harness insightful data, coupled with their medical expertise, to discover a solution for the patient. That’s the moment when technology can shine — as a graceful background accompaniment to an empathetic patient experience, helping providers perform better. Fight inefficiencies in data integration Healthcare organizations are tasked with increasingly complex decisions about which technology they’ll adopt. To provide the best outcomes, everyone needs to work from the same data. When data doesn’t integrate between providers and technologies that make data more useful, providers aren’t the only ones who suffer from that inefficiency. Patients are missing the tools they need to manage their own health. Integration challenges between critical and innovative software applications inhibit healthcare experiences. Redox provides an elegant, secure, and highly-scalable solution that eliminates these technical barriers. Join our battle cry to fight inefficiency as we invigorate the patient-provider relationship. Be part of the healthcare revolution and help us set the data free! Join the team Become a Redoxer Tackling healthcare interoperability requires commitment from our whole team—not just a commitment to solving problems, but to supporting each other as we navigate those challenges together. View current openings Employee benefits Keep your data flowing so you can bring innovations to life. Our promise We provide benefits that allow you to live life by your own design. Redox employees enjoy unmatched autonomy in their work and the support to live a balanced life. We trust you know what you need to be happy, at work and at home. Work anywhere We want to have the best people at Redox—no matter where you call home. All Redox employees are encouraged to live and work wherever they’re happiest. All you need is power, wifi, and a computer and you’re good to go. We’ve been remote since the beginning and will continue to be. Flexible time off Take a trip somewhere fun, stay home to recover from being sick, or have a staycation to unplug and recharge—we trust you to know what you need. Our best work happens when we feel fresh and inspired. We leave it up to you to decide when you need to take breaks and encourage you to make time for adventure and discovery. Parental leave As your family grows, it’s important that you’re there and have time to figure out what your family’s new norm is. You can take 16 weeks of paid time off within the first year of your new addition arriving. We know that they need you and we have your back. Rest and R^Charge In addition to our Flexible Time Off, we offer six weeks of paid leave for every five years of service for you to take a sabbatical. Take the time to recharge and do whatever you would like! Compensation and retirement In addition to competitive salaries, we offer employer matching on 401k retirement plans and provide all Redox Employees an opportunity for ownership through Stock Options and want you to share in the company’s success. Productivity stipend and wellness fund We want you to be able to set up a workspace that allows you to perform at your very best. All Redox employees receive an annual discretionary stipend so you can select what helps you be productive. Whatever it is, we want to make sure you have what you need. Finally, we provide a Wellness Fund for you to spend on anything you feel benefits your mental and/or physical wellness. Insurance from day 1 Working in healthcare makes you understand all the challenges life can throw at you. Your health and dental coverage starts when you do to make sure you’re always covered. We provide health and dental insurance for employees, spouses, domestic partners, and dependents along with 100% of premiums for Disability & Life Insurance. Our culture In order to do revolutionary things, we need a team of strong, diverse, mission-focused people. Whether we’re physically together or in our own little corner of the country, we are all focused on getting outcomes based on experimentation, data-driven decisions, and execution—and having some fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company with autonomous employees who act in ways that reflect our values every day. Our team is built on a foundation of trust and respect doing our part to make healthcare better. “When I first joined Redox, I was fresh out of undergrad.…I’ve grown from a timid developer to the tech lead of a small team. I was able to accomplish many things—not just because Redox allowed me to grow—but because Redox helped me to grow.” Dani Henkel Senior Software Engineer Our values We hire on the basis of values and coach people based on our values. They represent the foundation of our culture and how we want to interact with each other and the world. Read about our values Join our team Work from anywhere with other people who enjoy meaningful challenges. Become a Redoxer

text: Fullstack Developer Senior | Angular + Node.js (contractor)Bogota / LimaDesarrollo /Full-time /RemoteApply for this jobSomos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 15 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades? En redbee estamos buscando Developers Fullstack Senior para sumarse a un proyecto por 2 a 4 meses, trabajando como contractor de manera remota. Sobre el proyecto Te vas a sumar a un equipo que trabaja en la evolución de la aplicación nativa de un importante banco de la región.El proyecto abarca el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades, el mantenimiento y la modernización continua de la aplicación, trabajando tanto sobre la evolución de la experiencia de usuario como sobre la optimización de sus componentes técnicos. Vas a integrarte a equipos multidisciplinarios y participar de iniciativas de desarrollo, mantenimiento y modernización de la aplicación. ¿Qué vas a hacer? Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones asegurando escalabilidad, resiliencia y alto rendimiento. Implementar aplicaciones frontend con Angular 20 o versiones recientes, aplicando buenas prácticas y principios de Clean Architecture. Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas basadas en microservicios y BFF con Node.js y NestJS, asegurando eficiencia y confiabilidad. Diseñar, implementar y mantener APIs HTTP/REST. Trabajar con Docker ¿Qué esperamos de ti? Más de 4 años de experiencia trabajando con Angular 20 o versiones recientes y TypeScript. Experiencia en desarrollo backend con Node.js y NestJS. Experiencia diseñando, implementando y manteniendo APIs HTTP/REST. Conocimientos de arquitecturas basadas en microservicios y BFF. Experiencia utilizando Docker. Disponibilidad para trabajar como contractor durante un período de 2 a 4 meses. Residir en Chile, Perú o Colombia y contar con disponibilidad para trabajar de manera 100% remota. Intro callsWe start with a couple of conversations — one with your recruiter, one with the hiring manager. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.En redbee estamos buscando personas Senior Fullstack Developer para sumarse a proyectos diferentes, con desafíos técnicos vinculados a alta disponibilidad, APIs, procesos batch y medios de pago. Buscamos personas con experiencia sólida en Java y Spring Boot en backend y React en el frontend, que disfruten trabajar con soluciones robustas, escalables y seguras. Algunos de los desafíos que vas a encontrar incluyen llevar APIs a esquemas de disponibilidad 24x7, trabajando sobre resiliencia, escalabilidad, observabilidad y operación en producción; y también desarrollar APIs y procesos batch que requieren altos estándares de seguridad y procesamiento de archivos, dentro de un contexto de medios de pago. ¿Qué vas a hacer? Vas a trabajar en proyectos donde el backend tiene un rol central, participando en el desarrollo y evolución de soluciones robustas, escalables y seguras. Algunos de los desafíos incluyen llevar APIs a esquemas de disponibilidad 24x7, trabajando sobre resiliencia, escalabilidad, observabilidad y operación en producción; y desarrollar APIs y procesos batch que requieren altos estándares de seguridad y procesamiento de archivos, dentro de un contexto de medios de pago. Tecnologías Java 21 · Spring Boot 3 · React · Kafka · Kubernetes · Docker · AWS · GitLab · PostgreSQL · SQL Server · MySQL · APIs REST · Swagger · Spring Batch · mTLS · OAuth2 · ArgoCD También valoramos experiencia en arquitectura hexagonal, testing, observabilidad y experiencia previa en medios de pago o tarjetas. Requisitos +7 años de experiencia en desarrollo. Experiencia con Java 21 y Spring Boot 3. Experiencia desarrollando APIs REST. Experiencia con Kafka, Kubernetes y Docker. Conocimientos de AWS y GitLab. Experiencia con bases de datos SQL. Experiencia con unit tests y tests de integración. Disponibilidad para trabajar 1 día por semana de manera presencial en Parque Patricios, CABA. ¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte! title: Roadpass Digital - Career Page
text: About Roadpass Digital: Roadpass Digital is creating the leading technology platform for road-based travel and outdoor tourism. Through our brands, Roadpass Digital is focused on making it easier to experience, own, and maintain recreational vehicles as well as more easily discover, book, and navigate road trips. Learn about our family of brands at Roadpass.com. Why you should join our team: We pride ourselves on offering our employees a great work environment with generous benefits, competitive pay, and the opportunity to work with smart, motivated co-workers across the country, all united in our mission. We are growing and creating new opportunities regularly, so come check out what we have to offer! Flexible Workplace: While our headquarters are in Cincinnati, our team lives across the globe. We partner with our team to help them achieve personal and professional alignment, helping our employees to define their own blend of work-life balance.. Unlimited Vacation & Extensive Holiday Schedule: We believe this is a partnership and we trust our employees to build their own time-off schedule and encourage our teams to take time for their well-being. Collaborative & Inclusive Culture: Our employees work in small, self-organized and cross-functional teams that determine the best tactics to support the vision and strategy set by leadership. We encourage and welcome all ideas, taking an agile approach to creating an amazing product. Growth & Learning Opportunity: Through our Roadpass to Learning program, we offer both tuition reimbursement and upskilling programs. We also focus on career development within our teams through 1:1 Manager led conversations and hands-on learning to create endless opportunities. Focus on Well-Being: We pride ourselves on offering numerous benefit options to best fit the needs of our employees and their families, including domestic partners. Benefits include medical (PPO & HDHP-HSA), dental, vision, flexible spending account, commuter benefit, discount programs, life & disability insurance and accident insurance. We also offer a 401k program with company match and paid parental leave. Live your Passion: We believe in living our mission and vision, as a member of our team our employees enjoy a lifetime subscription to Roadpass! In addition to our Work-Detoured benefit which encourages and reimburses our team to live our brand by enjoying the outdoors and traveling. There are no open positions at this time.

The role of Director of Product, Consumer Frontend is to up-level Roblox UI both directly, with a Core UI team, and, indirectly, through capabilities provided by our Design Systems team. Your goal is to measurably raise the quality of our UI/UX across all surfaces, and unlock greater UI/UX capabilities for the company from a centralized, platform position. You’ll report to the Senior Director of Product for Apps. This role is based at HQ (no remote option open). You will: Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Consumer Frontend team which consists of Core UI and Luau architecture and Design System with tooling teams. Be the leader for common UI paradigms in the Roblox Consumer Application, providing thought leadership on Roblox UI for both end users and Creators. Invest heavily in relationship building and stakeholder management in order to drive UI standardization and design system adoption. Help define what success looks like for your teams and measure their progress towards it. Personally PM critical projects when required (hands on PM skills as well as management experience required). Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies in user interface design and gaming to inform product decisions. Research and deploy AI to drive efficiency and innovation at scale. You have: 10+ years of Product Management experience with expertise in shipping high-quality consumer products across multiple platforms. Experience defining, managing, or driving adoption of design systems, UI platforms or platform-wide UI changes. Expertise in navigating platform product development where internal engineers/designers are your primary customers. Deep experience in internal stakeholder management and alignment. Experience leading cross-functional execution with various teams including engineering, data science, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and policy, to conceptualize, develop, test, and launch impactful UI changes. Experience running complex, platform-wide AB tests and managing resultant trade-off conversations. The ability to clearly communicate roadmaps, priorities, experiments and decisions across a wide spectrum of audiences from partner teams to executive levels. Strong design sensibilities and a history of strong product to design working relationships. Demonstrated technical proficiency and effectiveness working closely with engineers. Experience with Luau, similar languages, and/or the React framework would be beneficial but are not required. A passion for gaming and a deep understanding of game UI or multi-platform UI delivery would be beneficial but is not a requirement. You are: A Product leader with a history of delivering high quality UI/UX work either directly or through a design system. Experienced, with 10+ years of product management experience or equivalent and a history of delivering across multiple platforms at scale. Analytical, with experience running complex AB tests to conclusion. Design-orientated with a passion for high quality user experiences. An excellent communicator and documenter, with fantastic listening, verbal, and written communication skills. You’re at home understanding and communicating an overarching vision at the 30k-foot level and diving into technical specifications, individual tradeoffs, and priorities. Entrepreneurial, having worked in a fast paced environment, with competing resources and priorities, through the product life cycle from planning, development, through to launch and continuing support. You love to get things done. Organized, understanding that the best way to build something great is through the joint efforts of many people. text: Computer Vision EngineerBuenos AiresRYZ Labs – Engineering /Full Time - Contract /RemoteApply for this jobContract directly with the clientRemote - Full-time Only for candidates based in Latam We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer. Ryz Labs is partnering with a client building an AI-powered platform for automated quantity takeoff in heavy civil and highway construction. As a Senior Computer Vision / ML Engineer, you'll own the “what is it?” problem—identifying materials, surfaces, and construction features from engineering drawings, PDFs, aerial imagery, and satellite imagery. You'll work closely with another engineering role focused on geometry and measurement, turning your detections into reliable, priceable quantities. What You'll Do Build CV/ML pipelines for engineering drawings, PDFs, aerial and satellite imagery. Extract information from both vector and raster PDFs, including degraded/scanned drawings. Develop detection and segmentation models for materials and infrastructure such as asphalt, concrete, pavement, drainage, pipes, signs, guardrails, and lane markings. Combine information from drawings, specifications, and imagery, identifying discrepancies between sources. Build the ML infrastructure around the models: labeling, datasets, evaluation, regression testing, confidence, and provenance. Work directly with domain experts to create ground truth and improve the system. Prioritize reliability and completeness—“not determinable” is better than a low-confidence guess. What We're Looking For Required: 5+ years building and shipping production Computer Vision / ML systems. Strong Python and PyTorch experience. Production experience with detection and segmentation on real-world imagery. Experience with aerial, satellite, drone, or comparable raster imagery. Strong knowledge of OpenCV and classical CV techniques. Experience with messy, domain-specific data and human-in-the-loop systems. Understanding of PDF internals, vector geometry, and/or document AI, or the ability to learn quickly. Strong written and verbal English. Nice to have: Experience with geospatial imagery, construction, document AI/OCR, CAD vectorization, or autonomous vehicle perception. 3D experience with photogrammetry, point clouds, terrain/surface models, or cut & fill. Experience across both document vision and aerial/geospatial CV. Apply for this jobRYZ Labs Home PageJobs powered by

title: RYZ Labs - Client Service Engineer Lead
text: Client Service Engineer LeadArgentinaRYZ Labs – Engineering /Full Time - Contract /RemoteApply for this jobLATAM - Contractor Fully Remote - Long-Term Client Service Engineer Lead – Solutions Management Our client helps organizations solve complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action and delivering lasting value. The company actively promotes an inclusive working environment and recognizes the value that diversity brings to its people, clients, and communities. It is committed to continually improving its initiatives, policies, and practices to foster authenticity, professional growth, and equity. What You’ll Do The Client Service Engineer Lead is a technical role that bridges client support, custom development, and platform implementation. You will serve as a technical subject-matter expert for enterprise platforms, delivering hands-on support and tailored solutions that drive client success. This role requires an engineer who is already proficient in developing software with AI coding agents and can apply multi-agent workflows, spec-driven development, and parallel execution to deliver client solutions from day one. Key Responsibilities Platform Implementation and Client Support Serve as a technical subject-matter expert for enterprise platforms, providing implementation guidance and troubleshooting support during client launches and deployments. Work alongside clients during training and go-live activities, executing implementation tasks and resolving adoption blockers in real time. Develop and deliver technical training, best-practice documentation, and configuration guides tailored to client use cases. Track and communicate adoption metrics, including instances launched, users onboarded, and time to value. Custom Development and Configuration Implement custom configurations, scripts, and lightweight development solutions to meet client-specific requirements, including dashboards, API integrations, data transformations, AI-agent configurations, and web-based applications. Write and maintain full-stack code for client customizations and internal automation tools. Architect and build web-based solutions tailored to client needs. Coordinate with development teams on client-specific integrations, API customizations, and feature requests. Develop workarounds for platform limitations and advocate for product enhancements based on recurring client needs. Technical Support and Issue Resolution – L2/L3 Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues across enterprise platforms and client environments. Perform detailed root-cause analysis through SQL queries, log reviews, and systematic troubleshooting. Implement short-term workarounds and contribute to long-term fixes. Manage incidents from end to end, including reproducing issues, assessing impact and priority, coordinating cross-functional resolution, validating fixes, and communicating outcomes to stakeholders. Escalate issues appropriately to Engineering and Product teams while maintaining ownership of client communication and resolution tracking. Support production incidents and urgent deployments in accordance with secure deployment processes. Documentation, Knowledge Management, and Automation Create and maintain knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, and best-practice documentation. Ensure technical content remains current with product releases. Identify patterns in support tickets and recommend product or process improvements supported by data and evidence. Automate repetitive support tasks through scripting and workflow automation to improve efficiency and reduce resolution times. Contribute to quality-assurance activities, including test automation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing coordination for platform updates. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Implementation teams to drive issue resolution and product improvements. Participate in customer-success reviews and post-implementation check-ins to identify adoption opportunities and technical risks. Mentor junior support team members and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives. Required Experience and Technical Skills — Must-Haves - Strong hands-on experience developing software with AI coding agents in real-world projects. You should be able to independently plan, execute, review, and validate agent-assisted development work from day one. - Practical experience with multi-agent workflows, including breaking down engineering tasks, delegating work across agents, coordinating dependencies, and reviewing and integrating their outputs. - Experience with spec-driven development: translating requirements into clear specifications, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria that guide AI agents and support reliable delivery. - Ability to manage parallel engineering workstreams, coordinating agents and development tasks while maintaining context, resolving conflicts, and ensuring consistent implementation quality. - Strong engineering judgment when working with AI-generated code, including reviewing changes, debugging issues, validating behavior through testing, and taking ownership of the final result. - Advanced knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), including hands-on experience implementing MCP-based integrations or tools. - Full-stack development proficiency and the ability to build and maintain web applications across front-end and back-end technologies. - Strong expertise in API design and integration, with demonstrated experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and webhooks. - Experience using AI tools and APIs to build AI-powered client solutions. - At least five years of hands-on experience in technical support, customer-success engineering, or SaaS operations. - At least five years of SQL experience, including writing queries, analyzing data, and troubleshooting data-related issues. Candidates must be able to discuss concrete examples of multi-agent workflows, spec-driven development, and parallel delivery they have personally implemented. Familiarity with AI tools or occasional use of coding assistants alone is insufficient for this role. Nice to Have Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language for backend development and scripting. Experience with front-end frameworks such as React or Vue. Experience with ServiceNow, ticketing systems, or support-management platforms. Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or logistics. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Apply for this jobRYZ Labs Home PageJobs powered by

This is an opportunity to help build AI-powered products, focusing on crafting intuitive, polished, and delightful user experiences. The ideal candidate is passionate about leveraging the latest AI coding tools to accelerate development, improve productivity, and build high-quality products. Basic Qualifications: • Strong experience building modern frontend applications. • Expertise with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React). • Excellent eye for detail, UI polish, and user experience. • Experience using AI coding tools as a core part of the development workflow. • Familiarity with AI products and LLM-powered applications (prompting, AI workflows, integrations, etc.). • Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate on new ideas. • Strong communication and collaboration skills. • Product-minded approach with a passion for creating exceptional user experiences. Key Responsibilities: • Build and maintain modern, high-quality frontend applications. • Design and implement intuitive, user-centric interfaces for AI-powered products. • Work closely with product and design teams to create seamless user experiences. • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, etc.) as part of your daily workflow. • Translate product ideas into polished, responsive, and scalable interfaces. • Continuously improve usability, accessibility, and overall product quality. • Collaborate across engineering and product teams in a fast-paced environment. text: AI EngineerDubaiRYZ Labs – Engineering /Full Time - Fixed Term /RemoteApply for this job Ryz Labs is looking for an AI Engineer to work with one of our clients, a company in the real estate investment industry that develops AI-powered solutions to automate and optimize investment processes, including deal sourcing, financial analysis, due diligence, and portfolio monitoring. They work with real estate investment funds, institutional investors, and family offices to help them make better, data-driven decisions. This is an AI engineering role with a forward-deployed edge. You'll split your time between: 1. Building our core AI systems: the agents, pipelines and evaluation infrastructure behind the company 2. Deploying them with clients: working embedded with real estate private equity funds, institutional investors and family offices to solve their hardest problems with AI You write production code, ship it and own it. On client work you partner with our GTM team: they open the door and frame the problem, you scope, build and deploy the solution. What you learn in the field goes straight back into the platform, so every deployment makes the product better. What you'll do: • Build agentic systems: multi-step agents, tool use and workflows that handle real investment work: sourcing, underwriting, due diligence, IC memos and portfolio monitoring • Own the AI stack: RAG and document pipelines, model routing across frontier and open models, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs into Excel and IC formats • Make it trustworthy: build evals and observability for accuracy, cost, latency and reliability. In finance, every number has to trace back to source • Build reusable infrastructure: connectors, data pipelines and components that make each new deployment faster than the last What we are looking for: • 3+ years shipping production software, ideally in Python and/or TypeScript • Deep hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: agents, RAG, tool use, evals and context engineering (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP or similar) • Strong grasp of the AI landscape: which models to use for what, and how to trade off accuracy, cost and speed • Solid ML fundamentals: evaluation, problem decomposition, and knowing when not to use an LLM • A builder's track record: founding engineer, early startup hire, ex-founder or ex-CTO, or a top engineering team where you owned outcomes end to end • Comfortable in front of clients. You can explain technical trade-offs to a fund partner, then go and build it • Fast and pragmatic. title: RYZ Labs - Technical Solutions Engineer
text: Technical Solutions EngineerArgentinaRYZ Labs – Engineering /Full Time - Contract /RemoteApply for this jobTechnical Solutions Engineer Our client helps organizations solve complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action and delivering lasting value. The company actively promotes an inclusive working environment and recognizes the value that diversity brings to its people, clients, and communities. It is committed to continually improving its initiatives, policies, and practices to foster authenticity, professional growth, and equity. What You’ll Do The Technical Solutions Engineer is a technical role that bridges client support, custom development, and platform implementation. You will serve as a technical subject-matter expert for enterprise platforms, delivering hands-on support and tailored solutions that drive client success. This position combines direct client support during launches and implementations with custom development responsibilities, including API integrations, AI tooling, and web-based solutions. You will manage the complete lifecycle of technical issues and custom requests—from initial diagnosis and root-cause analysis to temporary workarounds and permanent fixes—while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams. This is a high-impact and technically challenging opportunity for an engineer who enjoys problem-solving, client engagement, rapid learning, and delivering measurable business value. Success in this role directly contributes to customer adoption, retention, and platform revenue. Key Responsibilities Platform Implementation and Client Support • Serve as a technical subject-matter expert for enterprise platforms, providing implementation guidance and troubleshooting support during client launches and deployments. • Work alongside clients during training and go-live activities, executing implementation tasks and resolving adoption blockers in real time. • Develop and deliver technical training, best-practice documentation, and configuration guides tailored to client use cases. • Track and communicate adoption metrics, including instances launched, users onboarded, and time to value. Custom Development and Configuration • Implement custom configurations, scripts, and lightweight development solutions to meet client-specific requirements, including dashboards, API integrations, data transformations, AI-agent configurations, and web-based applications. • Write and maintain full-stack code for client customizations and internal automation tools. • Architect and build web-based solutions tailored to client needs. • Coordinate with development teams on client-specific integrations, API customizations, and feature requests. • Develop workarounds for platform limitations and advocate for product enhancements based on recurring client needs. Technical Support and Issue Resolution – L2/L3 • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues across enterprise platforms and client environments. • Perform detailed root-cause analysis through SQL queries, log reviews, and systematic troubleshooting. • Implement short-term workarounds and contribute to long-term fixes. • Manage incidents from end to end, including reproducing issues, assessing impact and priority, coordinating cross-functional resolution, validating fixes, and communicating outcomes to stakeholders. • Escalate issues appropriately to Engineering and Product teams while maintaining ownership of client communication and resolution tracking. • Support production incidents and urgent deployments in accordance with secure deployment processes. Documentation, Knowledge Management, and Automation • Create and maintain knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, and best-practice documentation. • Ensure technical content remains current with product releases. • Identify patterns in support tickets and recommend product or process improvements supported by data and evidence. • Automate repetitive support tasks through scripting and workflow automation to improve efficiency and reduce resolution times. • Contribute to quality-assurance activities, including test automation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing coordination for platform updates. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Implementation teams to drive issue resolution and product improvements. • Participate in customer-success reviews and post-implementation check-ins to identify adoption opportunities and technical risks. • Mentor junior support team members and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives. Required Experience and Technical Skills • At least five years of hands-on experience in technical support, customer-success engineering, or SaaS operations. • Full-stack development proficiency and the ability to build web-based applications across front-end and back-end technologies. • Strong expertise in API design and integration, with demonstrated experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and webhooks. • Advanced knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), including experience implementing MCP-based integrations or tools. • At least five years of SQL experience, including writing queries, analyzing data, and troubleshooting data-related issues. • Experience using AI tools and APIs to build AI-powered client solutions. Core Competencies • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and independently. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt technical explanations for developers, business users, and executives. • Customer-first mindset and a strong sense of ownership. • Commitment to driving client success, adoption, and measurable outcomes. • Ability to learn new platforms and systems quickly. • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent issues while meeting response-time expectations. • Comfortable working proactively in fast-paced and ambiguous environments. Nice to Have • Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language for backend development and scripting. • Experience with front-end frameworks such as React or Vue. • Experience with ServiceNow, ticketing systems, or support-management platforms. • Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or logistics. • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
