title: Work For Thorn - Thorn
text: Careers Our cause is our code Ready to make an impact? See Open Positions Our mission to transform how children are protected from sexual abuse and exploitation is deeply embedded within our core — a shared code that drives us to do challenging work with resilience and determination. As a nonprofit that uses technology to transform child protection, we offer the best of both worlds. Our culture of innovation will challenge you to continually develop your skills while building groundbreaking solutions that allow us to achieve our mission. We collaborate with the sharpest minds from tech, nonprofit, government, and law enforcement, and influence decisions that impact children across the globe. You’ll witness the real-world impact of your work as you create solutions alongside colleagues with top skills and unique perspectives. Join us and take your place among some of the best hearts and minds as we build a world where every child can be safe, curious, and happy. The employee experience Our values of trust, inclusion, and resilience form the foundation of our employee experience. These values are expressed in four unique ways. Critically committed Our mission to transform how children are protected from sexual exploitation and abuse is our top priority and the driving force behind everything we do. Whole-istically human There is humanity in our mission, in how we treat each other, in our lives, in our work, and in our culture of wellness, care, and compassion. Transformational tech We are an unstoppable force—resting but never quitting. Constantly improving, challenging, adapting, and solving problems with technology and programs that drive positive change in children’s lives. Purposeful growth Combining our organizational stability with teamwork and passion, we create a foundation for individuals to become better versions of themselves together. Unique, people-centered benefits Remote first Work from the comfort of anywhere, inside the continental United States, with flexible schedules that revolve around you, a technology stipend to cover your home office needs, and occasional in-person team meet-ups. Mental well-being Company paid wellness support inclusive of therapy, coaching, trauma-informed counseling, and more. Matched 401(k) Invest in your future and financial well-being with our matched support. Health benefits & paid leave Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your dependents as well as paid leave to grow your family, care for your loved ones and care for yourself. Generous time off Adventure and rest how you see fit with flexible PTO and generous company time off, including a fall and winter break. Plus, a 6-week paid sabbatical after 4 years tenure. Learning & development A professional development budget to support your continued growth. Our culture We take immense pride and satisfaction in our work toward a safer world for children. The work we do every day drives tangible and meaningful results. Although this requires resilience, we add levity to our day-to-day by fostering a supportive work environment where every person is afforded the space to work hard and rest well. One TEAm. one mission. A workplace where fairness, respect, and opportunity thrive. At Thorn, we believe that varied perspectives and experiences make us stronger and are essential to our mission. Thorn is committed to building a high-performing team dedicated to our mission while fostering a workplace where every individual has equal opportunities to grow, where people are treated with respect, and where all team members feel valued and able to contribute fully. WELLNESS COMMITMENT Equipped for the journey. We foster an environment of wellness, care, and compassion. Our employees’ personal and professional well-being is key to our strong and resilient workforce. Supporting our team with wellness groups, individual coaching, and a connected community full of compassionate colleagues is vital to the sustainability of our work. FLEXIBLE WORK MODEL Work that works with you. As a remote-first organization since our inception in 2012, we’ve mastered how to create a connected culture and community that embraces teamwork and collaboration. We value and recognize that our human experiences—family, health, adventure—are important and necessary. We provide the autonomy and flexibility to succeed both individually and collectively. Career with Cause: Hear from our team Learn about a career with Thorn from the people whose passion drives our mission — the Thorn team. Together, we blog about our unique culture, what inspires us to do what we do, and how a career here is unlike anything you’ve experienced. 3 min read Life at Thorn Meet the Team: A Conversation with Melissa Stroebel At Thorn, we bring together the best hearts and minds from tech, child protection, business and nonprofit fields to create powerful products and programs to defend children from sexual abuse. […] Read Article 4 min read Life at Thorn Prevention Meet the Team: A Conversation with Dr. Rebecca Portnoff Dr. Rebecca Portnoff, Head of Data Science at Thorn, shares more about her career and what working to defend children with tech is like. Read Article 3 min read Life at Thorn 10 Wellness Tips for World Mental Health Day Once you know about child sexual abuse, you can’t un-know it. In order to stay resilient in the fight to defend children from sexual abuse, protecting mental health is paramount. Read Article After three years, Thorn continues to be my dream job that I wake up excited for every morning. It is the rare intersection of cutting-edge technology, wonderful and passionate people, and a meaningful impact on the lives of those we serve. David R-S, Sr. Data Scientist Working at Thorn is a highlight of my career. Not only do I get the opportunity to make global impact everyday, but I work with such brilliant and wonderful people. Thorn takes such great care of its employees through wellness benefits and professional development — I can’t think of anywhere else I would rather work. Ariana, External Affairs Senior Operations Manager EXPLORE ROLES Open positions

title: Careers
text: CareersWe are Time DoctorTime Doctor, co-founded by remote work trailblazers Rob Rawson and Liam Martin in 2012, is a game-changer in the productivity software realm. Our cutting-edge solution empowers individuals to achieve their best performance, no matter where they work. With a worldwide, distributed team spanning 40 countries and over 250,000 active users who swear by our product's ability to enhance visibility, profitability, and employee engagement, Time Doctor is on the forefront of driving workplace transformation.View open positions Why choose Time Doctor? Elevate productivity Companies utilizing Time Doctor experience an average productivity boost of 22%. Our software's impact speaks for itself. Top-ratedRanked as the #1 employee monitoring software on the esteemed G2 review platform, Time Doctor sets the standard for excellence. Proven successOur clients consistently achieve remarkable user adoption rates and rapid returns on investment.Unleash your potential with Time Doctor Boost performanceThousands of global enterprises and SMBs rely on our automated time tracking and workday analytics software to unlock performance and nurture a thriving company culture. Transparent insights into employee productivity, engagement, task alignment, and work-life equilibrium are just a click away. Foster autonomyTime Doctor empowers employees through self-directed time tracking, personalized KPI dashboards, and strategic prompts that keep distractions at bay. It's a force multiplier for autonomy and trust-building.Ready to embrace remote innovation?At Time Doctor, geography is no barrier to greatness. Our team spans the globe, enjoying the perks of flexible schedules and asynchronous workflows that champion true work-life harmony. We've mastered effective communication and collaboration in the virtual space. Join us in a dynamic work environment where creativity thrives, ideas matter, and continuous professional growth is a given. Your journey to revolutionize remote work starts here. 44different nationalities 150employees worldwide RemoteFully remote environment 280kactive usersView open positions Our core valuesAt Time Doctor, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. With a global team, we embrace flexible schedules and asynchronous workflows, allowing for true work-life balance. We’ve perfected remote communication and collaboration, creating an environment where creativity flourishes and every idea is valued. When you join Time Doctor, you’ll step into a dynamic, innovative workspace focused on continuous professional growth. Ready to help revolutionize remote work? Your journey starts here! Remote RockstarExcel in the remote work environment Self-guided MissileWork independently without requiring guidance Teamwork TitanExcel at collaborating with othersView open positions Our hiring process Step 1Application and recruiter screenWhat to ExpectThe start of our application process is the same for all of our roles. We're keen on understanding you better. All information you share with us is reviewed securely and treated as confidential.How to ExcelStart by thoroughly reviewing the role's requirements and keep them in mind during our discussions. When communicating, prioritize clarity and conciseness. Highlight the most crucial aspects and include only pertinent information.We're eager to witness your enthusiasm in action. Share inspirational content that resonates with you. If you're involved in any communities, don't hesitate to share about them. Anything that sheds light on why you're passionate about your work—we're all ears.Also, during the recruiter evaluation, we gauge your cultural fit with our team. Step 2Technical interview with hiring managerWhat to ExpectWe love connecting with people who believe in our mission of Accelerating the world’s transition to remote work. At this stage, an interview will help us both decide whether the interest is mutual, and understanding if you have the technical skills to succeed in the role. How to ExcelWhen highlighting your accomplishments, provide the utmost specificity and incorporate success metrics. This approach allows us to grasp the extent of your impact.We have a strong affinity for innovative ideas. Embrace the opportunity to explore uncharted territory and showcase your expansive thinking while communicating with us. Don't hesitate to mention team achievements either—teamwork and collaboration are vital proficiencies within our environment.To prepare you for the upcoming stages, leverage the insights, advice, and feedback provided by our People Acquisition team throughout the process. Step 3Tasks and challengesPutting your skills into practice.Get ReadyIt's time to put your skills to the test in real-world scenarios. Whether it involves tackling a technical assessment, participating in a role-playing exercise, or crafting a presentation to address a challenge, we're excited to see you in action.Our CommitmentOur challenges are thoughtfully crafted to showcase your expertise. They're not intended to catch you off guard and will always align with the demands of the role you're seeking.Should any aspect of your task necessitate preparation, rest assured we'll provide ample advance notice for you to get ready.The time allocated for your challenge is intentional, and we never expect you to accomplish the impossible within that time frame. Step 4Team interviewWhat to ExpectAs we progress, get ready for a collaborative exchange with our team. This is your chance to engage in insightful discussions, share your perspectives, and connect with potential future colleagues.Our CommitmentThe team interview phase is designed to foster open dialogue. We're not here to stump you; rather, we're eager to uncover your thought process and how well you'd integrate with the team.Should any specific preparation be required, you'll have ample time to gear up.Just as before, the allocated interview time is purposeful, and we have realistic expectations that respect the timeframe.We're looking forward to diving into meaningful conversations and exploring your compatibility with our team dynamics. Step 5Final interviewOnce you've had the opportunity to meet our team and we've engaged in meaningful conversations, it's a pivotal moment for both you and us to determine if Time Doctor is the perfect fit.For those progressing to the final interview phase, our People Acquisition team will provide valuable insights and preparatory advice in advance.Our feedback will be candid, spotlighting your strengths as well as areas with room for enhancement.Rest assured, we won't rush you into an immediate decision. You'll always have the freedom to step away and contemplate your choice at your own pace. A final noteAbout the processPlease note for some roles the process can vary, for example the task may come before the interview, or be skipped entirely.Rest assured, we won't rush you into an immediate decision. You'll always have the freedom to step away and contemplate your choice at your own pace.Work from home storyWork life at Time Doctor Work from anywhere 30 days PTO Sabbatical Global and diverse team Flexible working hours Parental leave & paid leaves of absenceView open positions FAQWill you let me know when a role has been filled?If you’re in the interview process and the role you’re applying for gets filled, we’ll always let you know. Jobs are immediately taken down from all platforms when they’re filled or when we are no longer accepting new applicants.Can I apply for multiple jobs?Yes, you can apply for multiple roles. It’s also worth noting that if we see your application come through for one role and think you’d be better suited for another, we’ll tell you.How many jobs can I apply for at once?We suggest applying for no more than two to three jobs at a time.I interviewed/applied last year and wasn’t selected. Can I reapply?Yes, absolutely. We’d love to reconnect, especially if you received positive feedback.I’ve applied for a tech role, what does the technical interview involve?All technical interviews involve a take-home task that will test your capabilities with any technologies you will be working with in the role.Do you consider past candidates’ applications for future openings?If we think a candidate has potential for future positions, we’ll keep them in mind for future roles and be in touch. How long does the process take?From submitting your application to accepting an offer, the process usually takes four to six weeks. It’s sometimes less depending on the role.Are we going to use a Time Tracker?Yes, everyone in the company uses our very own Time Tracking Software, this comes with two major reasons. Firstly, for payroll purposes. Secondly, for us to experience the app first hand and report issues faced before putting the app version to public use.How is payment delivered?Depending on where the staff is located, we use different payment methods. For local currencies — we use Wise (Wise.com). For USD Transfers — we use Payoneer.What type of contract do you offer?Since we are a remote company, we offer a Consultant Agreement to our hires with full-time hours (160 hours monthly).Any other questions or concerns?Don’t hesitate to reach out to our People Attraction Team: people@timedoctor.comYou can also head to our Careers page to find out more and access a full list of our open roles.

text: Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Third Iron builds software to benefit libraries and their users. Our products focus on simplifying finding, discovering, and reading peer-reviewed research. Our main users are the librarians and the many researchers they support at research organizations big and small, all around the world. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications. If you have any questions about joining our remote-first company, which has been a fully distributed team since our company's start in 2011, either ask as part of the job application, or email us at [email protected] About Third Iron Third Iron, LLC is a leading information technology company developing innovative services that benefit libraries and their users. Third Iron services include BrowZine, LibKey Discovery, LibKey Link, LibKey Nomad and LibKey.io. Founded in 2011 as a remote-first company, Third Iron products are used by researchers from over 1,500 corporation, hospital, university and government libraries in more than 35 countries. Third Iron is a Minnesota, USA, company, but our software development team is distributed throughout the USA. For more information, check out our products at https://thirdiron.com , or try out one of our products: BrowZine or LibKey There are no open positions at this time.

We just shipped Customized Images for Linux builds to take that pain away. Instead of reinstalling the same dependencies every run, you can now bake your environment into a reusable image (defined from your .travis.yml), let Travis store it, and then just reference it in future builds. text: Senior Full Stack Engineer (581)Remote# – PP /Full-time /RemoteApply for this jobInfo on the Senior Full Stack Engineer (581) role Ready to take the next step in your international career? We can support you! Ubiminds is a GPTW-certified, people-first company that partners with American software product companies to scale their global teams. We curate top LATAM talent and connect professionals with long-term, high-impact opportunities while providing full employer-of-record support. In this role, we are seeking an experienced Senior Fullstack Developer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, building resilient backend systems, and crafting responsive web applications. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, scaling, and maintaining core platform capabilities and web interfaces used by millions of learners and institutions worldwide. Challenge In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning, technical ownership, and continuous improvement. As a Senior Developer, you will design, build, and support high-scale backend services and user interfaces across this product ecosystem. You will lead multi-sprint technical initiatives, produce clear technical specifications, write high-quality code in C# and JavaScript/TypeScript, and leverage AWS infrastructure to ensure platform stability. You will also have opportunities to mentor team members, collaborate with product and support teams, and contribute to initiatives that directly advance our core values and elevate engineering standards across all teams. Responsibilities: Software Engineering & Architecture: Write production-grade code using C# for backendservices and JavaScript/TypeScript (including Node.js, React, or modern JS frameworks) for webapplications. Design scalable, fault-tolerant component architectures and APIs. Technical Design & Planning: Produce detailed technical specifications for multi-sprint projects,including cost work-item breakdowns and architectural trade-off evaluations. Actively seek peerfeedback through technical design reviews. Cloud Architecture & Integration: Develop and deploy services leveraging Amazon Web Services(AWS). Partner with DevOps and Cloud teams to ensure optimal performance, resource efficiency,and security across environments. Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, enforce coding standards, andmaintain automated unit, integration, and debugging test coverage across the code base. Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor mid-level and junior developers, foster a culture of technicalrigor, and partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, and QA to deliver customer-centricfeatures. Customer Empathy & Operational Support: Periodically partner with support teams to investigatecomplex tier-three technical escalations, ensuring a deep understanding of customer pain pointsand real-world usage. Mandatory Skills: Advanced English level is a must! Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, orequivalent practical industry experience. Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering complex,customer-facing applications in a production environment. Backend Expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in C# (or strong Java experience with a provenability to transition to C#) and object-oriented design principles. Frontend & JavaScript Ecosystem: Proficiency in JavaScript and modern variants/frameworks(TypeScript, Node.js, React). Cloud Infrastructure: Solid working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) core services(e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch). Core CS Fundamentals: Strong foundational knowledge of data structures, algorithms,asynchronous programming, distributed systems, and relational databases. Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal technical communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) and building single-page applications. Hands-on experience developing and maintaining public or enterprise RESTful APIs andmicroservices. Background working in a high-scale SaaS or cloud platform environment. Familiarity with educational software ecosystems, Learning Management Systems (LMS), orenterprise integration standards (SAML, OAuth2, LTI). Team & Environment: - Distributed, international engineering team. - Strong ownership culture — engineers drive solutions end to end. - Focus on modernization, automation, and developer experience. - High autonomy to propose and implement improvements. - Collaborative environment with direct impact on engineering velocity. About Ubiminds Our Culture People First. We are all about people! Challenge yourself. There’s always room for improvement and continuous improvement is in our essence. Make it happen. Be ready to take challenges as they come. It’s all about attitude and commitment. We’re in this together. We work as a team, thrive as a team, and evolve as a team. Averaging on awesome. We work hard to deliver high-quality services and look forward to exceeding expectations. Keep it real. We promise you honesty, transparency, and openness, regardless of the situation. Perks and Benefits As a Senior Fullstack Engineer @Ubiminds, you: - You are placed in a product-based company, with the same treatment as their full-time employees. - Have our full back-office support, from career guidance to HR and concierge services. - Enjoy our remote-first policy – we are a distributed team, after all. - Get your own MacBook (none of that "bring your own device" stuff here). - Have access to growth opportunities with other amazing technology professionals, through tech talks, chapter meetings, and even remote happy hours for tons of fun! - Improve your English through free lessons with a native English speaker - get to the next level on your communication skills! - Candidate Referral bonus (promote Ubi to your tech friends, and get paid for it!) - Miss working in the office? Our cool Florianópolis headquarters is available, whenever you want, with weekly quick massages & tasty snacks, soft drinks, and games How our process works 1. Interview with Tech Recruiter (chat about the job opening and your experiences) 2. Client process (this may vary) 3. Offer (yay)We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Build the future of Umbrel.
text: CareersCareersApplyOpen menuCareersBuild the future of Umbrel.Our most important work lies ahead of us, and you can be a part of it.Join usThe cloud made life convenient. It also took our data away. The personal computer gave us computing on every desk. The personal server will give us freedom in every home. We're here to power that shift. And to make it delightful. How we workWe are a small, focused team. Every person here has an outsized impact on our product and our culture. When you join us, you're not just taking a role. You're directly shaping Umbrel's future.01Fully remote.Async written communication daily, and a single weekly all-hands meeting. We optimize for long chunks of deep, focused work.02Everyone has a say in everything - design, code, copy, strategy.We care about what's right, not who's right. Clunky setup, admin-first dashboards, scary networking gymnastics. We're designing the consumer-grade, app-first, OS-in-a-browser experience that feels familiar and effortless, not instructional.01Taste is a feature.Clarity over cleverness, restraint over knobs. Micro-interactions and motion exist to communicate, not perform. If it doesn't reduce cognitive load, it goes.02Making a browser tab feel like an OS is hard.The medium fights you. But that's the bar: every interface, every dialogue, and every experience should reinforce "this is my machine and my data lives here".03Do not overwhelm. But don't underwhelm.Start with sane defaults that create an obvious path, then progressively reveal depth exactly where it's needed.04Umbrel Home and Pro are a part of the interface: unbox → first-boot → "aha" in minutes.Hardware and software move as one. Fewer moving parts, boring tools, clear boundaries. If future-us can't reason about it in five minutes months later, it isn't world-class yet.01User-first, not tech-first.Start with the problem and reverse-engineer the simplest solution. Technology itself is a means, not the mission. No "cool stack" detours. Prototype, validate, then choose the right tool that wins for users.02Readable, maintainable code is the ultimate optimization.Small modules, clear boundaries, typed interfaces, and tests that actually fail when they should.03The cost of a mistake is high.Unlike a SaaS that can be hot-patched on a server, every bug ships to thousands of umbrelOS devices via the next OTA.04Users store their lives on Umbrel.Assume hostile networks and design for least privilege and secure defaults.01User-first, not tech-first.Start with the problem and reverse-engineer the simplest solution. Prototype, validate, then choose the right tool that wins for users.02Readable, maintainable code is the ultimate optimization.Small modules, clear boundaries, typed interfaces, and tests that actually fail when they should.03The cost of a mistake is high.Unlike a SaaS that can be hot-patched on a server, every bug ships to thousands of umbrelOS devices via the next OTA.04Users store their lives on Umbrel.Assume hostile networks and design for least privilege and secure defaults.How to applyWe don't post roles.If you've read this far and it feels like yours, whether you design, write code, build hardware, run supply chains, tell stories, or do something else entirely, we want to hear from you. Write to jobs@umbrel.com and tell us three things:01Why UmbrelWhat draws you to this mission, and what would you want to own here?02Why youShow us something you've made: portfolios, side projects, the thing you're proudest of.03Why nowWhy is this the right moment, both for you and for us?Attach anything else that helps us see your work, like your CV, work experience, links, or just whatever tells your story best.Email jobs@umbrel.comFrequently asked questionsWhy Umbrel, and why now?People want privacy, ownership and control over their data, and fewer subscriptions.The cloud benefits from economies of scale mostly in compute sharing, not as much in storage. Storage in the cloud is rent forever (plus egress), while local storage is a one-time cost with zero egress and near-instant performance.Legacy NAS companies assume you enjoy DDNS, ports, volumes, and acronyms. Most people don't. There's a big gap for a consumer-grade, app-focused, OS-level experience.AI models keep getting smaller, smarter, and specialized. Running inference near your data is private, responsive, and cheap. A personal server is the natural home for that future.Have you raised money?Yes, we raised $3.4M and are fortunate to be backed by some of the top Silicon Valley investors, including Naval Ravikant, Joseph Jacks (OSS Capital), Sahil Lavingia (shl.vc), Sam Lessin (Slow Ventures), Anne Dwane (Village Global), Andreas Antonopoulos, Owen Gunden, and more.What are the benefits of working at Umbrel?A decent chunk of equity w/ cash compensation.Worldwide health insurance.New work equipment + an Umbrel Home/Pro, of course.Work from anywhere in the world.Complete autonomy at work.Learning and development stipend.Flexible work hours.Minimum 3-weeks of paid time off.What's the interview process like?We'll start with a quick video call to make sure we're on the same page. After that, we'd love to chat with you in-depth regarding the specifics around the job position over another one or two video calls, followed by a quick and fun challenge or a task.Next, our preferred situation is that we get to work together for 2 to 4 weeks on a project (of course, we'd pay you whatever you think is fair). Often working together for a bit is a great way to determine whether there's a good match as future teammates and it can give you a lot of transparency. We're flexible with how much time you can allocate to the project and when you want to work on it. However, we understand that it's not always possible for everyone, so we're open to figuring something else out in such case.What are you looking for in candidates?Talent, passion, genuine love for your craft, and the desire to do meaningful work. What we're not looking for: credentials and degrees.When you really love what you do, work feels like play. And when work feels like play, you become the best at it. That's what we're looking for.What's work-life balance like at Umbrel?All of us enjoy complete freedom to create our own work schedules and work from anywhere in the world. Most of our team communication is async. You won't find endless Zoom calls or full calendars here. Just a calm, creative group of humans enjoying challenging problems at the intersection of art and technology.As a result of being a startup, we wouldn't want to hide this reality from you: raw hours make a big difference on the impact we can make right now. This won't always be the case, but it is at present. So we often find ourselves working later on in the evenings and sometimes on weekends, but it's mostly driven by personal ambition. We don't have any expectations from anyone to do so.

You own problems end to end: you sit with the people who have them, decide what to build, direct agents to do much of the implementation, and stay accountable for what ships. Code is cheap now. Judgment isn't. We care less about how many lines you write and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible output, design contracts that hold up, and say no to complexity the problem doesn't need. Our stack is full-stack TypeScript: Next.js, Prisma and Postgres, running on Google Cloud. Location: Remote. Time-zone overlap: CST. Compensation: USD 6.000 per month This job is exclusive to getonbrd.com. What you'll do Work directly with PMs and the company's departments to understand their problems, then turn them into scoped, shippable solutions.Build features across the stack: Next.js (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions), Prisma and Postgres.Orchestrate several AI coding agents in parallel. Break work down, write the specs and context they need, review their output critically and own the result.Improve our agent harness: the prompts, tools, context, guardrails and evals that make agents reliable on our codebase.Design the contracts between frontend and backend, and keep them stable as the product evolves.Review code, human or AI-written, with a focus on authorization, data integrity, payments and privacy.Help shape how our engineering team works as AI changes what an engineer's day looks like. What we're looking for 5+ years building production web applications, with real ownership of systems on both frontend and backend.Strong TypeScript, Next.js, Prisma and Postgres. You understand the server/client boundary, caching, and how schema and query design affect the product.You work with AI agents as a lead, not a typist. You run several agents on real work, know where they fail, and catch what they get wrong before it ships.You've improved an agent harness at your current job: better context, tools, rules, review loops or evals that measurably changed agent output. Tell us what you changed and what it fixed.You're curious about how your role is changing with AI, and you have opinions about it.You're comfortable with non-technical stakeholders. You can ask the right questions, push back on the wrong solution and explain trade-offs in plain language.Good technical taste: you prefer simple, boring solutions and delete code as readily as you write it.Professional English for daily written and spoken work. Benefits and how we communicate 15 PTO days + your country holidays + Sick days Good communication is non-negotiable for us. We love communication, and we dislike meetings that could have been a Slack message.Async first. Most of our work happens in writing. When async isn't enough, we jump on a quick huddle instead of letting a thread drag on.Share progress often. Post updates, blockers and decisions without being asked. title: It Takes Exceptional People to Build VGS
text: JUST ANNOUNCED VGS second-annual Agent Connect 2027! Apply to AttendIt Takes Exceptional People to Build VGSVGS has been solving the toughest challenges in payments. We don't just secure transactions; we power over a third of the world's e-commerce transactions and are a platform trusted with over 10 billion tokens globally, but we're just getting started.We've built and continue to evolve a powerful platform that gives businesses ownership, control, and insight into their payment data. Achieving that takes real talent.Ready to shape the future of payments?View All Open RolesView Engineering RolesToday, some of the world's most recognized Fortune 500 and innovative AI companies trust VGS to protect their most sensitive payment data. But we're not just securing payments as the world's leader in tokenization. We're also the trusted platform enabling agentic commerce. We're empowering businesses to unlock new possibilities in an ever-evolving payment landscape, from streamlining compliance to enabling smarter, faster innovation. Working at this scale, with this level of trust, is what pushes us to keep raising the bar.9B+Tokens stored1/3VGS powers a third of e-commerce transactions10B+Monthly interactionsWhat We Look For In Every TeammateWe're a remote-first company looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS. We invest in our people the same way we invest in our platform: with a long-term mindset and a commitment to getting better every day.Remote-First On PurposeVGS is a remote-first company, which means our teams are built to work well from anywhere, not just tolerate it. We hire the best people regardless of location, invest in the tools and stipends to set up a great home office, and default to async communication so no one is boxed out by time zones. Whether you're fully remote, hybrid, or prefer coming into an office, our processes, meetings, and culture are designed with remote as the baseline, not the exception.EMPLOYEE BENEFITSOur BenefitsFinancialCompetitive salary and early equity, an internet stipend, and in-office set-up stipend (US only)Retirement401(k) plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting (US only)Health and wellnessMedical, dental, and vision insurance, HSA/FSA options, life, disability, and pet insuranceVacation and time offUnlimited PTO, paid national holidays, and a global parental leave programProfessional developmentLearning stipends, promotion from within, lunch and learns, team events and summitsOffice life and perksRemote and hybrid options, flexible working hours, weekly office lunches, employee discount platformEngineering positionsReady to build and ship solutions with purpose?Join a team of engineers solving hard problems in data infrastructure, with real ownership, modern tools, and high impact.View Engineering RolesOPEN POSITIONSDiscover OpportunitiesOur InvestorsInside VGS, the innovative payments company quietly powering 1/3 of e-commerce"VGS is working with some of the largest frontier AI labs & enterprise merchants - and they're hiring"View NewsletterHear from Our TeamVGS was born in a cafe in downtown San Francisco. Ten years ago, we were two engineering leaders who had just exited our YC-backed company to Stripe. Looking for new challenges, we worked alongside early customers to rethink how sensitive data flows across the web, developing our tokenization and vaulting architecture from scratch.Today, VGS powers payments infrastructure for the world's most recognizable brands, holding 9 billion records in our vaults and handling 10 billion events every month. Operating at this scale is a profound responsibility. We built VGS for high-agency engineers who want ownership, leverage, and hard problems. If you're an ambitious builder ready to shape global payments infrastructure, come build the future with us.Marshall JonesCTO & FounderSelling VGS means selling trust. Our customers are putting their most sensitive data in our hands, and that changes every conversation. I get to work with a team that genuinely believes in the product, understands the problem deeply, and isn't afraid to have honest conversations with customers. That's rare, and it's why I enjoy my work.Austin ClarkDirector of SalesBuilding product at VGS means constantly balancing complexity with simplicity. Payments and compliance need to feel invisible to users of the VGS platform. I get to work closely with engineering and customers to solve problems that actually matter, and see the impact almost immediately.Emma RandlettSenior Product ManagerLearn about VGSVGS is a payments data platform that helps companies manage, own, and control their sensitive data without having to store it on their own servers. But that is only one part of the VGS story.Learn More

title: Experience Insights brings new insights to the Citrix® platform
text: Experience Insights brings new insights to the Citrix® platform Improve user experience and security with Experience Insights, formerly uberAgent, providing in-depth visibility into user experience, system performance, and security across physical and virtual endpoints. With Experience Insights, IT administrators and architects get rich metrics for operations, IT security, SLA compliance, size and capacity planning, and license compliance across their entire environment. The lightweight agent provides detailed information about applications, networks, and more so admins can easily diagnose and fix issues for faster time to resolution. Experience Insights can monitor Citrix as well as non-Citrix workloads so you can consolidate vendor sprawl and gain a more holistic picture of your environment. Integrated with Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud, Experience Insights data can be used with Splunk AI to automate processes and detect risky events. Whether you are using Citrix DaaS, NetScaler®, web and SaaS applications within the browser, or any other Citrix platform capability, Experience Insights tracks reliability and performance along with deep security visibility. Product documentation: Experience Insights Find detailed guides, new release information, and troubleshooting resources for all Experience Insights releases. View Experience Insights product documentation Deep insights across your whole enterprise Monitor a wide range of metrics across your environment with one lightweight agent Data-driven insights Monitor and optimize sessions, machines, and web apps Gain deeper insight into sessions, machines, and web apps across your environment. Experience Insights includes digital experience scores, which analyze data from application, session, and machine performance, so you can easily gauge performance and experience. Issue resolution Simplify troubleshooting Resolving one issue for a single machine may be simple, but when the issue affects dozens or hundreds of computers, Experience Insights simplifies the process of finding correlations. With high-quality data from your entire environment, you can easily drill down to find the root cause of any IT issue. Capacity planning Maximize your IT resources Track resource usage and average session footprints so you know when you need to upgrade your capacity or when you have unused resources. Experience Insights can also track application usage, which can be used for license audit use cases to see if you're over- or under-licensed, or to determine which applications need to be considered in a migration plan. Application security Secure configurations Experience Insights conducts periodic checks to ensure secure configurations for line of business applications, improving your application and operating system security consistency. You can even customize your checks to verify your state against your own security and compliance policies. Risk mitigation Detect threats ahead of time The Threat Detection Engine from Experience Insights detects threats and risky behavior using granular data from machines, applications, and users. You can trace every process, analyze call chains in real time, and track network connections per user, network target, application or endpoint. See how Experience Insights help Protect sensitive business information Secure your employees, IT environment, and content with analytics intelligence. Deliver incredible experiences to users on any device Elevate the user experience when delivering virtual apps and desktops, even over challenging networks. Implementamos metodologias ágeis por toda a empresa, buscando nos conectar com as formas mais inovadoras e colaborativas de trabalho. title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer(Angular, React.js, or Vue.js / C#, .NET, Java, Node.js, or Python)
text: Skip to content Senior Full Stack Software Engineer(Angular, React.js, or Vue.js / C#, .NET, Java, Node.js, or Python) Job Description We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 6+ years of software development experience in Angular, React.js, or Vue.js and C#, .NET, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python/FastAPI to join our U.S. client’s engineering team. In this role, you will play a key role in building the technology that powers our client’s customers. You’ll work hands-on from back-end services and data architecture to front-end applications to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-friendly software. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, QA, and fellow engineers to design creative solutions, improve system performance, and enhance how customers operate every day. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, mentoring others, and making a meaningful impact through technology that truly matters. Our client is a U.S. fintech software company offering innovative banking solutions that improve operations and members’ financial lives. The company has grown steadily since its inception over thirty years ago counting nearly 300 financial institutions across the United States, U.S. territories, and the Caribbean as customers. Backed by a large private equity company, our client is a recognized market leader helmed by financial industry veterans. Responsibilities Technical Leadership Architect scalable, secure, and maintainable systems across back-end, front-end, and database layers Lead design discussions, code reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives Evaluate new technologies and guide the adoption of tools that improve developer productivity and system performance Define and document architecture patterns, design principles, and shared libraries for reuse across teams Partner with DevOps to design efficient CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and observability tooling Software Development Build high-quality, production-ready features using modern frameworks and cloud platforms Write clean, testable, and efficient code following established coding standards and contributing to their evolution Optimize system performance, reduce technical debt, and improve reliability Collaborate with QA engineers to develop automated testing strategies and ensure high code coverage Participate in production support rotation and proactively drive root cause analysis and prevention with QA engineers to develop automated testing strategies and ensure high code coverage Collaboration & Mentorship Mentor and coach mid-level and junior engineers to foster career growth and skill development Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions Provide feedback and guidance during design and implementation reviews Promote a culture of continuous learning, clear communication, and shared ownership across the team General Duties Complete assigned development and project tasks by due dates while maintaining a high standard of quality Work collaboratively with engineers, product managers, and QA across departments to deliver cohesive solutions Act as a technical resource and subject matter expert in your assigned product domain Contribute to process improvements, documentation, and internal tooling to enhance engineering efficiency Success Looks Like First 30 Days Build an understanding of the client's architecture, domain, and codebase Complete onboarding and deploy your first contributions with mentorship Participate in planning and architecture discussions, bringing forward improvement ideas By 60 Days Lead a small-to-medium-size feature from design to production Build strong cross-functional relationships with other engineers, QA, and product managers Begin mentoring mid-level engineers, providing code review and technical guidance By 90 Days and Beyond Serve as technical owner for a significant domain or service Drive architectural improvements and influence long-term technology direction Enable your team to ship high-quality, maintainable code faster and more confidently title: Sme špecialisti na online technológie, ktorí sa rozhodli pracovať v slobodnej firme a baví nás to. Našou prednosťou je efektívna práca v tíme.
text: O násSme špecialisti na online technológie, ktorí sa rozhodli pracovať v slobodnej firme a baví nás to. Našou prednosťou je efektívna práca v tíme.SlužbyNáš tímHodnotyWebikon príbehTechnológieKariéraČo všetko robí WebikonTvoríme webové a mobilné aplikácie a pomáhame našim klientom rásť v online svete. Zabezpečíme hladký priebeh od prvého náhľadu dizajnu, po spustenie a následnú podporu a údržbu celého projektu. Či už potrebujete web, aplikáciu, e-shop alebo revíziu existujúceho projektu.WebstránkyVytvárame webové stránky na mieru podľa potrieb vášho biznisu. Navrhujeme ich tak, aby boli čo najefektívnejšie z pohľadu použiteľnosti a atraktívnosti, ale aj rýchlosti a bezpečnosti. Po spustení máte plnú kontrolu nad všetkým obsahom na webe. Samozrejmosťou je plná integrácie so SEO štandardami. Samotný web bude jednoduchý na používanie ako pre jeho návštevníkov, tak pre vás ako správcov.Pozrieť projektyWebové aplikácieTieto aplikácie väčšinou tvoríme ako takzvané Progressive Web App, čo nám umožňuje implementovať funkcie ako offline režím, push notifikácie, alebo oveľa rýchlejšie používateľské rozhranie. Majú rôzne využitia pre intranetové aplikácie, finančné aplikácie alebo aplikácie na prehľadnejšiu prácu s rôznymi typmi dát a ich analýzu.Pozrieť projektyHybridné mobilné aplikácieNaše skúsenosti s JavaScript sme tranformovali aj do projektov pre natívne mobilné aplikácie. Interaktívne push notifikácie, biometrické overovanie a podpisanie, či komplexná správa stavu aplikácie, či už je online alebo kompletne offline, to všetko vieme zahrnúť vo vašej aplikácií.Pozrieť projektyAutomatizácia pre e-commerceVďaka našim integráciam pre banky, dopravné služby a fakturačné systémy, sme umožnili tisíckam e-shopov a miliónom ich zákazníkov v česko-slovensku a zahraničí prijímať platby kartou, automaticky vystavovať faktúry, alebo integrovať fullfilment pre skladový systém a dopravu.Pozrieť projektyTvorba špecifikácie a odborné konzultácieJe dôležité zakladať dizajnové, ale aj technické rozhodnutia na dátach a výstupoch z ich analýzy. Preto poskytujeme naše know-how v tejto oblasti a radi vám poradíme s porjektom.Pozrieť projektyUX a UI návrhVytvárame interaktívne prototypy na základe používateľskej analýzy, alebo vám pútavo navrhneme celý web. Máme skúsenosti s dizajnovaním webov, ale aj s rozhraním pre mobiné aplikácie. Všetko podľa najnovších trendov v dizajnérskom svete a s ohľadom na potreby použivateľov.Pozrieť projektyPravidelná údržba a dohľadKaždý web, či aplikácia si aj po spustení vyžaduje, pravidelný monitoring a údžbu. Bezpečnosť a výkon riešenia určite patria medzi top priority.Pozrieť projektyServerová infraštruktúra a hostingStarosti o to, kde by ste mali hostovať váš web alebo aplikáciu, môžete tiež nechať na nás. Vieme vám navrhnúť optimálnu serverovú konfiguráciu. V prípade potreby vieme tiež zabezpečiť prevádzku a údržbu hostingového riešenia priamo u nás, alebo cez našich hostingových partnerov.Pozrieť projektyPodporaTechnológie sa neustále vyvíjajú a prichádzajú nové aktualizácie. Na to všetko dohliadneme a budeme sa starať aby bol náš výsledný produkt vždy pripravený plniť svoju úlohu plnohodnotne s ohľadom na všetky novinky v technologickom svete.Pozrieť projektyBudujeme inovatívnea zmysluplné riešenia.Pridajte sa k nám. Ozvite sa námWebikon tímSme tím nadšencov, ktorí sa spojili, aby prinášali do online sveta digitálnu dokonalosť. Naša práca je založená na dlhoročných skúsenostiach, vedomostiach, ale aj neustálej chuti učiť sa nové veci.Naše spoločné projektyJán BočínecObchodný a tímový koordinátorMarek DaňkoTímový a projektový koordinátorPeťo DaňkoProjektový manažérPavol CabanSenior developer a QAŠimon CihraFull stack developerBoris DaňkoTester a junior frontend developerMartin TomášekDizajnér a UX špecialistaBoris KakutaFull stack developerPeter NemčokKonzultant a manažér pre PlatobneBrany.skKeď netvoríme weby, tvoríme zážitkyPríbeh značky WebikonPozrite si, aké boli naše začiatky a ako sa formovala značka Webikon. Aké momenty nás posilnili a kde všade ste nás mohli vidieť a zažiť.Zobraziť viacLegendárny teambuildingV decembri sme sa stretli na chate v Polomke. Navarili sme guláš, debatovali a vzdelávali sa. A urobili si parádne fotky.Zobraziť viacPrekonávame svoje limityTeambuilding sme tentokrát poňali trochu netradične a spojili sme ho s účasťou na 100. Medzinárodnom maratóne mieru v Košiciach.Zobraziť viacSme tím špecialistov, ktorí sa postarajú aj o Váš projektNapíšte nám! Chcem online stretnutieNaše hodnotyNaše hodnoty tvoria základ našej firmy a staviame na nich dlhé roky. Sme presvedčení o tom, že sústredenie sa na tieto hodnoty nám pomáha prispievať k lepšiemu fungovaniu v tíme a s našimi partnermi.EstetikaStojíme za funkčným a jednoduchým dizajnom. Dizajn, ktorý je prehľadný a zároveň dostatočne odvážny, aby vynikol. Naše návrhy reprezentujú potreby klientov a dávajú produktom zásadný charakter.TransparentnosťTrváme na čestnej, otvorenej a férovej komunikácii. Máme radi za živú a zdravú diskusiu. Dôverujeme si a spoliehame sa jeden na druhého. Dodržiavanie jasne daných povinností a dohôd je polovicou úspešnej spolupráce.VášeňBaví nás spoločná práca na projektoch, ktoré nám dávajú zmysel. Robíme všetko preto, aby náš zápal pre online svet bol inšpiráciou pre ostatných.RešpektNavzájom sa podporujeme a povzbudzujeme v tom čo robíme. Vítame rozmanitosť názorov a potrieb. Dbáme na gendrovú, vekovú a geografickú diverzitu v tíme.PartnerstvoNeustále sa od našich klientov a jeden od druhého učíme a hľadáme cesty ako efektívnejšie spolupracovať. Naše procesy sú od začiatku transparentné a vždy preberáme zodpovednosť za našu prácu.RovnováhaNaša práca si vyžaduje intenzívne sústredenie a veľa komunikácie, čo je vyčerpávajúce. Preto sa radi medzi sebou rozprávame o dôležitých veciach, ktoré prežívame, alebo plánujeme. Vytvárame priestor pre čo najviac spoločného voľného času.Naše hodnoty uplatňujeme v práci, ale aj v životeLSTME 2023Opäť raz sa konalo sústredenie pre všetkých nadšencov do elektroniky a technológií. Ako sa účastníkom podarilo naprogramovať vlastné hry a vyvinúť ovládače, pomocou ktorých si ich zahrali?Zobraziť viacČarovná TerchováV tomto strhujúcom príbehu sa dozviete, ako sme skoro stratili kolegov v Terchovej a v čom výrobcovia stolových escape room klamú na obálke.Zobraziť viacOpen Source – kvalita dodávaná komunitouPrečo máme radi Open Source a sme mu verní od začiatku nášho pôsobenia? Aké sú jeho najväčšie výhody a je jeho používanie bezpečné?Zobraziť viacSme tím špecialistov, ktorí sa postarajú aj o Váš projektNapíšte nám! Chcem online stretnutieHello world, we are Webikon!Náš príbeh začal ešte predtým ako sme vedeli, že Webikon bude existovať.V roku 2007 založil Vladimír Gábor diskusné fórum, ktoré riešilo rôzne technologické témy a podporu pre WordPress.Ako prispievatelia na fóre sa stretli aj Peter Nemčok a Ján Bočínec, ktorí neskôr položili základy Webikonu. Podarilo sa im vytvoriť silnú komunitu WordPress na Slovensku a v Čechách a vypracovali sa na majstrov vo svojom obore. Svoje hobby pretavili do práce a dodnes prinášajú svetu webových technológií veľký prínos práve cez značku Webikon.2008Prvé meetupy a vznik WordPress komunityKomunita WordPress sa rozrastala a stále viac ľudí sa obracalo na fóru s prosbami o vyriešenie problému. V roku 2008 prevzal Peter Nemčok preklad WordPress do slovenčiny pod seba. Komunita sa začala stretávať aj offline a tak začali prvé meetupy.Tak ďaleko do minulosti už naše zdroje nesiahajú, ale ak máte záujem zaspomínať si na niektoré z meetupov minulých rokov, možete si ich pozrieť tu.2009Prvé črty značky WebikonPribúdali ľudia, ktorí začali prejavovať záujem o WordPress a potrebovali poradiť. Preto sa Jano a Peťo spojili a začali rozmýšlať nad značkou Webikon a ako pomáhať v online svete naplno.2009Spustenie webu webikon.skSpustili sme náš prvý web. Vyzeral úplne inak ako dnes, ale my sme naň boli patrične hrdí. Pozrite sa ako vyzeral.2012Vznik spoločnosti Webikon s.r.o.Postupne nám bolo jasné, že na projekty, ktorých stále pribúdalo sami nestačíme. Zaregistrovali sme firmu Webikon s.r.o., aby sme mali viac možností ako komerčne fungovať. Pribrali sme k sebe ďalších ľudí a začali sa po nás obzerať aj zvučnejší klienti.2012Prvý Webikon deňNáš tím pracoval z rôznych kútov Slovenska a Česka a boli sme v kontakte len online. Chýbali nám ale osobné stretnutia, a tak sme zaviedli Webikon dni. Hlavnou témou programu bol väčšinou chod firmy. Nechýbali ani školenia a prednášky o tom, čo nové sa deje vo svete WordPress.2012Prvý WordCamp SlovenskoWordPress nadšenci sa stretli na úplne prvom WordCampe na Slovensku, kde boli hlavnými organizátormi Peťo Nemčok a Jano Bočínec. Konal sa v Žiline a zožaľ veľký úspech, čo potvrdili hlavne reakcie účastníkov.Zaspomínajte si s nami a prečítajte si ako to vyzeralo na úplne prvom WordCampe Slovensko.2013Prvý WordCamp Europe LeidenNemohli sme si nechať újsť úplne prvý WordCamp Europe, na ktorý sme sa vybrali ako Webikon tím. Zobrali sme to z hurta a urobili si road trip autom. Videli sme prvý krát WordCamp takéhoto rozmeru, čo nás povzbudilo ďalej budovať komunitu aj tu na Slovensku.2013Organizovanie WordPress kurzovZa niekoľko rokov aktívneho používania WordPress sme nadobudli obrovské know-how a chceli sme ho posúvať ďalej. Tak vznikli naše kurzy, ktoré boli zamerané na používanie WordPress a všetko okolo toho. Kurzy sa diali v online priestore, ale aj offline.2014Projekt SynergieKeď sa Synergie ako špecialisti v oblasti riadenia a rozvoja ľudských zdrojov rozhodli postaviť svoj web na WordPress, oslovili nás, čo sa rozvinulo do spolupráce, ktorá trvá dodnes.Web odvtedy prešiel viacerými dizajnovými aj funkčnými zmenami, vylepšila sa integrácia na komplexné HR riešenie RECRU a pribudol k nemu aj web S&you, ktorý slúži na vyhľadávanie talentov zväčša pre odborné a manažérske pozície.2015Projekt HabitatPrvý web, ktorý odštartoval našu spoluprácu s Habitat for Humanity sme pripravili na základe dizajnov od našej partnerskej agentúry Lighting Beetle, ale tam to všetko len začalo.Počas týchto rokov sme vytvorili rôzne weby pre regionálne pobočky po celom svete a pripravili sme aj generickú šablónu, ktorú vedia používať pri tvorbe ďalších podobných webov.2015Chata Banská ŠtiavnicaWebikon dni sa neskôr pretrasformovali na Webikon chaty a úplne prvá sa konala v Banskej Štiavnici. Hostil nás coworking našeho kolegu Andreja, ktorý sa aktívne zapájal v miestnej komunite. Na Andreja veľmi radi spomíname ako na tímového kolegu ale hlavne dobrého človeka.2015Powerlogy projektPowerlogy ako stále rastúca firma so zdravou výživou a potravinami, ktoré sú pohladenie nie len pre žalúdok, ale aj myseľ, potrebovali špecializovaný dohľad nad ich eshopom. Od začiatku našej spolupráce už ubehlo niekoľko rokov a prešli sme si viacerým redizajnami a vylepšeniami.2016HB ReavisHB Reavis hľadal špecialistov na WordPress a úspešne ho našiel. Po code review ich existujuceho webu sme sa rýchlo dohodli na ďalšej spolupráci, ktorá viedla k vacerým projektom.Aktuálne sa dlhodobo staráme o celý web HB Reavis, pripravili sme pre nich aj Intranet, ktorý využívajú zamestnanci a dlhodobo spravujeme web pre Nivy Centrum, čo je obchodné stredisko spolu s autobusovou stanicou, ktorú zastrešuje HB Reavis.2016WordCamp Europe ViedeňAko ostrieľaní WordPressáci sme si nenechali újsť ani WordCamp Europe vo Viedni, kde sme boli ako spoluorganizátori a dobrovoľníci. Bola to zaujimavá skúsenosť vidieť zákulisie tak veľkého stretnutia nadšených ľudí pre technológie. Okrem iného radi spomíname na afterparty, kde sme boli riadni štramáci.2017WordCamp BrnoJano Bočínec bol na brnenskej WordPress scéne známy a bol hlavou organizačného tímu nejedného slovenského WordCampu. Tak sa pustil do organizovania prvého Wordcamp Brno, ktorý zožal veľký úspech.2017Iné možnosti ako WordPressWordPress nám dlhé roky poslúžil a bola to láska na prvý kód. Ako čas ubiehal a naše know-how rástlo, tak sme začali cítiť potrebu pridať do nášho technologického stacku aj robustnejšie backend frameworky, či oveľa viac používať headless architektúru projektov.Prestali sme robiť len obyčajné weby a vrhli sme sa aj do vývoja webových a mobilných aplikácií, čo umožnilo ešte lepšie pokryť potreby našich klientov.2018WordCamp KošiceV roku 2018 si náš tím z východu zobral pod seba oraganizovanie WordCampu v Košiciach a dopadlo to na jednotku. Nadupaný program plný prednášok a perfektná afterparty aj s pozeraním hokeja, keďže boli majstrovstvá sveta.2018Prechod na dev boardOrganizácia a plánovanie práce v rastúcom tíme je extrémne dôležitá. Preto sme sa rozhodli pre pridanie DEV boardov do našej Asany a zmenili štruktúrovanie taskov, čo sa nám veľmi osvedčilo pri našich projektoch a pracujeme s tým dodnes.201910. výročie WebikonuAni sme sa nenazdali a Webikon tu je celých 10 rokov. Roky plné výziev, zaujímavých projektov, teambuildingov, WordCampov.Na všetko toto sme si spoločne zaspomínali a oslávili, že stále môžeme tvoriť lepší online priestor s našimi projektami. Užili sme si čas so všetkými, ktorí boli súčasťou Webikonu a podielali sa na jeho ceste a tešíme sa na ďalšie roky.2020Prvá mobilná aplikácia na React NativeNaše dlhoročné skúsenosti s tvorbou webových aplikácií v PHP a WP sme pretavili do tvorby našej prvej PWA aplikácie postavenej čisto na Reacte v kombinácii s Gatsby. Mobilné aplikácie nás začali ešte viac baviť a na React Native sme pre nášho dlhoročného klienta Across postavili hybridnú aplikáciu, ktorá je dostupná na všetkých 3 platformách – natívne na Android/iOS aj ako web aplikácia.2021Popandemická Webikon chataPandémia neobišla nikoho z nás a aj keď pracujeme všetci z domu, v roku 2020 sa nám nepodarilo stretnúť ani na teambuildingu. Ale 2021 rok všetko napravil a my sme si užili parádnu Webikon chatu. Zdolali sme martinskú feratu, povozili sa na motokárach a užili si skvelé jedlo.2021Redizajn Webikon webuAko sa hovorí: 'Obuvníkové deti chodia bosé'. A tak aj my ako webová agentúra sme sa pristihli, že náš web už nie je také pohladenie pre oko a treba ho redizajnovať. Spojili sme sily a vykúzlili krásny, nový Webikon web, ktorý sme začali napĺňať ďalším obsahom a článkami.2022Tech Talk s Ferom VoláromZačiatok roka 2022 sme odštartovali spolu s Ferom Volárom v Tech Talks. Rozprávali sme sa o tom, kde má WordPress svoje hranice a Jano hovoril aj o naších začiatkoch vo Webikone a ako to u nás aktuálne funguje.Tento rozhovor si celý môžete pozrieť na Youtube.2022Letné sústredenie talentovanej mládeže v elektronikeLetné sústredenie talentovanej mládeže v elektronike je miestom, kde sa vždy stretnú veľmi šikovní ľudia, ktorí majú záujem rozvíjať svoje nadšenie pre technológie. Je to tábor pre mladých kde sa môžu učiť od skúsených lektorov a prakticky si skúšať programovanie, 3D tlač, konštrukciu robotických modelov, vyskúšajú si aj videotvorbu a na programe sú aj športové a voľnočasové aktivity.V roku 2022 bol súčasťou aj náš kolega Jano a ako to celé prebiehalo si môžete prečítať v našom článku.2022WordCamp BrnoPo pomerne dlhom období sme konečne zavítali na WordCamp do Brna. Naši kolegovia Jarka a Palo sa účastnili ako dobrovolníci, ale stihli si aj vypočuť rôzne prednášky. Novinkou bola forma panelovej diskusie, kde nerečnil jeden, ale viacerí a bolo to zaujímavé oživenie.2022Ďalšie skvelé teambuildingyAj v roku 2022 sme si dopriali spoločný čas. V máji sme sa stretli vo Vysokých Tatrách, kde nás hostil hotel Sliezky dom. Vyskúšali sme si jazdu na elektrokolobežkách, čo bol naozaj famózny vrchol programu.Na konci roka sme sa ešte stretli na chate v Polomke, kde sme si navarili výborný guláš. Keďže sú naše teabuildingy a fotky z nich legendárne, aj o tomto sme spísali článok, ktorý si určite prečítajte.2023AI revolúciaS nástupom roku 2023 a spustením ChatGPT začala AI revolúcia, ktorá ovládla aj nás. Začali sme skúmať a objavovať zákutia tejto fascinujúcej technológie a vymýšlať spôsoby, ako by sme pomocou nej mohli zefektívniť našu prácu. Náš kolega Rosťo sa do tejto témy ponoril a pravidelne nás zásobuje informácia z tohoto sveta.Pri tom sme však neostali a stále sa téme AI venujeme a snažíme sa ju integrovať do našich procesov.2023Redizajnovaná anglická verzia Webikon webuPo roku od spustenia našeho nového webu sme mali stále zastaralú anglickú verziu a preto sme sa pustili do príprav na jej zverejnenie. Dnes už si ju môžete pozrieť v celej jej kráse aj s projektami.2023Spustenie novej služby WebentorV roku 2023 sme spustili našu novú službu Webentor. Je to proces, ktorý nám umožňuje weby robiť rýchlejšie a lepšie narábať s rozpočtom klienta. Webentor však nie je len proces, ale slúži aj ako sprievodca pri tvorbe webov a na našom webe si môžete pozrieť rôzne zaujímavé články. Náš Webentor tím už fungoval aj predtým a pracoval na svojich vlastných projektoch, ale konečne sme mu dali tvár a dokonca aj maskota. No nie je úžasný?2023Už druhý rok súčasťou LSTMEAj v roku 2023 bol súčasťou Letného sústredenia talentovanej mládeže v elektronike náš kolega Jano. Program opäť tvorili zaujímavé témy a účastníci si mohli naprogramovať svoju vlastnú hru, pre ktorú si zostavili aj herný ovládač, ktorý si vytlačili na 3D tlačiarni. LSTME je úžasné miesto pre nadšencov do technológií, kde sa nie len naučia teóriu od skúsených lektorov, ale môžu si všetko vyskúšať aj prakticky.Sme tím špecialistov, ktorí sa postarajú aj o Váš projektNapíšte nám! Chcem online stretnutieAké technológie používa WebikonNáš tím, naše projekty a aj naše technológie pracujú na princípoch slobodného softvéru a internetu dostupného všetkým. Budujeme okolo seba komunitu, ktorá našla svoju vášen a uplatnenie vo webových technológiach a spoločne rozvíja svoje vedomosti v oblasti dizajnu, vývoja a údržby webových projektov.Open sourceNáš tím, naše projekty a aj naše technológie pracujú na princípoch slobodného softvéru a internetu dostupného všetkým. Používame Open Source od úplného začiatku a považujeme ho za najefektívnejší spôsob realizácie webov a aplikácií pre deskt

Create an account RANDOMHomeRandomBrowse ArticlesQuizzes & GamesAll QuizzesCommunity QuizzesHotLove QuizzesPersonality QuizzesFun GamesDating SimulatorLearn Something NewForumsCoursesHappiness HubExplore MoreSupport wikiHowAbout wikiHowLog in / Sign upTerms of Use Imagine a world where anyone can learn how to do anything. Where access to comprehensive step-by-step instructions in multiple languages enables billions of people to improve their lives, in ordinary and extraordinary ways. Where users can find fun (remember when the internet was fun?!) and interactive experiences that spark joyful moments of self-discovery. That's the world we want to create. We’re looking for talented, collaborative, delightful employees with an interest in education to join our cause. Are you in? Steps Fast Facts wikiHow is the only company that has been on the Comscore top 150 list with under 30 employees. wikiHow helps 60 million people every month, in 19 languages. We have ambitions to push our mission much further to create innovative and delightful interactive experiences for our users. wikiHow offers remote work from certain locations. Though we’re based in Palo Alto, CA, we allow remote work from other states on the West Coast. Additional states may be considered but will require review and approval on a case-by-case basis. You can find our office, the wikiHaus, in beautiful downtown Palo Alto. Bonus: we’re just 3 blocks from the Caltrain Station! wikiHow is considered one of the Internet’s most influential websites. What sets us apart? We value our mission over short-term goals: We want to create content by humans for humans that helps our users learn, discover, and play. We take that mission very seriously. Our team consists of a rare breed: humble, high-performers. Each of us is insanely productive. Our small team of around 20 people is competing with mega corporations with hundreds of employees. And beating them! Huge number of users + Small team = Your work will make an immediate, noticeable impact on millions of people. We pride ourselves on being a beloved staple of the internet that people rely on in their day-to-day lives. But don’t just take it from us, here’s some of the nice things others have said about wikiHow: As a World Changing Idea Finalist, wikiHow was called a company “with an enduring impact on the world” by Fast Company. The Atlantic called us “the largest commercial platform in existence that hasn’t been accused of exploiting its users.” Wired said wikiHow “has become the internet’s answer to almost every question”. According to Vice, “I’ve been yelling for a while about how wikiHow is doing the best consistent service journalism on the web right now.” “Well, wikiHow about that?”-- The Big Bang Theory Company Culture We love coming to work every day. Working with intelligent people to accomplish something globally ambitious is intrinsically satisfying. We are profitable and growing. We are self-funded. We refuse VC money on a regular basis. Investors don’t make our decisions, we do. Our small, cohesive team is gender balanced. We’re often wrong (and that’s OK). Making mistakes show that we are innovating. We love to innovate. We like walking. We even have a few treadmill desks. Find us working outside on a sunny California day, enjoying our beautiful backyard patio — perfect for collaboration and inspiration. We pay top performers well. We are better in person than on TV. We're delightfully quirky (but you probably figured that out already). Just because we’re remote doesn’t mean we don’t enjoy team bonding! We love taking time for online games, the occasional virtual ice cream tasting, and live team meetups. One Thing to Keep In Mind wikiHow is not hoping to be acquired or looking for a quick financial exit. We're already profitable, financially stable, and we all love working here, so we aren't in a rush to sell out. Selling might mean the end to a product that we all love working on. It is an amazing feeling to work on such a popular, high-impact product! That amazing feeling makes us smile when we wake up every day. If all of this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply. If this is a bummer, then that’s okay too, we probably aren't the best fit for you right now, and that’s totally fine! Are you ready to make an impact?West Monroe is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the AI Assets Foundry Team, working with the internal Labs product team to develop proprietary software assets and AI capabilities that help our consultants sell and deliver more effectively and efficiently. This is an internal product engineering role focused on building reusable, scalable, secure AI-enabled applications and platform components in partnership with product owners, designers, architects, governance, and engineering teammates.ResponsibilitiesDesign, develop, test, deploy, and support full-stack software applications and reusable asset components for the Tech Ex AI Assets portfolio. Build and integrate Generative AI capabilities into software products, including APIs, prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, model integration, and evaluation patterns where applicable. Translate product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into maintainable, reliable, and secure code in collaboration with product owners and product design. Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to iterative delivery, estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives. Partner with architects and senior technical leaders to implement established architecture patterns and make practical engineering recommendations without owning enterprise architecture direction. Contribute to engineering quality through code reviews, unit and integration testing, CI/CD practices, documentation, observability, and production support practices. Apply responsible AI, data privacy, security, and compliance considerations when building AI-enabled features and internal software assets. Mentor junior developers, share engineering best practices, and help raise the overall quality and consistency of the asset development team. Troubleshoot defects, performance issues, and integration challenges across front-end, back-end, data, cloud, and AI service layers. Core TechnologiesBack-end: Node.js, Python, .NET Front-end: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 Database / Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, data integration patterns, and vector search or embedding stores where applicable Cloud: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Generative AI: Azure OpenAI, Databricks Machine Learning, LLM integration, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI evaluation concepts Patterns & ToolsPatterns: REST APIs, MVC, MVVM, service-oriented architecture, event-driven patterns, and microservice concepts Source Control / Delivery: Git, Azure DevOps, pull requests, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines DevOps Tooling: Terraform, Docker, infrastructure as code, environment configuration, and deployment automation Package Management: npm, NuGet Testing / Quality: Jest, unit testing, integration testing, code review, static analysis, and defect triage QualificationsBachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred, or equivalent experience required. 5+ years of experience in full-stack software development with demonstrated ability to deliver production-quality software. Strong working knowledge of object-oriented concepts, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and design patterns. Hands-on experience with modern application development using cloud services, APIs, databases, and CI/CD delivery practices. Practical experience building or integrating AI, machine learning, Generative AI, or data-driven capabilities into software products; direct experience with Azure OpenAI, Databricks, LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, or model evaluation is strongly preferred. Comfortable working within a fast-paced, collaborative Agile/Scrum product environment with product owners, designers, architects, engineers, governance, and product success partners. Able to follow architecture direction, contribute engineering design input, and make sound technical tradeoffs while remaining focused on hands-on asset development rather than architecture ownership. Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, and documentation skills. Excellent English communication skills and ability to work effectively with distributed teams across geographies and time zones. Smart, versatile, and passionate about delivering high-quality code and learning new technologies and languages. Experience coaching and mentoring junior developers.
