text: Make the internet a better place for free knowledge. Advancement Senior Program Officer Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) Remote The Community Resources team is the primary funding function of the Wikimedia Foundation ensuring that we support the Affiliates and volunteer contributors of the Wikimedia Movement by offering institutional and individual funding to help achieve the Movement’s goals. To support the movement’s commitment to Knowledge Equity, the team prioritizes proactive outreach to communities that structures of power and privilege have left out. The Senior Program Officer will implement the regional funding programs serving Wikimedian communities in Sub-Saharan Africa. Lead Learning Experience Designer Remote The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Lead Learning Experience Designer to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You’ll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors. Communications Wikimania Scholarships and Event Coordinator (Contract) Remote This role will support the Lead project manager and others in the Core organising team on event planning and logistics, helping to provide local knowledge and expertise. The role will also work with the Communications team on communications to our scholars, self funded attendees and general audiences through a range of communication channels. Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract) Remote The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation’s broader communications priorities. This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s Communications Department, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise. Principal, Executive Communications Remote The Wikimedia Foundation seeks a senior communications professional to lead our executive communications across a growing, global portfolio. This person’s main responsibility is to serve as a primary communications partner to the Foundation’s CEO, providing strategic counsel and direct support across internal and external communications. This includes building a comprehensive engagement strategy spanning multiple and complex stakeholder groups. In close collaboration with colleagues on the Foundation’s media relations and internal communications teams, and with the Foundation’s Chief of Staff, this person will develop, shape, and implement a strategy for the CEO to communicate and advance the vision of the Wikimedia Foundation. In addition, they will support external communications for other members of the Foundation’s executive team and the Board of Trustees. Head of Marketing Remote The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for an experienced Head of Marketing to help establish and oversee a new function responsible for product and integrated marketing. Positioned within the External Communications team, the Head of Marketing will collaborate with Foundation stakeholders to shape our go-to-market approach. While the primary audience focus for the role is readers, they will also help develop a unified view of audience engagement across the Foundation’s external audiences. Finance and Administration Lead Financial Analyst, Strategic Business Partner – Product & Technology Remote Join the Foundation in our ambitious project to empower people to create and share the sum of all human knowledge. We are looking for a Lead Financial Analyst to serve as the strategic business partner to our Product & Technology department, one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing parts of the organization, with a combined budget of more than $100M. You will also support other key areas of our work and, as the most senior analyst on the Financial Business Partner team, be responsible for driving improvements in financial planning, analytics, and our business partnership practices. Legal Please check back soon! People Department Please check back soon! Product & Technology Senior UX Designer Remote The Product Design team is looking for a Senior UX Designer with a solid understanding of user experience and product development processes to work within a new multi-disciplinary product team that will be focused on improving trust and safety. You will be influential in creating and developing the user experience, feeding directly into the product strategy for your product team. For this role, you will primarily be working with the Reader Growth team, software focused on ways of learning and engagement for new and casual readers of Wikipedia. Software Engineering Internship Program (2027) Remote We are looking for graduates, non-graduates, or those seeking a career change who are interested in developing software engineering skills through an immersive “learn on the job” internship program. As an intern, you will be embedded into an engineering team within our Product and Technology departments and assigned a primary project with clear deliverables. Alongside your manager and dedicated mentor, you will learn the inner workings of our open source code that helps to create “a world in which everyone can freely share in the sum of all knowledge”. You will work with software that serves over half a billion page views per day through Wikipedia (and other Wikimedia projects). The outcome of your work will impact how all people everywhere discover, share, and contribute to free knowledge. Senior Software Engineer, Android (Contract) Remote The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Android to support the App Experience and App Growth teams within the Core Experiences engineering group. Our teams have a clear and ambitious goal: make our apps the destination for knowledge lovers and grow our active readership. Senior Software Engineer, iOS (Contract) Remote The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, iOS to join the App Growth team within the Core Experiences engineering group on a 3-month full time contract. The App Growth team has a clear and ambitious goal: make the apps the destination for knowledge lovers and grow our active readership. The team owns the cross-platform feature framework for the app, making decisions about where a feature lives when the app is the destination and where its primary value is unlocked. Senior Data Scientist, Safety & Security Remote We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to help guide Wikipedia’s anti-abuse and security strategy as a member of our Product Analytics team. In this role, you will inform our product development strategy by collaborating with product managers, engineers, and others to help our features and interventions make the impact they should. Software Quality Manager Remote The Wikimedia Foundation (WMF) is looking for an experienced Software Quality Manager to lead two teams who are providing testing & documentation services to multiple WMF engineering teams while fostering a culture where Software Quality & Documentation is everyone’s responsibility. This role supports geographically distributed teams of 5-10 Test Engineers & 3 Technical Writers who are providing services that improve the quality of our software. They engage with multiple WMF teams in high-impact initiatives to provide technical documentation, automated test suites, and manual testing for the software that runs Wikipedia and its sister projects. Lead Product Manager, Security Remote Wikimedia’s Product Safety and Integrity team is charged with keeping Wikipedia a stable and trustworthy place, and protecting its many contributors and readers. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to bring their experience dealing with modern threats to bear on Wikipedia’s security strategy in the AI era, and to drive a strong security culture throughout the Wikimedia Foundation and movement. Though this is a senior role, prior experience in a product manager role is not required. This position is intended to bring strong technical and security experience, including some familiarity with AI in a security context, into a role focused on product and platform strategy. Values We are in this mission together We do great work and improve We welcome everyone who shares our Vision and Values We listen and share with curiosity Read more about our values. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Commitment We trust our personal and organizational accountability We envision a world in which every single person can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe knowledge belongs to everyone, and in order to empower people from diverse backgrounds to participate in the collaborative creation of knowledge, we need to build diverse teams that reflect the communities we support and an inclusive culture of belonging that embraces the potential of our diversity. We believe in co-creating safe, respectful and collaborative work spaces. We aspire to generate a sense of belonging by understanding each and everyone’s differences, contexts and experiences. Through our actions, we ensure that the staff at the Foundation has a healthy work environment where they can flourish. We acknowledge diversity as a core value that is essential to fulfilling our mission. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not tolerate any form of discrimination. This enables us to attract, develop, and retain amazing talent. We are committed to cherishing our differences, and putting people first. We seek to foster a creative environment that unleashes innovative solutions toward building a more inclusive and equitable hiring and retention process. This commitment starts at the top of our organization and moves through every level of hiring from managers to individual contributors. We strive to ensure excellence in our work by building this path together. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics. If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at recruiting@wikimedia.org or +1 (415) 839-6885. United States Benefits and Perks Health Care Benefits Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees and their eligible families. New Parent Leave We provide a total of 16 weeks of paid new parent leave, plus an additional 8 weeks of paid pregnancy leave. Wellness Reimbursement Program We provide $450 per quarter up to $1,800.00 a year for reimbursement for staff wellness expenses, such as gym fees, educational expenses, and more! Professional Development Program We offer reimbursement of conferences, college/university classes, online programs, and books related to work that supports the Wikimedia Foundation. 401(k) Retirement Plan 401(k) retirement plan with matched contributions up to 4% of annual salary. Time Off Generous paid time off policy which includes: vacation days, holidays, sick leave, and volunteer days. Pre-tax Savings Plans For health care, child care, elder care, public transport, and parking expenses. Includes an employer funded HSA option. Disability & Life Insurance Long and short term disability, life insurance (2x salary) and an employee assistance program. Equipment Stipend Equipment including a laptop, monitor, plus a one-time $600 stipend to cover any additional needs to make sure you have the best work from home experience. *Please note that for remote roles located outside of the U.S., we defer to our EOR (Employer of Record) to ensure alignment with local labor laws. Current Hiring Locations The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based in 40+ countries. *Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District) Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only) We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements. Compensation Philosophy Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. In compliance with local legislation within the US, we post the anticipated annual pay range for each position for applicants with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location. All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process. We believe that diversity is a business’s greatest asset. Working with coworkers that come from all walks of life encourages people to challenge their way of thinking. And what better way to broaden our talent pool than by widening our search for passionate, hardworking individuals across the globe? Several years ago, we made the switch to become a 100 percent remote team so that our employees could create the work-life balance they want and deserve. As one of the truly remote companies out there today, our fully distributed team can set their schedules to make time for family, travel, fitness goals, and anything else that they value in their lives. Our Core Values (What Matters Most to Us?) Our core values are the rules and boundaries that define our company’s culture and personality and provide a final “should/shouldn’t” test for everyone’s behaviors and decisions in the company. In simplest terms, it’s the soul of Uhuru. Let’s break it down so you can see what the best digital marketing careers should be like: Always Educate Here, although you will learn a lot in your first 90 days, alone—we never stop learning. Even the most senior-level experts should keep brushing up on their skills and knowledge, as times are changing, and we want everyone to be abreast of trends, so we have the best strategies for our clients. We will provide those opportunities to you for continued education because it’s important to us. Encourage Individual Initiatives As much fun as you’ll have here, we recognize it’s not your whole life. We want you to have hobbies on the side. Pick up crafting, a new sport, or anything else that fulfills your non-work passions and feel the support of the team behind you all the way. Hyper Communication & Clear Expectations Unlike other digital marketing careers, you won’t have someone breathing down your neck in a cubicle or knocking on your office door. Yet, we still highly value collaboration. We’re fully remote, so we build enough mutual trust with you that we can be confident you will regularly keep in touch with us through our various cloud-based tools—and not leave any team member hanging. We have daily team check-ins called Huddles, so it’s nearly impossible to feel stuck for long—and trust us, you won’t feel like your coworkers are strangers. We also encourage social chatter via our digital channels, not just talk about assignments—get to know one another like any traditional, in-person job! Good Fit You may be a hard worker, but if we don’t share values—or you’re not a nice person—we might not be a good match. Culture is a crucial part of how we function. It’s been proven repeatedly that any team works best when they like each other! You might be a good fit for Uhuru if you have self-initiative, like to improve continually, hyper-communicate, like working with groups, work hard to deliver your best work and results for clients, have a positive attitude, work hard and love what you do. If you’re looking for an easy marketing job, this is not the place. Practice What We Preach Actions speak louder than words, especially when it comes to digital marketing careers. See these values? We stick to them. We live by them each and every day. We don’t say things unless we really mean them. This list has been tried and tested and has resulted in better outcomes for our clients and team members alike. Each is a calculated and key piece of our overall strategy for success. Leave People Better Than We Found Them Starting to sound familiar? This is one of our all-time favorite mottos. We want to offer considerable value to every person that virtually walks through our digital doors. We are a smaller company, and we have not been around for eons. So we need to have a greater impact than the larger agencies. And we are dedicated to making a noticeable difference in the companies we work with. Give Them More than What They Expect We are not ones for doing the bare minimum. Again, we believe digital marketing careers should be about delivering exceptional value. Any opportunity we see to do so, we jump to the chance. We like our clients to know that we aren’t in the game to make money—we are here to genuinely help them grow to heights they’ve never seen before. Value Statement: We Value Results Value Statement: We Value People Value Statement: We Value Learning Uhuru’s Principles Uhuru is confident in its culture. We even have a Uhuru Culture Bible, which team members use to hold each other accountable. Principle #1: We Before Me We are super team-oriented. We are not a selfish clan. We see things in a “we” mentality and are proud of this mindset. Our ability to move through projects seamlessly, as a single entity, makes the quality of what we create that much stronger. Principle #3: Ask Questions No question is a bad question. The more you ask, the more you learn. We would rather you be open, honest, and inquisitive with us than stay silent and feel lost. We are here for you, so never be afraid to speak up! Principle #5: Work Like an Owner There is no room for someone to be MIA with the digital marketing careers we offer. We like to have equal weight and ownership in what we deliver for clients. This company is your baby, too, not just that of the founders’. Principle #7: Discuss What’s Best, Not Who’s Right We’re big on respect. All ideas matter, but in the end, it’s not just about us—it’s about making the client happy. Be willing and able to appreciate different perspectives. Principle #9: Teach What You Learn For digital marketing careers—or really, any job that you sincerely care about with every fiber of your being—if you learn something new, spread the knowledge. It may do the group well for others to know what you just found out, too. Plus, you’ll feel good helping your teammates grow. Once again, add value wherever possible. And lead by example! It might benefit us all, as a whole. Principle #11: Do the Little Things Well Even the little things count in digital marketing careers like these. You should be detail-oriented and be willing to follow our processes to a T to help ensure things keep on flowing. Our scrum framework is there to help us be—and stay—agile! We pride ourselves on getting a lot done for clients in less time due to the precise, proven procedures we’ve developed over the years. Principle #2: Bring Your Whole Self to Work We’re in it to win it (for our clients). Are you? Are you prepared to give your all and create your best work yet? We work hard and play hard, so if you can see yourself in that type of environment, you just might find a home at Uhuru. Principle #4: Tell Your Team the Truth Remember, we are counting on you to be a real asset to the team and be someone upon whom others can rely. Maintaining a well-functioning remote landscape requires having a team in which we can have immense confidence—and one where all members can have full faith in one another. Principle #6: The glass is already broken We always do our best at that moment. But we always expect to find a better way eventually. In essence, we know everything we are doing now is going to be replaced eventually by something else. All of our processes are already “broken.” Principle #8: Do Right by People Keep in mind, it’s your team. It’s who you’ll spend a big part of your day with, so you’ll be getting really comfortable with them. If you can’t, it simply might not work out. It’s all about how you treat each other. There are even times we have taken our team’s side over a client’s if we truly believe it’s right in those circumstances. title: Arbeiten bei Webrunners
text: Arbeiten bei WebrunnersJobs für Softwareentwickler​ in KölnAls Agentur für Softwareentwicklung & IT-Consulting mit Sitz im schönen Köln richten wirbereits seit 2005 unseren Fokus auf agile Web- und Softwareentwicklung, die Umsetzungkomplexer Webanwendungen, individuelle Softwarelösungen, IT-Consulting undProgrammierdienstleistungen. Dabei arbeiten wir stets mit den neuesten Standards, sowohl imOnline-Bereich als auch offline. Wir möchten uns ständig weiterentwickeln und deshalb unserTeam erweitern.Du bist auf der Suche nach einem spannenden Arbeitsplatz und willst in einem lockeren undaufgeschlossenen Team agil arbeiten? Dann stöbere doch einfach in unseren aktuellenJobangeboten und schaue, ob etwas Passendes für dich dabei ist.Sicher bewerben bei Webrunners: Erfahre hier, woran du echte Jobangebote erkennst und wie du dich vor Betrug schützt. Jetzt bewerben Offene Positionen Das bieten wir dir Bewerbungsprozess Freelancer:in (w/m/d) Direkt bewerben Wir arbeiten seit jeher gern mit Freelancern im Bereich Software- und Webentwicklung zusammen. Wenn Du dich in den von uns eingesetzten Technologien wiederfindest und darin sattelfest bist, freuen wir uns über ein unverbindliches Kennenlernen.Initiativbewerbungen Direkt bewerben Ist keine passende Stelle dabei, du bringst aber viel Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit, dann kannst du uns gerne deine Initiativbewerbung zukommen lassen.Bitte beachte, dass wir derzeit keine Schülerpraktika anbieten.Teamwork & HierarchieOb Azubi oder Senior: in unserer flachen Hierarchie zählt jede:r und ist gleich wichtig. Wir alle können uns darauf verlassen, jederzeit Unterstützung von unseren Mitarbeitenden zu erhalten. Denn„ONE TEAM – ONE MISSION“ wird bei uns ganz groß geschrieben.Wir legen Wert darauf, dass jede:r aus dem Team in die Entscheidungsfindung einbezogen wird.In einer gemeinsamen Runde diskutieren wir das Für und Wider und bewerten es, damit am Ende jeder die Entscheidung nachvollziehen kann.Das bieten wir dir. Natürlich sind das keine leeren Versprechen, sondern unsere Philosophie von unserem Miteinander. Flexible ArbeitszeitenWir haben hier bei Webrunners das Arbeitsmodell „Gleitzeit“. Du kannst also entscheiden, wanndu deine Arbeit beginnen und wann du sie beenden möchtest. Unsere Kernarbeitszeit ist von 10Uhr bis 14 Uhr, in welcher jede:r erreichbar sein sollte. Remote arbeitenDu hast die Möglichkeit flexibel von dem Ort zu arbeiten, an welchem du gerne sein möchtest. Sei es mit den Füßen im Pool oder gemütlich von deiner Couch aus. Alle unsere Meetings finden online statt und die Dokumentation von Projekten sind auf unseren Git-Boards zu finden. Wir arbeiten gerne selbstverantwortlich und sprechen uns im Team ab. KaffeekränzchenTäglich haben alle Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, auf freiwilliger Basis an unserem sogenannten „Kaffeekränzchen“ teilzunehmen – vor allem in der Zeit, in der jeder im Homeoffice arbeitet. Dort haben wir alle die Gelegenheit, uns über Themen auszutauschen, die mal nichts mit der Arbeit zu tun haben. Wissen teilenWir tauschen uns regelmäßig in separaten Meetings aus – zum einen um uns wissenstechnisch auf einen Nenner zu bringen und unsere Fähigkeiten gemeinsam auszubauen und zum anderen, damit jedes Teammitglied versteht, mit welchen Aufgaben sich die Kollegen auf welche Art befassen. FirmeneventsWir planen regelmäßig Firmenevents, auch mal ohne Anlass, bei denen wir z.B. Sommerfeste und Grillabende im Garten, kleine Wanderungen unternehmen, Escape Rooms oder Kletterhallen besuchen, eine Fahrradtour machen, mal spontan zum See fahren, wenn die Hitze unerträglich wird oder andere Dinge tun, die unser Team noch mehr zusammenschweißen. HackathonIn regelmäßigen Abständen treffen wir uns im Creative Space um gemeinsam im interdisziplinären Team an gemeinsamen Projekten zuarbeiten. Sei es der Bau von Robotern, von eigenen Gamecontroller oder anderen Dingen, die uns gerade einfallen. Jede:r darf eigene Ideen mitbringen, kann sich austauschen und neues erlernen. Essen & TrinkenWir lieben Essen und wollen sicherstellen, dass alle Teammitglieder glücklich sind. Wir haben immer Obst und Süßigkeiten vorrätig und auch ein Kühlschrank mit verschiedenen Getränken steht allen zur Verfügung. Ab und zu planen wir ein gemeinsames Kochen oder bestellen ein Festmahl für das gesamte Team. Komfortabler ArbeitsplatzWir verbringen viele Stunden damit, uns auf unsere Projekte zu konzentrieren, deshalb ist es wichtig, dass der Arbeitsplatz auf die Bedürfnisse jedes Einzelnen abgestimmt ist. Unsere Schreibtische sind höhenverstellbar, sodass es auch möglich ist im Stehen zu arbeiten. Sport & EntspannungWir haben keinen Sportraum, aber alle Mitarbeiter haben die Möglichkeit, Mitglied im „Urban Sports Club“ zu werden. Wir übernehmen die Kosten für die Mitgliedschaft.Arbeiten von überall Du wohnst nicht in der Kölner Umgebung? Kein Problem! Wir bieten auch die Möglichkeit, aus der Ferne zu arbeiten, sodass du trotzdem Teil unseres Teams sein kannst. Ebenso sind wir offen für Freelancer. Deine AnsprechpartnerinDu hast Fragen rund ums Thema Karriere bei den Webrunners? Schreib uns gerne und wir werden dir gerne alle Fragen beantworten. jobs@webrunners.de Jetzt bewerben Finja Projektmanagement, Recruiting & Design

title: Security Engineer - Product
text: WizSign inUnder attack?CareersSecurity Engineer - ProductLondon, UK; Remote - United Kingdom | Product SecurityCome join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!Role Description Wiz is looking for a Security Engineer for Product & Production Infrastructure who has experience performing security reviews, vulnerability management, and detection and response operations in cloud-native environments. You’ll get to collaborate with our software development and DevOps teams to secure Wiz’s products, CI/CD infrastructure, and production infrastructure. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence our product roadmap by utilizing Wiz-for-Wiz to assess, monitor, and harden our environments. Responsibilities Lead threat modeling and security reviews across Wiz's products and cloud infrastructure, identifying attack surfaces and developing scalable mitigation strategies. Build automation, policy-as-code, and security tooling that enables development teams to "shift left" and integrate end-to-end security into their workflows. Design and implement secure baselines for cloud resources and Kubernetes based infrastructure. Drive vulnerability management and remediation efforts – prioritizing issues, implementing mitigations, and designing strategic preventative controls in software supply chains from development through production. Extend our detection and response capabilities – building scalable solutions to identify malicious activity, triage alerts, and investigate and remediate incidents. Build deep functional partnerships with Wiz's engineering and operations teams – helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions. Minimum qualifications 7+ years of experience in security engineering or security operations work in cloud environments. Experience with AWS cloud security (or equivalent experience in Azure and GCP with some level of AWS experience). Experience with cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and container security principles. Experience securing IAM and cloud identities at scale. Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, conducting threat modeling exercises, and translating findings into actionable security controls. Practical understanding of web application security concepts (such as OWASP Top-10 and similar). Hands-on experience with IaC and related tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Pulumi). Experience with automation and tooling development in one or more of the following: Python, Go, Shell, HCL, Rego. Preferred qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, and/or equivalent job experience in lieu of a degree. Experience working with remote, globally distributed teams. Experience working in organizations that develop software and/or operate managed infrastructure and technology services for their own customers. Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, or CIEM solutions. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need for visa sponsorship. This role does not offer visa sponsorship. Wiz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wiz will process your personal data in accordance with Wiz's Privacy Policy.Apply NowApply Now

title: Manager of Applied AI, Solutions Support Engineering
text: WizSign inUnder attack?CareersManager of Applied AI, Solutions Support EngineeringRemote - USA | Support Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!Minimum qualifications: 2+ years of experience leading or managing a team of internal tool developers, automation engineers, or systems developers, driving technical direction, scheduling and running Agile sprints, and managing epics and defects in Jira while staying actively hands-on in the code. 5+ years of hands-on development experience building internal tools, backend services, APIs, and web applications using Python and TypeScript/JavaScript (e.g., Node.js, React). Hands-on experience with Zendesk and Salesforce administration and development, including owning Zendesk configurations and apps, writing Salesforce Apex code, working with custom objects and workflows, and integrating with platforms like ServiceNow. Practical experience deploying and maintaining cloud-hosted services on GCP (or AWS/Azure) using containers, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery), and message queues. Hands-on experience using AI models, APIs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted coding tools to build internal applications, automate operational workflows, and speed up the development lifecycle. Experience with everyday development and deployment tooling, including Terraform, Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and managing changes across both cloud services and CRM sandboxes. Candidates must meet EAR part 772 and ITAR 120.15 definition of a U.S. person (Any individual who is granted U.S. citizenship; or any individual who is granted U.S. permanent residence (green card holder); or any individual who is granted status as a "protected person") and reside in the contiguous United States. Preferred qualifications: Experience connecting AI tools and workflows to internal systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool proxies, and AI models and coding tools (such as Gemini and Claude Code). Experience building custom UI components, embedded apps, and integrations across Zendesk, Salesforce, and ServiceNow, such as Zendesk Apps Framework (ZAF) apps and Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC). Track record of building practical productivity tools for internal teams, such as Chrome extensions, VS Code extensions, or cloud-hosted workspaces. Experience building ticket routing, scheduling, and team availability tools that factor in queues, engineer skills, and global shift coverage. Familiarity with integrating workplace and support tools like Slack (bots and workflows), Jira, Zoom, and BI reporting pipelines. Prior customer-facing experience in a technical support role, preferably at a B2B technology company. About the job: At Wiz, technical support is never an afterthought. It is core to how our platform functions and a key part of how we create magic for our customers every day. To deliver a truly magical support experience at global scale, we put AI at the forefront of how we operate. As a Manager of Applied AI, Solutions Support Engineering, you will be an AI-first technical leader guiding the team of internal tool and automation developers who build the tools and architecture that make this experience possible. Rather than managing customer-facing support engineers directly, you will lead the builders behind our support platform ecosystem. You will own our primary Zendesk ticketing environment, build integrations with Salesforce and ServiceNow, and lead the development of our intelligent ticket routing, browser and IDE extensions, and automated triage, pre-investigation, and resolution workflows. You will thrive in this role not only by leading and mentoring your team, but by getting your hands directly into the technology. Leading from the front, you will split your time between writing and reviewing code alongside your team, using AI models and tools like Gemini and Claude Code to build internal tools and run our development pipeline, owning our Zendesk platform, and coaching the developers who power our support organization. Responsibilities: Lead, mentor, and guide an AI-first team of internal tool and automation developers, scheduling and running sprints in Jira, managing epics and defects, and driving day-to-day technical execution and team growth. Own the tooling and automation roadmap that powers our technical support experience, designing the tools and architecture that handle the heavy lifting of case resolution. Serve as a hands-on technical leader, actively writing, reviewing, and shipping code in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Apex across internal web apps, background automation jobs, and CRM integrations. Champion an AI-first development pipeline by using AI models, APIs, and coding tools (like Gemini and Claude Code) to build internal tools faster, power automated ticket triage and pre-investigation workflows, and maintain high quality and reliability across our automations. Own the administration, architecture, and custom development of our Zendesk platform (including embedded apps, webhooks, declarative workflows, and routing/SLA logic), while building custom integrations and workflows across ServiceNow and Salesforce (including Apex code). Lead the development and maintenance of our internal support tooling suite, including skills- and availability-based ticket routing, browser and IDE extensions, and integrations with Slack, Jira, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Maintain the cloud infrastructure that runs our support tools and automations on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using containerized services, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Terraform while keeping access and customer data secure. Partner closely with Support leadership, frontline Solutions Support Engineers, Product, and the CTO team to spot workflow bottlenecks and build new tools and automations that keep AI at the forefront of our support experience. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need for visa sponsorship. This role does not offer visa sponsorship. AI-first delivery. Architecture decisions.We are looking for a highly senior engineer who can operate at Lead Engineer level across frontend and mobile applications.This is not a role for someone who only executes tickets. We need someone who can make architecture decisions independently, design scalable frontend and mobile systems, and turn ambiguous product needs into production-ready applications.This is a high-ownership role on a lean team. The default mode of execution is AI-first. Engineers use AI agents and tools such as Cursor, Claude, and similar platforms to accelerate research, planning, implementation, testing, and refinement, but ownership stays fully with the engineer. The person in this role must be able to use AI to move fast while maintaining strong judgment around architecture, correctness, performance, usability, maintainability, and overall product quality.The workDesign and own frontend and mobile application architecture across React, React Native, and Next.jsMake architecture decisions independently, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliabilityBuild production-grade applications using TypeScript across web and mobile environmentsWork with GraphQL APIs and define clean integration patterns across frontend, mobile, and API layersDefine scalable engineering patterns across React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQLOwn application quality standards across architecture, code structure, testing, responsiveness, and developer experienceDefine technical direction, not just implementation detailsSet and enforce quality standards across both AI-generated and manually written codeUse AI-first and agentic development workflows with tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate delivery without compromising engineering standardsTranslate ambiguous product needs into clear technical solutionsEnsure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications across web and mobileCollaborate directly with clients to ensure smooth communication and strong understanding of requirementsContribute to system design, performance strategy, testing strategy, and engineering productivityApply a basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift when working with React Native integrations, debugging, or platform-specific requirementsThis is a fast-paced environment with real production stakes. title: Yonder
text: Yonder Events Services We’re building a movement to create more distributed companies and change the future of work. Follow Report this company About us We make “remote” work. Yonder offers resources for distributed companies and remote teams including consulting services, conferences, and a popular podcast featuring interviews with company leaders and others thinking about remote work. Yonder was started in 2013 by Lullabot as a round-table conference for leaders of distributed companies and remote teams. The event allowed companies like Automattic, GitHub, Upworthy, and others to come together and share ideas, discuss best practices, and start to develop a common vocabulary around this new frontier for work. In 2016, Yonder split off from Lullabot and we launched this website, adding a podcast and ongoing blog articles to share these ideas with a larger audience. We're continuing to expand the products and services that we offer to create remote jobs and to support companies interested in creating and cultivating distributed teams. DescriptionAbout XeXe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.About This RoleWe're hiring a senior full-stack engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and frontend experience through to backend services, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the platform across the stack, and lead delivery of customer-facing features as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small engineering team with direct access to product, design, and compliance, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.What You'll DoDesign and own features across the stack that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.Lead delivery of customer-facing features that customers use every day, from the interface through to the services behind them.Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.Lead cross-functional delivery with product, design, and compliance from problem framing through launch.Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.What We're Looking ForMust-have6 to 10+ years building production web applications, end-to-end.Strong frontend proficiency with Vue.js, React, or equivalent.Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).Solid SQL and relational database fundamentals.Writing and maintaining tests as part of how you ship.Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.Production experience on AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.Strong communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design.Nice-to-haveFrontend fundamentals: responsive design, accessibility, web performance, and internationalization.Experience leading front-end or platform modernization and migrations.Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).Perks & BenefitsFree Life InsuranceSupplemental Medical & Dental InsuranceInternal emergency loansBirthday day offVarious discounts via Caja Los AndesEuronet stock purchase (quarterly option)Remittance service with no commission for immediate familyAnnual salary reviewsAgreement with Smart Fit (Gym)We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.Xe is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. You will work on a few assignments and get to know your future team membersJob OfferIf all goes well, we’d be happy to welcome you to our team!Application FAQHow do I apply for a job at Yazio? You can find all open positions on our Jobs Page. You can upload your CV, cover letter, other necessary documents and even an intro video. Feel free to send your intro video via WeTransfer.Once you've submitted your application, you should receive an automatic confirmation.We will then screen your application and get back to you as soon as possible.Please avoid sending your application via e-mail and, instead, apply directly through our Jobs Page. This is the best option for everyone!How can I make my application stand out? Ensure that your CV and especially your cover letter are perfectly tailored to the position you're applying for.Let us know why you want to work for Yazio and what appeals to you most about the respective position.We would particularly love to see an introduction video of you telling us about yourself as well as your hobbies and interests. Other exciting profiles relevant to the job, such as a personal blog, your IG or GitHub profile, are also always exciting for us to see. It's not a must but definitely a plus!How and where does the initial job training take place? Since we are a remote-first company, the initial job training generally takes place remotely from where you will be regularly working.You will have two regular contacts at Yazio: Your team lead, who will support and train you regarding all departmental matters, and a people manager, who will be available to answer all of your personnel-related questions.Can I work from anywhere in the world? To work at Yazio, you must be located in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the U.K.Our remote-first approach provides the flexibility for you to work from home, a co-working space or other locations within your country of employment.It is also possible to work from abroad for a limited period of time depending on the destination. This means constant travel or a digital nomad lifestyle does not fit with our corporate culture.How does remote work at Yazio function and how do you communicate with each other? We utilize various tools to ensure work and communication are efficient and pleasant.Our most important communication tool is Slack. In addition, we also use Google Meet for video calls and Notion for knowledge and project management.Proactive, written communication is extremely important when working remotely. This is the only way to ensure a smooth workflow.How do you make sure remote employees feel included when they aren't in the office every day? Our entire team comes together once a year for an unforgettable 4-day company retreat. We travel to a select location and take part in exciting and relaxing activities, such as outdoor cooking, yoga, hiking and plenty more!In addition, sub-teams have the opportunity to plan and conduct their own Department Days once a year. These events as well as other remote team events, such as online cooking courses, help to encourage and build a positive team spirit.But that’s not all! To encourage connection with colleagues outside of one’s own team, we also have Donut Dates. Up to three team members are randomly matched via Slack to enjoy a virtual coffee date and get to know each other better.We also offer virtual lunches and off-topic Slack channels, such as movie and podcast recommendations.It's extremely important to us that everybody feels comfortable and socially engaged with the rest of the team. It's worked out great so far!What makes working for your company special? Team atmosphere is everything: We constantly support each other and are working towards a common goal—to become the most popular and best nutrition app in the world!At Yazio, you'll have plenty of flexibility: Not only can you decide where you work from, you can also decide when. Our core hours are only from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. CET daily!With us, you can make a difference: Since we're a very dynamic team, every single person matters and is able to make essential contributions to an exciting product for millions of users!How much do you pay your employees? Salary is dependent on several factors, including the position being filled and applicant experience.We believe fair salary is essential and conduct regular salary reviews.Still have questions?Do you identify with our core values and want to become a part of our team? text: Work that mattersYNAB is the best place to work, ever. (Don’t take our word for it! They voted!) We are intentional about creating an environment where everyone gets to do important work they love.View OpeningsView Openings CultureAt YNAB, we think one of the best things we can offer is the chance to do meaningful work alongside people you respect, admire, and genuinely enjoy. And we mean that—from the beginning, we’ve been intentional about creating the company we want to work for. Along the way, we’ve learned that great teams are built by the people in them. Our team is full of competent people who thrive on tough challenges and share a commitment to doing exceptional work. We value clear expectations and ownership over unnecessary layers of process, and look for people who speak candidly, act with conviction, and are relentlessly curious. That’s the team we’re building at YNAB: one that cares deeply, works pragmatically, and always finds time to laugh (mostly at ourselves).Live where you wantWe've always been a fully remote team. As long as you have a reliable internet connection, you’re good to travel or live wherever you’d like. Just promise you’ll share pictures and recommendations from your life of extravagant travel to exotic places!No outrageous hoursWe’ve adopted a four-day work week and rarely work more than that. There may be times where things get busy and people put some extra time in but then they take some extra time off, so it all balances out. We work hard but smart—we’re in this for the long haul.Take vacation (seriously)We have a minimum vacation policy of three weeks per year, and we will (kindly) bug you if you aren’t taking it. We also have a two-week company break every December. You’ll often see vacation photos posted in our internal chat room, creatively named #office-wall. A Spikeball tournament, Joshua Tree adventure, art workshop, escape room, karaoke, and lots of board games and puzzles…the 2022 YNAB retreat in Palm Springs was a blast.Meetups and the YNAB RetreatWe love remote work around here, but we also love getting together in person. Work-focused meetups with small teams help us connect and build camaraderie, while doing some very cool in-person work. And then there's our biennial company retreat... think Best Western conference room, PowerPoints for hours, and lots of personal finance talk. Just kidding. One year, we were in Costa Rica. Another time, we stayed at a dude ranch in Montana with an unforgettable trip to Yellowstone. We do really fun things, but the highlight always seems to be just hanging out. (And, if we’re being totally honest, board games.)Play ButtonPalm SpringsPlay ButtonLaguna BeachPlay ButtonCosta RicaBenefitsOur team is spread all over the world—mostly in the United States, but also in the UK, Canada, Germany, Brazil, Mexico, and several other countries. Team members who live in the US or UK are set up as employees, and those who live in other countries set themselves up as independent contractors. You’re an equal part of the team no matter where you live.Health, dental, and visionFor full-time employees in the U.S., we offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, where we cover 100% of the premium for you and your family. No need to check your vision, you read that right—100%. (Although if you did need to check your vision, we’ve got you covered!)Retirement savingsFor full-time employees in the U.S., we have a Traditional and Roth 401(k) option. YNAB matches your contributions up to six percent, and the money is yours immediately. No vesting period. For U.K. employees, we contribute six percent to your pension.Parental leaveWe also offer generous paid parental leave for all full-time team members. (Here’s to increasing the world’s YNABers, one child at a time!) PerksIf you ask our team about the benefits of working here, they’ll mention our great people, our culture, and our focus on work-life balance, but most of all, they’ll talk about how significant it is to work on a product that makes such a huge, positive difference in people’s lives.Profit-shareWe offer profit-shares twice a year—if YNAB wins, everybody wins.Professional developmentEveryone gets an annual stipend for professional development (and a separate one for books!).Birthday giftsWe get ideas from your 50-item bucket list, your partner, your best friend, your mom, your manager...PurposeTurns out helping people reduce their financial stress makes working at YNAB really, really enjoyable.We don’t have any openings right now.Thanks for checking us out! Unfortunately we aren't currently hiring, but we'd love to keep in touch. Please “Register Your Interest” to add your information to our database—we’ll let you know about future jobs at YNAB that you might be interested in!
